Morning Translation.

Q. Were you a member of the Executive Committee or of the Standing Committee?
A. I was a member of the Standing Committee. Tsang Nai-chi, Li Kung-poh, Wong Zac-dz and Sz Liang were also Standing Committee members, but Tseu Tao-fun was a member of the Executive Committee.
Q. Did Kco Liu-uhing (留馨), Ning Zoong-kao (任崇皋) and Loo Tsing (羅青) attend the association?
A. I do not know them.
Q. Did you know Leo Tsing before?
A. I cannot remember very well. I only met him through the introduction of Sz Liang while in the reception room. At first I thought he had been sent to watch us, and I did not know him to be Loo Tsing until I was introduced.
Q. Was Loo Ching a representative of the national salvation association?
A. No.
Q. How many times did the Executive Committee of the All-China National Salvation Association meet?
A. Twice altogether after the general meeting of the association; one meeting was held in the home of Mr. Ma Siang-pah (馬湘伯), but I cannot remember the date.
Q. When were the manifesto and the general political principles of the general meeting of the association drawn up?
A. They were drawn up at the general meeting by persons appointed to do the work.
Q. What was the manifesto of the general meeting for?
A. To explain to the Government and people our suggestions for resisting the foe.
Q. What were the general political principles intended for?
A. They were intended to solicit preliminary views of the various parties.
Q. What did they mean by "allying with various Parties and cliques?"
A. They did not point to any definite party. The various Parties and cliques throughout the country all hoped to join hands together to resist Japan.
Q. Was the Kuomintang included?
A. The Kuomintang was naturally included; in fact it occupied the leading position.
Q. Did it mean a government to be jointly organized by the various Parties and cliques?
A. Nothing of the sort was said and furthermore such a government was not needed in view of the fact that there is already the National Government.
Q. The general political principles advocated a general election and the convention of a National Congress. What did this mean?
A. This was based on the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen's declaration to convene a National Congress when he went to North China.
Q. The general political principles advocated the establishment of a united political regime in the country after the convention of the National Congress. What did this mean?
pages.zh:
1937年6月12日。
晨间译本。

问：你是执行委员会成员还是常务委员会成员？
答：我是常务委员会成员。章乃器、李公朴、王造时和史良也是常务委员会成员，但邹韬奋是执行委员会成员。
问：刘留馨（音译）、任崇皋（音译）和罗青是否参加了该协会？
答：我不认识他们。
问：你以前认识罗青吗？
答：我记不太清了。我只是在接待室通过史良的介绍才见到他。起初我以为他是被派来监视我们的，直到经人介绍后，我才知道他就是罗青。
问：罗青是全国救国会的代表吗？
答：不是。
问：全国救国会执行委员会召开过几次会议？
答：在协会大会之后总共开过两次；其中一次是在马湘伯先生家中举行的，但我记不得日期了。
问：协会大会的宣言和一般政治原则是什么时候起草的？
答：它们是在大会上由指定负责此项工作的人员起草的。
问：大会宣言的目的是什么？
答：旨在向政府和人民阐明我们关于抗敌的建议。
问：一般政治原则的目的是什么？
答：旨在征求各党派的初步意见。
问：“联合各党派”是什么意思？
答：这并非指任何特定的政党。全国各地的各党派都希望携手抗日。
问：国民党包括在内吗？
答：国民党自然包括在内；事实上，它占据着领导地位。
问：这是否意味着由各党派联合组建政府？
答：从未有过此类说法，况且鉴于已有国民政府存在，并不需要组建这样的政府。
问：一般政治原则主张举行普选并召开国民大会。这是什么意思？
答：这是基于已故孙中山博士北上时关于召开国民大会的宣言。
问：一般政治原则主张在召开国民大会后，在全国建立统一的政治体制。这是什么意思？

pages.en:
3
June 12, 1937. Morning Translation.

A. This meant that national unification would strengthen
the government's power to resist Japan.
Q. Did the "allying with various Parties and cliques" mean
the toleration of Communism?
A. According to the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen's instructions,
the toleration of Communism is a good thing for the
consolidation of strength, but since the purge among
the communists this toleration has been condemned.
All the documents of the national salvation association
only advocate the cessation of civil wars, but have
never mentioned toleration of communism.
Q. Do you favour Communism?
A. The national salvation association did not speak of
principles. If there were any, they were simply those
of resistance to Japan and saving of the nation.
Q. National salvation and resistance against Japan is a
communistic slogan, is it not?
A. Communists eat rice and we also eat rice. Cannot we
resist Japan?
Q. Do you know that the communists on one hand advocate
resistance against Japan while on the other they suggest
revolution?
A. I do not know; this question must be put to the communists.
Q. Were there any communists in the national salvation
association?
A. We had no knowledge of this as we only paid attention
to the anti-Japanese question.
Q. When did you issue the booklet together with Tsang Nai-
chi, Tseu Tao-fun and Dao Ying-ts (陶行知)?
A. Probably in July.
Q. Can you remember the contents of the booklet?
A. The main object of this booklet was to call for
consolidation against insults.
Q. Why did you all issue the booklet?
A. The work for the salvation of the nation is extraordinarily
difficult and it is not easy for the public to understand
it. For this reason, we issued the booklet.
Q. Do you all object to the campaign of the Government to
suppress the communists?
A. We only opposed the Sino-Japanese co-operation against
the communists and we did not mention the subject
regarding the suppression of the communists. Nevertheless,
we paid close attention to the fact that the Government
had been engaged in the communist suppression campaign
for a period of ten years and that the people were in
much distress.
Q. What expression had the Communist Party made towards
the issue of offering resistance against Japan?
A. I learned from the newspapers that the communists desired
to pass through Shansi to resist Japan.
Q. Had you all any connection with the Communist Party?
A. We never had any connection with the Communist Party.
This may be verified by the letter from Mau Shih-tung
(毛泽东), stating that he had read our suggestions in
the newspapers.
pages.zh:
3
1937年6月12日。晨间译本。

答：这意味着国家统一将增强政府抗日的能力。
问：“联合各党派”是否意味着容共？
答：根据已故孙中山博士的指示，容共有利于巩固力量，但自从清党以来，这种宽容已受到谴责。救国会的所有文件只主张停止内战，从未提及容共。
问：你赞成共产主义吗？
答：救国会不谈主义。如果有，那也只是抗日救国的主义。
问：抗日救国是共产主义的口号，不是吗？
答：共产党人吃饭，我们也吃饭。难道我们就不能抗日吗？
问：你是否知道共产党人一方面主张抗日，另一方面又鼓吹革命？
答：我不知道；这个问题必须去问共产党人。
问：救国会里有共产党人吗？
答：我们对此不知情，因为我们只关注抗日问题。
问：你与章乃器、邹韬奋和陶行知（音译）一起发行小册子是什么时候？
答：大概在七月。
问：你还记得小册子的内容吗？
答：这本小册子的主要目的是呼吁团结以抵御侮辱。
问：你们为什么要发行这本小册子？
答：救国工作极其困难，公众不易理解。因此，我们发行了这本小册子。
问：你们是否反对政府镇压共产党的运动？
答：我们只反对中日合作反共，并未提及镇压共产党的问题。尽管如此，我们密切关注到政府从事剿共运动已达十年之久，且民众深受其苦。
问：共产党对抗日问题有何表态？
答：我从报纸上得知，共产党人希望借道山西去抗日。
问：你们与共产党有任何联系吗？
答：我们与共产党从未有任何联系。毛泽东（音译）的来信可证实这一点，他在信中表示是通过报纸读到我们的建议的。

pages.en:
4
June 12, 1937. Morning Translation

Q. When was the circular telegram addressed to Chang Hsueh-liang sent?
A. It was issued probably in November and this telegram was not addressed particularly to Chang Hsueh-liang alone. In the meantime, a circular telegram was issued addressed to the National Government, General Fu Tso-nyi, General Han Fu-chu, General Sung Cheh-yuen and other military leaders requesting them to assist Suiyuan.
Q. Was the National Salvation Association registered with the authorities?
A. The National Salvation Association was entirely open to the public and was unregistered.
Q. Did you know about the Sian Revolt?
A. I was in the detention house at that time and did not know of it.
Q. Did you read the resolutions passed by the Third Internationale?
A. I knew them after reading the prosecution against us.
Q. In which year was the 7th Conference of the Third Internationale held?
A. This should be referred to the Communist Party as I have no knowledge of this.
Q. Did you have any connection with the strikes in Shanghai?
A. I was not a worker and am ignorant. Please mention to which strike you refer.
Q. I refer to the strike declared on December 13, 1935 in the Japanese cotton mills.
A. I knew of the strike only after I read the newspapers.
Q. Was the Strike Support Committee formed by you all.
A. No. At the meeting in celebration of the birthday of the late Dr. Sun Yat-sen, the workers asked for support. A sum of some $400 was collected in subscriptions during the meeting.
Q. What is the difference between the People's Front and the National Salvation Joint Front?
A. We never used the expression: People's Front.
Q. Did you all secretly send Loo Tsing to form the Kiangsu National Salvation Association?
A. No.
Q. Have you any more to say?
A. I am very puzzled as to why the responsibility for the Sian Incident is foisted upon us. The Judge is requested to summon Chang Hsueh-liang to serve as a witness.

The lawyer defending Sung Chun-tz declared that no representatives from Sian attended the meetings of the All China National Salvation Association and that this will be seen from a perusal of the Intelligence Report for Averting of National Extinction (救亡情报) and also the minutes of these meetings.

Tsang Nai-chi's Statement

Tsang Nai-chi was next interrogated by the Judge as follows :-
Q. Did you know Loo Tsing?
A. He came to find me on the day before my arrest.
pages.zh:
4
1937年6月12日。晨间译本

问：发给张学良的通缉电报是什么时候发出的？
答：大概是在十一月发出的，而且这封电报并非专门只发给张学良一人。与此同时，还发出了一封通缉电报给国民政府、傅作义将军、韩复榘将军、宋哲元将军及其他军事领袖，请求他们援助绥远。
问：救国会是否在当局注册？
答：救国会完全公开，未予注册。
问：你知道西安事变吗？
答：当时我被关在拘留所里，对此事并不知情。
问：你读过第三国际通过的决议吗？
答：我是在阅读了对我们的起诉书后才知晓的。
问：第三国际第七次代表大会是哪一年召开的？
答：此事应询问共产党，因为我对此一无所知。
问：你与上海的罢工有关联吗？
答：我不是工人，对此无知。请说明你指的是哪次罢工。
问：我指的是1935年12月13日在日本棉纺厂宣布的罢工。
答：我是在看报纸后才知道这次罢工的。
问：罢工后援会是由你们成立的吗？
答：不是。在庆祝已故孙中山博士诞辰的会议上，工人们请求支持。会议期间募集了约400元的捐款。
问：“人民阵线”与“全国救国联合战线”有什么区别？
答：我们从未使用过“人民阵线”这一表述。
问：你们是否秘密派遣罗青去组建江苏救国会？
答：没有。
问：你还有要说的吗？
答：我很困惑，为何要将西安事变的责任强加于我们。恳请法官传唤张学良作为证人出庭。

宋庆龄（音译）的辩护律师声明，西安方面无人出席全国救国协会的会议，查阅《救亡情报》及这些会议的记录即可证实这一点。

章乃器的陈述

法官随后对章乃器进行了如下讯问：
问：你认识罗青吗？
答：他在我被捕的前一天来找过我。

pages.en:
5
June 12, 1937. Morning Translation.

Q: What did you give him?
A: I gave him the manifesto and general principles of the National Salvation Association and the booklet.
Q. Was it you who gave him the mimeographed letter of Mau Shih-tung and the open letter addressed to the Kuomintang by the Communist Party?
A. No.
Q. Did Lo Ching join the National Salvation Association?
A. No. He would have been welcome if he had desired to join.
Q. Was it you who sent him out to undertake national salvation work?
A. The work of the National Salvation Association was all carried out at one's own initiative. Never was anyone sent out to undertake such work.
(For other replies of the accused to questions asked by the Court, see the statement of Sung Chun-dz.)
The following points were then raised by the lawyers acting in the defence of this accused:-
(1) The manifesto issued by the Third Plenary Session; the resolution passed by this Session in connection with the suppression of the Red menace; the statement issued by General Chiang Kai-shek, President of the Executive Yuan, after the conclusion of this Session; and the manifesto issued by the National Crisis Conference held in April of the 21st Year (1932) of the Chinese Republic; the Court was requested to investigate as to whether or not all this is inconsistent with the proposals of the National Salvation Association.
(2) The second conference of the Executive Members of the National Salvation Association was held at the home of Mr. Ma Siang-pah. The Court was requested to enquire from Mr. Ma of the resolutions of this meeting.
(3) The Court was also requested to find out from the National Government and Generals Sung Cheh-yuan, Han Fu-chu and Fu Tso-nyi as to whether or not the telegrams they received from the National Salvation Association were identical to that addressed to General Chang Hsueh-liang.

Wong Zao-dz's Statement

The following questions were then put to accused Wong Zao-dz:-
Q. There appeared in the manifesto of the National Salvation Association an expression advocating the establishment of a political power for resistance against Japan. Does not this expression mean the overthrow of the present Government?
A. What I have studied is politics. I, therefore, only understand that "Government" is different from "Political Powers". What we have proposed is the strengthening of the political power of the Government; we did not demand a reorganization of the Government.
Q. Then do you agree to the system wherein the political power is monopolized in the hands of one "Party"?
A. So far as I am concerned, I have no objections, as I am one who favours the Constitution.
pages.zh:
5
1937年6月12日。晨间译本。

问：你给了他什么？
答：我给了他救国会的宣言、一般原则以及那本小册子。
问：是你把毛泽东（音译）的油印信件和共产党致国民党的公开信给他的吗？
答：不是。
问：罗青加入救国会了吗？
答：没有。如果他愿意加入，我们是欢迎的。
问：是你派他去开展救国工作的吗？
答：救国会的工作都是自愿进行的。从未派人出去开展此类工作。
（被告对法庭提问的其他回答，见宋庆龄（音译）的陈述。）
随后，为该被告辩护的律师提出了以下几点：
(1) 三中全会发布的宣言；该次会议通过的关于镇压赤祸的决议；行政院长蒋介石将军在该次会议结束后发表的声明；以及中华民国二十一年（1932年）四月召开的国难会议发布的宣言；请求法庭调查这些内容是否与救国会的提议相矛盾。
(2) 救国会执行委员的第二次会议是在马湘伯先生家中举行的。请求法庭向马先生查询该次会议的决议。
(3) 还请求法庭向国民政府以及宋哲元、韩复榘和傅作义将军查证，他们从救国会收到的电报是否与发给张学良将军的电报相同。

王造时的陈述

随后向被告王造时提出了以下问题：
问：救国会的宣言中出现了一种主张建立抗日政权的表述。这种表述是否意味着推翻现政府？
答：我研究的是政治学。因此，我只明白“政府”与“政权”是不同的。我们提出的是加强政府的政权；我们并未要求改组政府。
问：那么你同意由一个“党”垄断政权的制度吗？
答：就我个人而言，我没有异议，因为我是拥护宪法的。

pages.en:
June 12, 1937.
6
Morning Translation.

Li Kung-poh's Statement

The 4th accused brought forward for interrogation was Li Kung-poh. The questions put to him were generally the same as those to the previous accused. Briefly, his statement is as follows: "The All-China National Salvation Association was inaugurated at the end of May or thereabouts last year. At that time I was not in Shanghai, so I did not participate in the inauguration of the Association. The manifesto and the 'General Principles on Politics' issued by the Association were known to me only after the inauguration meeting of the Association. The object of the manifesto and the General Principles is to bring about the concentration of the united efforts of the people throughout the country for resistance against Japan under the guidance of the Central Government. The term 'Political Power' refers to the 'strength of the political administration of the Government.' So far as the National Salvation Association is concerned, it has no political ambition whatever. Its efforts were to work for the unification of all Parties and cliques with the Government. I am entirely ignorant of the circumstances of the Sian Incident. It is true that a telegram was sent to General Chang Hsueh-liang, but it advocated resistance against Japan. Moreover, telegrams were addressed to various military leaders of this country, requesting them to pledge their unanimous support in the defence of Suiyuan Province."

Here the lawyers acting in the defence of this accused pointed out that the circumstances of the strike of the workers of the Japanese cotton mills in Shanghai were known to the authorities. The Court was requested to investigate as to whether or not this strike had had any affiliations with the National Salvation Association.

Tseu Tao-fun's Statement

The following questions were put to accused Tseu Tao-fun:-
Q. Did you take part in the inauguration meeting of the All-China National Salvation Association?
A. As I was then in Hongkong, I did not participate in the meeting. It was only after I had been notified after my return to Shanghai in July that I knew that I had been elected as a member of the Executive Committee of the Association.
Q. Do you agree with the contents of the manifesto issued by the Association?
A. Yes, I do.
Q. There appeared in the booklet expressions about "a meeting for aversion of national extinction". What does this mean?
A. It means to bring about the concentration of all the talents of the country to deal with Japan.
Q. What is the difference between "The People's Front" and "The National Salvation Front"?
A. The object of the "People's Front" is to oppose Fascism, while that of "The National Salvation Front" is not; it advocates united resistance against Japan, the recovery of the Four North-Eastern Provinces and the restoration of our sovereign rights in North China.
pages.zh:
1937年6月12日。
6
晨间译件。

李公朴的供词

被提审的第四名被告是李公朴。向他提出的问题大致与前几名被告相同。简而言之，他的供词如下：“全国救国会于去年五月底左右成立。当时我不在上海，因此未参与该会的成立大会。我是通过该会成立会议后才知晓该会发布的宣言及《政治大纲》。宣言和《政治大纲》的宗旨是在中央政府的指导下，促成全国人民集中 united efforts（联合力量）以抗日。‘政权’一词指的是‘政府行政之力量’。就救国会而言，它没有任何政治野心。其努力方向是促使各党派及派系与政府实现统一。我对西安事变的情况完全不知情。确实曾向张学良将军发送过电报，但该电报主张抗日。此外，还向本国各位军事领袖发出电报，请求他们承诺一致支持保卫绥远省。”

在此，代表该被告辩护的律师指出，当局已知晓上海日本棉厂工人罢工的情况。请求法庭调查此次罢工是否与救国会有任何关联。

邹韬奋的供词

向被告邹韬奋提出了以下问题：-
问：你是否参加了全国救国会的成立大会？
答：当时我在香港，故未参加会议。直到七月我回到上海后接到通知，才得知自己当选为该会执行委员。
问：你是否同意该会发布的宣言内容？
答：是的，我同意。
问：小册子中出现了关于“防亡会议”的表述。这是什么意思？
答：意思是集中全国人才以对付日本。
问：“人民阵线”与“救国阵线”有何区别？
答：“人民阵线”的目标是反对法西斯主义，而“救国阵线”则不然；它主张联合抗日、收复东北四省以及恢复我们在华北的主权。

pages.en:
7
June 12, 1937. Morning Translation

Here the lawyers acting in the defence of this accused pointed out that the proposals and views of the accused could be obtained from all his writings. The Court was requested to investigate as to whether or not his proposals are irreconcilable with the Three Principles of the People.

Next interrogated was Sz Liang who made the following statement :-
"I was one of the Standing Committee members of the All-China National Salvation Association as well as of the Women's National Salvation Association. The motive in issuing a manifesto and drafting a set of general principles on politics by the Association was to effect the concentration of the strength of the people throughout the country and to unite together all people, irrespective of sex or class. The proposal that all parties and cliques which are different in views should unite together was not aimed at seizing the political power of the National Government because we had absolutely no idea of re-organizing the Government. We do not mean that the Constitution set up by the Government is useless, because at this time when a national crisis confronts the country, the salvation of the nation is the most important task before our people; the question of the Constitution should be left over for consideration. Furthermore, the aim of our Association is to save the nation. We have never talked about the People's Front. The characters 'national salvation front' mean that all Chinese people should stand on the same front to save the nation."

Soo Chi-li who was then interrogated made the following statement :-
"The main object in proposing the unity of all parties and cliques is to effect resistance against Japan. All people who belong to the Chinese race should therefore unite together. As regards the question of the Constitution, we have only made comments upon it, and as a rule, people are allowed to make comments over their dissatisfaction. It does not necessarily follow that we have protested against the Constitution. We have never talked about communism because at this time when we have no time to lose in the task for the salvation of the nation, it is impossible for us to make a study of communism. The Sian Revolt came to our knowledge only at the time of our interrogation by the Procurator."

Finally, Loo Tsing was interrogated, and he made the following statement :-
"The formation of the Kiangsu National Salvation Association was on my own initiative, not on the instructions of Tsang Nai-chi. At this time when the fate of the nation is at stake, all Chinese people, if not traitors, should rise and unite together to take up the work of salvation of the nation and resistance against Japan."

The other accused such as Koo Liu-ching and Ning Zoong-kao stated that they had no connection with the Association.
pages.zh:
7
1937年6月12日。晨间译件

在此，代表该被告辩护的律师指出，可以从该被告的所有著作中获取其主张和观点。请求法庭调查其主张是否与三民主义相抵触。

接下来受审的是史良，她作了如下陈述：-
“我是全国救国会常务委员之一，也是妇女救国会的成员。该会发布宣言并起草一套政治大纲的动机，是为了集中全国人民的力量，团结所有民众，不分性别或阶级。提议不同观点的各党派及派系联合起来，并非旨在夺取国民政府的政治权力，因为我们绝对没有重组政府的想法。我们并不意味着政府制定的宪法无用，因为在国家面临民族危机的时刻，拯救国家是我国人民面前的首要任务；宪法问题应留待日后考虑。此外，我们会宗旨是救国。我们从未谈论过人民阵线。‘救国阵线’这几个字的意思是所有中国人应站在同一阵线上以拯救国家。”

随后受审的沙千里作了如下陈述：-
“提议各党派及派系统一的主要目的是为了实现抗日。所有属于中华民族的人都应当团结起来。关于宪法问题，我们仅对其进行了评论，而且通常人们被允许对不满之处发表评论。这并不必然意味着我们抗议宪法。我们从未谈论过共产主义，因为在这个分秒必争以完成救国任务的时刻，我们不可能去研究共产主义。我们直到接受检察官审讯时才知晓西安事变。”

最后受审的是王造时，他作了如下陈述：-
“江苏救国会的成立是我主动发起的，并非章乃器的指示。在这个国家命运攸关的时刻，所有中国人，若非汉奸，都应奋起团结，投身于救国和抗日的工作。”

其他被告如郭柳敬（音译）和宁宗高（音译）声称他们与该会没有关系。

pages.en:
June 12, 1937.
Morning Translation.

Sung Chun-dz was in fine spirits, while Tseu
Tao-fun made the following remarks to certain persons
before the hearing took place :-
"I will not obstruct the national salvation
movement. I will not do anything against my conscience."

While being interrogated, Li Kung-poh combed
his beard with a small comb and appeared very pleased with
himself.

At this juncture, 7 p.m., the Court announced
that Sung Chun-dz and the other accused would be returned
to detention, Koo Liu-ching and Ning Zoong-kao would be
bailed out on their original securities and the case would
be further heard on the afternoon of June 12.

China Times and other local newspapers :-

SUPPRESSION OF TWO SETTLEMENT HOSPITALS DESIRED

In view of the fact that the Dah Chuen (大川)
Hospital, Canton Road, and the Chung Ih (中一) Hospital,
corner of Chekiang and Canton Roads, are still operating
under the management of non-registered doctors, the
authorized doctors who established these hospitals having
died some time ago, the Bureau of Public Health of
the Shanghai City Government has withdrawn the licences
issued to these hospitals and has requested the Public
Health Department of the Shanghai Municipal Council
to assist in the suppression of these establishments
in the interests of the community.

1937年6月12日。
晨间译件。

沈钧儒精神饱满，而邹韬奋在开庭前对某些人发表了如下言论：
“我不会阻碍救国运动。我不会做任何违背良心的事。”

在接受审讯时，李公朴用小梳子梳理胡须，显得非常自得。

此时，下午7点，法庭宣布沈钧儒及其他被告将被还押拘留，郭柳敬（音译）和宁宗高（音译）将按原保释金保释外出，案件将于6月12日下午继续审理。

《中国时报》及其他本地报纸：

拟取缔两家租界医院

鉴于广东路的大川医院以及浙江路与广东路转角的中一医院仍在未注册医生的管理下运营，而创办这些医院的持证医生已于不久前去世，上海市政府卫生局已撤销发给这些医院的执照，并请求上海公共租界工部局卫生处出于社区利益协助取缔这些机构。

pages.en:
May 13, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Hwa Mei Chao Pao and other local newspapers :-

SILK WEAVERS' STRIKE SITUATION IMPROVED

It is learned that the measures drawn up by the Bureau of Social Affairs for the arbitration of the demands of the silk weavers for better treatment have now been agreed to by the local Silk Weaving Factories' Owners' Association. The Association has, however, requested the local Party and Government authorities to mete out severe punishment upon the agitators of the strike and the leading elements who have caused damage to the factories during the strike. In view of this, the strike situation of the local silk weaving factories is gradually on its way to normalcy.

The Diamond (金钢鑽) :-

MR. PAN KUNG-CHAN ON NATIONAL SALVATION

In the course of an interview granted several days ago to the representatives of the National Salvation Association of Various Circles of Shanghai, Mr. Pan Kung-chan, Commissioner of the Bureau of Social Affairs, expressed his views on national salvation and emancipation of the Chinese nation.

He emphasized how the Kuomintang Party had worked for the salvation of the nation and explained his friendly relations with Messrs. Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒), Tsang Nai-chi (章乃器), Li Kung-poh (李公), Tseu Tao-fun (韜奮), Wong Zao-dz (王造時) and Soo Chi-lee (沙千里) and Miss Sz Liang (史良). He stated that during 1919 he had worked together with these persons and that Messrs. Sung Chun-dz, Tsang Nai-chi and others were then his superiors. He continued that the reason why their present activities for national salvation, though they are similar in objective, are criticized by the public, is because they are conducted in an improper manner. He further stated that as Shanghai is an important port wherein both foreign and Chinese nationals reside, whatever activities take place locally should be in accordance with the instructions of the National Government. In conclusion, he expressed the hope that all the local population would abide by the instructions of the Government.

Hwa Mei Chao Pao publishes the following poem written by one Ho Po-zung (何朴人):

"BROTHERS"

Brothers, are you going?
Stand erect and lift your hands;
March forward with firm steps.
It is your duty to maintain the territorial rights of this country
And to resist the enemy as well as to avenge our national humiliation!

1937年5月13日。
午后译件。

《华美晨报》及其他本地报纸：

丝织工人罢工局势好转

据悉，社会局为仲裁丝织工人改善待遇要求而制定的措施，现已得到本地丝织厂业主协会的同意。然而，该协会请求当地党政当局严厉惩处罢工煽动者以及在罢工期间造成工厂损坏的首要分子。有鉴于此，本地丝织厂的罢工局势正逐渐恢复正常。

《金刚钻》报：

潘公展先生谈救国

社会局局长潘公展先生在日前接见上海各界救国会代表时，表达了他对救国及中华民族解放的看法。

他强调了国民党如何致力于救国，并解释了他与沈钧儒、章乃器、李公朴、邹韬奋、王造时、沙千里诸先生及史良女士的友好关系。他表示，1919年期间他曾与这些人共事，当时沈钧儒、章乃器等先生是他的上级。他接着说，他们目前的救国活动虽然目标相似，却受到公众批评，原因是开展方式不当。他进一步表示，由于上海是中外侨民居住的重要港口，当地发生的任何活动都应符合国民政府的指令。最后，他希望当地居民都能遵守政府的指令。

《华美晨报》刊登了一首由何朴人所作的诗：

“兄弟”

兄弟们，你们要走吗？
挺直身躯，举起双手；
迈着坚定的步伐前进。
维护本国领土权利是你们的职责
既要抵抗敌人，也要雪洗国耻！

April 30, 1937.
4
Morning Translation.

Central China Daily News and other local newspapers (Nanking Telegram) :-

ATTEMPT ON LIFE OF GENERAL LIU TU-CHIEN AT NANYANG

According to a telephone message received from Kaifeng by the Ministry of War, General Liu Tu-chien (刘多荃), Commander of the 49th Route Army, was shot and wounded by an unknown person at Nanyang at about 6 a.m. April 28. During the melee, his wife was also wounded by a stray bullet, while the assailant was shot dead on the spot. Enquiries are at present being conducted into the cause of this attempted murder.

Owing to lack of properly equipped hospitals at Nanyang, it is understood that General Liu is proposing to come to Shanghai for medical treatment and has ordered an aeroplane from the Eurasia Aviation Corporation for this purpose.

According to information secured from local circles, General Liu was attacked and wounded at about 9 a.m. April 28 by a subordinate officer named Wang Chao-sui (王兆苏), Captain of the Special Affairs Squad, whilst he was inspecting his troops of the First Division. His wife was struck by a stray bullet when she attempted to rescue her husband.

General and Madame Liu arrived at the Lunghwa Aerodrome at 6.10 p.m. yesterday by an aeroplane of the Eurasia Aviation Corporation and were extended a welcome by General Yang Hu, Woosung-Shanghai Defence Commissioner, and Mr. Tu Yueh-sung. The couple are at present undergoing operations at the Orthopedic Hospital, Route de Zikawei, at the hands of Dr. W.S. Niu.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

TRIAL OF SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS POSTPONED

According to information secured from local circles, the case against Sung Chun-dz (孙钧儒) and six others, who had been formally prosecuted by the Procuratorate of the Kiangsu High Court on a charge of endangering the security of the Republic of China, was first scheduled for hearing at Soochow to-day, but it is now learned that it will be postponed to some future date. It is also learned that this postponement was due to the fact that all the parties concerned are of the opinion that though the activities of these accused were improper, they did not, however, know that they were offences; moreover, many well known people have sent telegrams requesting the release of the prisoners. For this reason, the case will probably be dealt with on the basis of law but from a humanitarian point of view.

It is also learned that all the accused have engaged lawyers for defence and have submitted their pleas to the Court.

1937年4月30日。
4
晨间译件。

《华中日报》及其他本地报纸（南京电通社）：

刘多荃将军在南阳遇刺

据国防部收到来自开封的电话消息，第49路军司令刘多荃将军于4月28日上午6点左右在南阳被一名身份不明者枪击受伤。在混战中，其妻子也被流弹击中，而袭击者当场被击毙。目前正对此谋杀未遂案的原因进行调查。

由于南阳缺乏设备完善的医院，据悉刘将军计划来上海接受治疗，并已为此向欧亚航空公司订购了一架飞机。

据从本地渠道获得的消息，刘将军于4月28日上午9点左右在视察第一师部队时，遭到特务队队长王兆苏下属军官的攻击并受伤。其妻子在试图营救丈夫时被流弹击中。

刘将军夫妇昨日傍晚6点10分乘坐欧亚航空公司的飞机抵达龙华机场，受到淞沪警备司令杨虎将军和杜月笙先生的欢迎。夫妇二人目前正在霞飞路骨科医院接受牛惠生医生（Dr. W.S. Niu）的手术治疗。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

沈钧儒等人审判延期

据从本地渠道获得的消息，江苏高等法院检察处以危害中华民国安全罪正式起诉沈钧儒（原文误作孙钧儒）等七人的案件，原定于今日在苏州开庭审理，但现获悉将推迟至日后某日。另悉，延期原因是各方认为，尽管这些被告的行为不当，但他们并不知道这是犯罪行为；此外，许多知名人士已发电报请求释放囚犯。基于此原因，该案可能会在法律基础上，但从人道主义角度进行处理。

又悉，所有被告均已聘请律师进行辩护，并向法庭提交了答辩状。

pages.en:
Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers:

ACCUSED IN NATIONAL SALVATION CASE ENGAGE LAWYERS

In connection with the case against Sung
Chun-dz (沈儒) and others, the report published by local
newspapers to the effect that the Kiangsu High Court at
Soochow will hear the case on April 28 and 29 is untrue.
It is understood that Sung Chun-dz and the
other accused have engaged lawyers Chang Yoh-tseng (張耀曾),
Kiang Yung (江庸), Waung Yeu-ling (汪有齡), Loh Hoong-

Zing Lien-kwei (秦聯奎), Cheng Ts-niang (鄭毓秀) and
Chweng Hsiang (莊翔) to attend the forthcoming
hearing for their defence.

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：

救国会案被告聘请律师

关于沈儒（Sung Chun-dz，即沈钧儒）等人一案，本地报纸报道所称江苏高等法院将于4月28日和29日在苏州审理此案，实属不实。据悉，沈儒及其他被告已聘请张耀曾、江庸、汪有龄、罗鸿仪、Eugene Y.B. Kiang（音译）、陈霆锐、秦联奎、郑毓秀和庄翔等律师，出席即将举行的庭审为其辩护。

April 19, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers (Soochow letter) :-

CASE OF SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS TO BE HEARD ON APRIL 28
AND 29.

The Kiangsu High Court at Soochow will hear
the case against Sung Chun-dz (沈钧儒), Li Kung-poh (章乃器),
Wong Zao-dz (王造时), Tseng Nai-chi (沙千里), Tseu Tao-fun
(邹韬奋), Soo Chi-lee (史良) and Sz Liang (李公朴), all
of whom were arrested on November 23, 1936 in Shanghai,
on April 28 and 29.
On the morning of April 27, General Li Lieh-
chun, member of the Central Executive Committee of the
Kuomintang, paid a visit of consolation to the accused at
their detention houses.

Eastern Daily News (东方日报) :-

Reported Special Amnesty for the Seven Accused

It is reported that the National Government
will grant the seven accused a special amnesty if they
agree not to continue to impair the peace and order of
the community in future. Although no confirmation can
be obtained, it is believed that there is some truth in
the report.

Eastern Daily News :-

"RECORD OF NATIONAL CRISIS"

The authorities of a certain nation recently
published a report in the newspapers accusing the booklet
entitled "Record of National Crisis" (救亡论) published
by the China Cultural Society (中国文化协会) of having
committed lese majesty to the Japanese Emperor. As a
matter of fact, the China Cultural Society did not publish
this booklet nor is there any person named Dong Tseng-hwa
(董振华) working with the society.
According to our knowledge, the booklet
"Record of National Crisis" was published in May last year
and it was sold at 8 cents a copy. It contains only common
childish songs.

Shanghai Pao (上海报) of April 18 :-

CHOW UNG-LAI IN SIAN. INACTIVE

The communist leader Chow Ung-lai (周恩来)
has left the bandit district. It is reported that he now
resides in Sian and will give up his red activities. His
movements are not kept so secret as before.
The report released by the authorities of a
certain nation that Chow Ung-lai will come to Shanghai to
interview certain high Government officials is untrue.

1937年4月19日。下午译文。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸（苏州来信）：

沈钧儒等人案将于4月28日和29日审理。

江苏高等法院将于4月28日和29日审理沈钧儒、章乃器、王造时、沙千里、邹韬奋、史良和李公朴一案，上述七人于1936年11月23日在上海被捕。
4月27日上午，国民党中央执行委员李烈钧将军前往拘留所慰问被告。

《东方日报》：

报道称七名被告将获得特赦

据报道，如果七名被告同意今后不再损害社会安宁与秩序，国民政府将给予他们特赦。虽然无法获得证实，但相信该报道有一定真实性。

《东方日报》：

“救亡论”

某国当局近日在报纸上发表报告，指责中国文化协会出版的小册子《救亡论》犯有对日本天皇大不敬之罪。事实上，中国文化协会并未出版此小册子，该协会中也无名为董振华（Dong Tseng-hwa）的人员任职。
据我们所知，《救亡论》小册子于去年五月出版，每本售价八分。其中仅收录普通的儿童歌曲。

4月18日《上海报》：

周恩来在西安。停止活动

共产党领导人周恩来已离开匪区。据报道，他现居西安，并将放弃其红色活动。他的行踪不再像以前那样保密。
某国当局发布的关于周恩来将赴上海采访某些政府高官的报道不实。

Ambassador who has returned from the conference is
now conferring with Foreign Minister Wang Chung Hui
on the subject of Soviet economic activities in North
China. Soviet Russia has changed her policy towards
China since the Sian incident and is attempting to
make closer economic connection with China in order to
strengthen China's front against Japan. It is note-
worthy that Lung Wen Yi, one of General Chiang Kai
Shek's right hand men, is attending the conference
between Foreign Minister Wang Chung Hui and Soviet
Ambassador and Mongolian affairs are reported to have
been discussed. China is attempting to drive away
Japanese influence from the North by co-operating
with Soviet Russia and this will bring unhappy results.
Japan is now endeavouring to
improve her relations with China by securing economic
co-operation in North China. It is difficult to
say what will happen if China supports Soviet Russia's
economic activities in the North. Japan's policy
towards North China is to maintain peace in Manchukuo
and the North by suppressing communist activities
there and she has proposed to China to co-operate in
this respect. For this reason, China's support of
Soviet Russia's economic activities in the North will
turn the north into a political arena thereby involving
her in trouble.
The Nanking Government's present
policy of playing one Power against the other does
not agree with the pan-Asiatic policy of the late
Dr. Sun Yat-sen and it has already been proved that
China has secured no benefit from it.
It is of no use for us to
discuss the rights or wrongs of Japan's policy towards
North China as it will not be changed as a result of
re-organization of cabinet or re-appointment of
ministers. We maintain again that Japan's policy
towards North China will never be changed by the
petty activities of any Power in the North.

and is conducting negotiations with the communist

1937年4月8日。

-2-

刚从会议返回的大使正就苏联在华北的经济活动问题与外交部长王宠惠进行磋商。自西安事变以来，苏俄改变了对华政策，试图与中国建立更紧密的经济联系，以加强中国对抗日本的前线。值得注意的是，蒋介石将军的得力助手之一翁文灏出席了外交部长王宠惠与苏联大使之间的会议，据报道会议讨论了蒙古事务。中国正试图通过与苏俄合作来驱逐日本在北方的影响，这将带来不良后果。
日本目前正努力通过在华北取得经济合作来改善对华关系。如果中国支持苏俄在北方的经济活动，很难说会发生什么情况。日本对华北的政策是通过镇压那里的共产主义活动来维持满洲国和华北的和平，并就此向中国提出合作建议。因此，中国支持苏俄在华北的经济活动将使北方变成政治竞技场，从而使中国卷入麻烦之中。
南京政府目前这种以夷制夷的政策不符合已故孙中山博士的泛亚主义政策，且已证明中国从中未获任何利益。
讨论日本对华北政策的对错毫无用处，因为内阁改组或部长重新任命不会改变这一政策。我们再次重申，任何势力在北方的微小活动都不会改变日本对华北的政策。

《每日新闻》

对人民阵线领导人的指控

《每日新闻》发表以下社论：
4月3日，被捕的人民阵线运动七名领导人被移送高等法院受审。4月7日，所有中文报纸刊登了针对这七名囚犯的起诉书全文及理由。提出的指控理由之一是，囚犯声称政府的反共政策是错误的，但目前所有中文出版物都公开谴责该政策。事实上，国民政府军事委员会委员长已停止反共军事行动，并与共产党匪徒进行谈判。在起诉书中指出

communist party. General Chiang Kai Shek then
abolished the field headquarters of the anti-communist
campaign and asked a pardon for Chang Hsueh-liang who
is known to advocate co-operation with communists.
Generals Yu Hsueh-chung and Yang Hu Chen who were
equally responsible for the Sian incident were not
punished but came to Nanking and Shanghai to attend
government conferences. There is no reason whatever
for punishing the leaders of the popular front movement.
The idea of committing the
leaders of the popular front movement for trial, is,
it is believed, to release them.
The Ta Kung Pao has
published a leading article regarding the indictment of
Sung Chun-dz and other prisoners and advocating that
the accused should be freed for the reason that political
situation in China has greatly changed and the law
governing the punishment of persons who commit acts
with intent to injure the Republic of China does not
fit the present situation.
The formal prosecution was
simply framed against the prisoners so that they could
be released without causing suspicion that they were
released as a result of the settlement of the Sian
incident. Marshal Chang Hsueh-liang's case was
settled in a similar manner.
pages.zh:
1937年4月8日。
-3-
囚犯与共产党人有联系，因为共产党领导人毛泽东致信给他们，支持他们的观点，但蒋介石将军也在西安和奉化与共产党代表周恩来进行了谈判。根据最近收到的消息，当政府官员在杭州举行会议时，周恩来就在杭州。如果与共产党人有联系的人要受到惩罚，那么蒋介石将军本人也应受到惩罚。
1936年11月，囚犯是根据政府采取的政策被捕的。蒋介石将军发布指令镇压人民阵线运动，并在指示参与西北反共作战的部队在三个月内消灭共产党人之后前往西安。从西安脱身后，蒋介石将军成为了一位民族英雄，他试图利用共产党来维持内部和平并对抗外敌。随后，蒋介石将军取消了反共战役的前线总部，并为已知主张与共产党合作的张学良请求赦免。对西安事变负有同等责任的于学忠和杨虎城将军未受惩罚，而是来到南京和上海参加政府会议。没有任何理由惩罚人民阵线运动的领导人。
据信，将人民阵线运动领导人移送受审的想法，是为了释放他们。
《大公报》就沈钧儒及其他囚犯被起诉一事发表社论，主张应释放被告，理由是中国的政治局势已发生巨大变化，管辖惩处意图危害中华民国行为的法律已不适合当前局势。
正式起诉仅仅是为了构建针对囚犯的法律程序，以便在不引起人们怀疑他们是因西安事变解决而被释放的情况下释放他们。张学良元帅的案件也是以类似方式解决的。

pages.en:
April 6, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE CASE OF SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS

The High Court at Soochow has filed a charge against Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒), Tsang Nai-chi (章乃器), Li Kung-poh (李公樸), Tseu Tao-fun (鄒韜奮), Sz Liang (史良), Wong Zao-dz (王造時), Soo Chi-li (沙千里) and seven others for intending to injure the Republic of China. The families of the first seven persons have arranged to retain lawyers for their defence when the case comes up for hearing.

Our reporter made enquiries from various sources on April 5 and learned that the families of Sung Chun-dz and others have already invited Mr. Chang Tse-niang (張志讓) and other lawyers to defend them.

In view of the importance of the case, the families of the accused will request lawyer Chang Tse-niang and another lawyer named Li (李) to proceed to Soochow in a few days to interview the accused, after which the lawyers will discuss the drafting of their defence.

Ta Kung Pao (Editorial) :-

Sung Chun-dz and six others have been charged for injuring the Republic of China.

The national crisis reached its climax last year and the people were excited. As the Government could not make public all the steps taken in dealing with the situation, many people were dissatisfied. Following the victory in Suiyuan and the Sian Incident, the attitude of the Government became known among the people who then began to trust the work of consolidation of the Government instead of suspecting it as before.

Prior to the latter part of last year, the youths in the country usually welcomed anti-Government and anti-Kuomintang comments. However, they have now changed their attitude by favouring a strong unification of the country. Members of the so-called National Salvation Federation favoured quick action to deal with external affairs and really their policy was erroneous in many ways. As a matter of fact, their background was formed by the radical ideas of the people. Although we cannot surmise what changes have taken place in people's minds during the past six months, yet at least the minds of those who were formerly in sympathy with the National Salvation Federation have undergone certain changes through the Suiyuan fighting and the Sian Incident.

We are of the opinion that if the authorities insist on charges against them for their past action, it might cause uneasiness among the people, especially at the present time when the Government is working for the consolidation of the minds of the people. We hope that the Judges concerned will pay attention to this point.
pages.zh:
1937年4月6日。
下午译文。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸：

沈钧儒等人案

苏州高等法院已对沈钧儒、章乃器、李公朴、邹韬奋、史良、王造时、沙千里及其他七人提起诉讼，指控其意图危害中华民国。前七人的家属已安排在该案开庭审理时聘请律师为其辩护。

本报记者于4月5日向各方查询获悉，沈钧儒等人的家属已邀请张志让先生及其他律师为他们辩护。

鉴于该案的重要性，被告家属将请求张志让律师和另一位姓李的律师在数日内前往苏州会见被告，随后律师们将商讨起草辩护词事宜。

《大公报》（社论）：

沈钧儒等六人被控危害中华民国。

去年民族危机达到顶峰，民众情绪激动。由于政府无法公开处理局势的所有步骤，许多人感到不满。继绥远胜利和西安事变之后，政府的态度为民众所知，民众开始信任政府的巩固工作，而不像以前那样怀疑它。

在去年下半年之前，全国青年通常欢迎反政府和反国民党的言论。然而，他们现在改变了态度，倾向于国家的强力统一。所谓全国救国联合会的成员主张迅速采取行动处理对外事务，实际上他们的政策在许多方面都是错误的。事实上，他们的背景是由民众的激进思想形成的。虽然我们无法推测过去六个月中民众思想发生了哪些变化，但至少那些以前同情全国救国联合会的人的思想，通过绥远战事和西安事变发生了一定的变化。

我们认为，如果当局坚持因他们过去的行为而对其提出指控，可能会引起民众的不安，特别是在政府正致力于巩固民心的当下。我们希望有关法官能注意到这一点。

pages.en:
April 5, 1937.    Morning Translation.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers :-

SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS CHARGED WITH ENDANGERING THE
INTERNAL SECURITY OF THE REPUBLIC OF CHINA

    In November 1936, Sung Chun-dz (沈儒), Tsang
Nai-chi (章乃器), Li Kung-poh (李公樸), Tseu Tao-fun
(鄒韜奮), Sz Liang (史良), Wong Zao-dz (王造時) and
Sco Chi-li (沙千里) were arrested in Shanghai and were
later removed to Soochow for investigation.    Four months
have now elapsed and according to law, the period of
investigation cannot be extended.    On the evening of
April 3, the Soochow High Court filed a formal charge
against them.
    On April 3, members of the families of the seven
accused all went to Soochow to secure information.    They
returned from Soochow on April 4 in disappointment for the
seven persons together with seven other persons named Dao
Ying-ts (陶行知), Loo Tsing (羅青), Koo Lieu-shing (顧留馨),
Zung Zoong-kao (任仲言), Chang Zoong-me (張仲勉), Chen
Dao-hung (陳道宏) and Chen Tso (陳卓) are being charged
with offences against the internal security of the State.
    It is said that the reason the Soochow High
Court has charged the latter seven persons is as follows:-
    Dao Ying-ts is an educationalist and he has
never been summoned by the High Court at Soochow in connection
with the case.    He is now teaching in America.    An order
for his arrest has been issued.
    Loo Tsing, who was formerly a secretary with
the Tseng-Tai Railway Administration, was arrested one
year ago.    He is still being detained at Soochow.
    Koo Lieu-shing, Zung Zoong-kao, Chang Zoong-me,
Chen Dao-hung and Chen Tso are members of the National
Salvation Federation of Various Public Bodies in Shanghai.
In January, they, in company with 16 others, proceeded to
Soochow and requested the High Court to release Sung Chun-
dz and six others.    In February they received summonses
instructing them to appear at the Court.    Koo and Zung
appeared at the Court on February 3 and were detained until
the 10th when they were bailed out.
    The names of the latter seven persons are also
included in the charge filed by the Soochow High Court.
Furthermore, the Court has issued orders for their arrest.
    The charge is very lengthy and contains the
following points: "The accused, with intent to injure the
Republic of China, have formed organizations which propagate
doctrines against the Three Principles of the People.    In
accordance with Article 11 and 28 of the Criminal Code,
they have committed crimes mentioned in Article 6 of the
Law Governing the Punishment of Persons Who Commit Acts
with Intent to Injure the Republic of China.    In addition
to issuing orders for the arrest of Dao Ying-ts, Chang
Zoong-me, Chen Dao-hung and Chen Tso whose whereabouts
are not known, this Court is now charging all of them under
Articles 230 and 243 of the Code of Criminal Procedure".
    Article 6 of the Law Governing the Punishment of
Persons Who Commit Acts with Intent to Injure the Republic
of China states: "Whosoever with intent to injure the
Republic of China organizes associations, holds meetings,
or propagates a doctrine irreconcilable with the Three principles
of the People shall be punished with imprisonment
for not less than five years, and not more than fifteen
years".    The families of the accused are prepared to retain
three lawyers each for the defence.    The Soochow Bar
Association has appointed five lawyers to defend the accused.
    It is learned that the Soochow High Court will
hear the case sometime this week.
pages.zh:
1937年4月5日。上午译文。

《立报》及其他本地报纸：-

沈钧儒等人被控危害中华民国内部安全

    1936年11月，沈钧儒（Sung Chun-dz）、章乃器（Tsang Nai-chi）、李公樸（Li Kung-poh）、鄒韜奮（Tseu Tao-fun）、史良（Sz Liang）、王造時（Wong Zao-dz）和沙千里（Sco Chi-li）在上海被捕，随后被移送苏州受审。四个月现已过去，根据法律，调查期限不得延长。4月3日晚，江苏高等法院正式对他们提起公诉。
    4月3日，七名被告的家属均前往苏州探听消息。他们于4月4日失望地从苏州返回，因为除上述七人外，另有陶行知（Dao Ying-ts）、羅青（Loo Tsing）、顧留馨（Koo Lieu-shing）、任仲言（Zung Zoong-kao）、張仲勉（Chang Zoong-me）、陳道宏（Chen Dao-hung）和陳卓（Chen Tso）等七人也被指控犯有危害国家内部安全罪。
    据称，江苏高等法院起诉后七人的理由如下：-
    陶行知是一位教育家，此前从未因本案被江苏高等法院传唤。他目前在美国任教。已对其发出逮捕令。
    羅青曾任津浦铁路管理局秘书，于一年前被捕。目前仍被拘押在苏州。
    顧留馨、任仲言、張仲勉、陳道宏和陳卓均为上海各界救国联合会成员。今年一月，他们与其他16人一同前往苏州，请求高等法院释放沈钧儒等六人。二月，他们收到传票，要求出庭。顧留馨和任仲言于2月3日出庭，被拘留至10日获保释。
    后七人的名字也被列入江苏高等法院提起的公诉书中。此外，法院已对他们发出逮捕令。
    起诉书篇幅很长，包含以下要点：“被告意图危害中华民国，组织传播违背三民主义学说的团体。根据刑法第11条和第28条，他们犯了《危害民国紧急治罪法》第六条所述之罪。除了对行踪不明的陶行知、張仲勉、陳道宏和陳卓发出逮捕令外，本庭现依据刑事诉讼法第230条和第243条对所有这些人提起公诉”。
    《危害民国紧急治罪法》第六条规定：“凡意图危害中华民国而组织团体、集会或宣传与三民主义不相容之学说者，处五年以上十五年以下有期徒刑”。被告家属准备各聘请三名律师进行辩护。苏州律师公会已指派五名律师为被告辩护。
    据悉，江苏高等法院将于本周内开庭审理此案。

Inquiries made regarding the antecedents of the prisoner
revealed that he was the same person who has been
visiting a number of Japanese homes begging for money
or obtaining it by means of false pretences. It has
also been ascertained that the prisoner is of mixed Japanese
and Chinese blood.

NICHI-NICHI

SEVEN LEADERS OF NATIONAL SALVATION MOVEMENT
TO BE FREED SHORTLY

On November 23, 1936 seven
leaders of the National Salvation Movement were arrested
and they are still being detained by the Procurator's
office of the Kiangsu High Court, pending a decision as
to whether they are to be prosecuted or released. The
period of 4 months detention is now at an end and according
to reliable information, the Court will free them on
the ground that there is no reason to charge them with
reactionary activities.

Sun Chun Tze, one of the seven
prisoners, will, on his release, proceed to a foreign
country by order of the Nanking Government. This goes
to show that the government is willing to give in to
the popular front.

《日日新闻》

七位救国运动领袖即将获释

1936年11月23日，七位救国运动领袖被捕，目前仍由江苏高等法院检察官办公室羁押，等待决定是起诉还是释放。四个月的拘留期现已结束，据可靠消息，法院将以没有理由指控他们从事反动活动为由释放他们。

七名囚犯之一的沈钧儒（Sun Chun Tze），获释后将奉南京政府之命前往国外。这表明政府愿意向人民阵线让步。

March 11, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

GENERAL CHANG CHUN ON SINO-JAPANESE RELATIONS

General Chang Chun, the former Minister
of Foreign Affairs, now Secretary-General of the Central
Political Council and Chairman of the Diplomatic Affairs
Committee, came to Shanghai the other day to undergo
treatment to his nose.
When interviewed yesterday at his residence
by a reporter of this paper, General Chang Chun made the
following statement:- "I accepted the post of Minister of
Foreign Affairs last year on condition that I served for
six months only. As regards negotiations for the
readjustment of Sino-Japanese relations, the attitude of
the Chinese Government has already been made quite clear
to Japan in the course of my conferences with Mr. Kawagoe,
the Japanese Ambassador, last year. For this reason, there
will be no necessity to solve the Sino-Japanese disputes
separately or partially. The recent speech delivered by
the Japanese Minister of Foreign Affairs represented what
I would have liked to say. A solution of all outstanding
Sino-Japanese disputes will depend upon Japan's sincerity."

Sin Wan Pao and other local newspapers :-

ANNIVERSARY OF FALL OF SHANGHAI TO NATIONALIST ARMY

In commemoration of the anniversary of
the arrival of the Nationalist Army in Shanghai, which falls
on March 21, General Wu Teh Chen, Mayor of Shanghai, will
hold a meeting with representatives of local Government
organs, public bodies, etc. on the 9th Floor of the Chinese
Y.M.C.A. Building, Boulevard de Montigny, French Concession,
at 3 p.m. Sunday, March 13 to discuss ways and means to
celebrate the anniversary.

Hwa Tung Ya Pao dated March 10 and other local newspapers :-

DEATH ANNIVERSARY OF DR. SUN YAT SEN

March 12 being the anniversary of the death
of the late Dr. Sun Yat Sen, the local Tangpu yesterday
issued a notification stating that it will hold a meeting
of representatives of public bodies, schools, etc. at 10 a.m.
March 12 at the People's Educational Institute, Wen Miao
Road, City, to commemorate the occasion.
The national flag will be hoisted at half
mast on that day, while amusement resorts will suspend
business for one day.

Hwa Tung Ya Pao dated March 10 :-

THE CASE OF SUNG CHUN SZ AND OTHERS

It is learned that the investigations conducted
by the Soochow High Court into the case against Mr. Sung Chun
Sz and others have been completed, and that they will all
soon be released. The Shanghai Bar Association is still
retaining Mr. Sung Chun Sz and others as members of the
Executive Committee of the Association.

1937年3月11日。
下午译文。

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

张群将军谈中日关系

前外交部长、现任中央政治委员会秘书长兼外交委员会主席的张群将军，日前来沪治疗鼻疾。
昨日，本报记者在其寓所采访张群将军时，他发表了如下声明：“去年我接受外交部长一职的条件是仅任职六个月。关于调整中日关系的谈判，中国政府的态度在去年我与日本大使川越茂先生的会谈中已向日方阐明。因此，没有必要单独或部分解决中日争端。日本外相最近的讲话代表了我本想说的话。所有悬而未决的中日争端的解决，将取决于日本的诚意。”

《新闻报》及其他本地报纸：-

国军进驻上海周年纪念

为纪念3月21日国军进驻上海周年纪念日，上海市市长吴铁城将军将于3月13日（星期日）下午3时，在法租界蒙太尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）基督教青年会大楼九楼，与地方政府机关、公共团体等代表举行会议，讨论庆祝周年纪念的方式方法。

3月10日的《华东亚报》及其他本地报纸：-

孙中山博士逝世周年纪念

3月12日是已故孙中山博士逝世周年纪念日，本地党部昨日发布通知，称将于3月12日上午10时，在市内文庙路民众教育馆举行公共团体、学校等代表会议，以纪念这一日子。
当日国旗将下半旗致哀，娱乐场所停业一天。

3月10日的《华东亚报》：-

沈钧儒等人案件

据悉，苏州高等法院对沈钧儒先生等人案件的调查已经结束，他们都将很快获释。上海律师公会仍保留沈钧儒等人作为该公会执行委员会委员的身份。

pages.en:
March 4, 1937.

MAINICHI

ARRESTED LEADERS OF ANTI-JAPANESE FRONT TO BE
RELEASED

The seven leaders of the Various
Circles National Salvation Association under arrest are
still being detained by the Soochow High Court. Four
of the prisoners are lawyers. Soon after their arrest
the Ministry of Justice issued instructions to the Kiangsu
High Court, the Shanghai District Court and the Chinese
Bar Association to suspend the four lawyers.
Several leftist members of the
Kuomintang submitted a proposal to the Third Plenary
Session suggesting the release of the prisoners. It
is said that the Session has decided to release the
prisoners on the ground of lack of evidence.

JAPANESE ROBBER ARRESTED

At 4.40 p.m. yesterday Detective
Mizoguchi of the S.M.P. arrested on North Szechuen Road
a Japanese named Horita, age 31, on information given by
Detective Kosonoi of the Japanese Consular Police that the
Japanese was wanted for robbery. The prisoner has had a
previous conviction.
The man Horita arrived in
Shanghai on January 9, 1937 after his release from the
Nagasaki Goal. On January 28 he stole $55 and Yen 3 -
from the Restaurant Hitomatsu, No. 15, Lane 465 North
Szechuen Road; on February 17 he stole a sewing machine
valued at $250 from No. 8 Hang Fong Li, Scott Road; on
February 22 he took away a radio receiver, an eye-glass and
a finger ring valued at $200 from No. 69 Haskell Road; on
March 2 he entered Dr. Yoshida's home in the Foo King
Hospital and demanded $5 under threat of injuring a servant
with a dagger.

THE RESIGNATION OF DEPUTY COMMISSIONER TAJIMA

At 4 p.m. yesterday the Committee
appointed by the Japanese Amalgamated Association of Street
Unions to persuade Deputy Commissioner Tajima to withdraw
his resignation called on Mr. Tajima at the Banzai Kwan
Hotel and after handing him the resolution passed by the
Association regretting his resignation they requested him
to reconsider his decision.
In reply, Deputy Commissioner
Tajima informed the Committee that he was determined to
resign because of his health and family affairs.
It is not likely that the
persuasion movement will prove successful in view of Mr. Tajima's
firm decision.
pages.zh:
1937年3月4日。

《每日新闻》

被捕的反日阵线领袖将被释放

被捕的各界救国会七位领袖仍被苏州高等法院羁押。四名囚犯是律师。他们被捕后不久，司法部即指令江苏高等法院、上海地方法院和中国律师公会暂停这四名律师的执业资格。
几名国民党左派成员向三中全会提交提案，建议释放囚犯。据说，全会已决定以证据不足为由释放囚犯。

日本抢劫犯被捕

昨日下午4时40分，工部局警务处侦探沟口（Mizoguchi）根据日本领事警察小园井（Kosonoi）侦探提供的情报，在北四川路逮捕了一名名叫堀田（Horita）的31岁日本男子，该日本人因抢劫被通缉。该囚犯有前科。
堀田于1937年1月9日从长崎监狱获释后抵达上海。1月28日，他在北四川路465弄15号“一人松”餐厅（Hitomatsu）盗窃了55美元和3日元；2月17日，他在斯科特路（Scott Road）恒丰里8号盗窃了一台价值250美元的缝纫机；2月22日，他在哈斯克尔路（Haskell Road）69号拿走了一台收音机、一副眼镜和一枚戒指，价值200美元；3月2日，他进入福金医院（Foo King Hospital）吉田医生（Dr. Yoshida）家中，持匕首威胁伤害一名仆人，勒索5美元。

副总监田岛辞职

昨日下午4时，日本同业公会街道工会联合委员会任命的劝说副总监田岛撤回辞呈的代表团，在万岁馆酒店拜访了田岛先生，在向田岛递交了对其辞职表示遗憾的决议后，请求他重新考虑其决定。
作为回应，副总监田岛告知委员会，由于健康和家庭原因，他决心辞职。
鉴于田岛先生坚定的决定，劝说行动不太可能成功。

March 4, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Hwa Tung Ya Pao dated March 3 and other local newspapers :-
DR. YING TSE LING CONVICTED AND SENTENCED
Recently Dr. Ying Tse Ling, native of Funing (阜寧), Chairman of the Ricsha Owners' Association, was charged by Chao Kwan Pao (趙官保) in the Shanghai First Special District Court with counterfeiting certain documents. Later Dr. Ying Tse Ling filed a counter-charge against Chao Kwan Pao for malicious accusation.
The case against Dr. Ying Tse Ling was again heard by Judge Feng (馮) on the morning of March 3 when Dr. Ying Tse Ling was sentenced to five months' imprisonment with suspension for two years.

Hwa Tung Ya Pao dated March 3 and other local newspapers :-
PAYMENT OF INCOME TAX BY FOREIGNERS
The Ministry of Foreign Affairs is at present negotiating with the various foreign Consulates over the question of payment of income tax by foreign residents in China.
It is learned that during the past few days many local foreigners have voluntarily called at the Shanghai Office of the Income Tax Collection Bureau and offered to pay the income tax. Most of these foreigners are Russians, with a few British and Americans who work in missionary concerns.

Ta Mei Wan Pao dated March 3 and other local newspapers :-
THE ARREST OF THE SEVEN LEADERS OF THE NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION
Sung Chung Sz (沈鈞儒), Wang Chao Shih (王造時), Soo Chi Lien (沙千里) and Miss Sze Liang (史良), four of the seven persons arrested and later handed over to the High Court at Soochow for detention by the local Police Bureau, are lawyers. After their arrest, the Kiangsu High Court, the Shanghai District Court and the Shanghai Bar Association were instructed by the Ministry of Justice to suspend them from practising as lawyers.
Recently the Shanghai Bar Association held a meeting at which the question of the qualification of the four lawyers to serve as members of the Executive Committee of the Association was brought up for consideration.
After a heated discussion, it was resolved that they be retained as members of the Executive Committee on the ground that they have not been convicted of any criminal offence but have only been temporarily suspended.

1937年3月4日。下午译件。

据3月3日《华通亚报》及其他本地报纸报道：-
应则灵博士被判刑
近日，阜宁籍人力车车主协会主席应则灵（Ying Tse Ling）博士，被赵官保（Chao Kwan Pao）在上海第一特区地方法院指控伪造某些文件。随后，应则灵博士对赵官保提出反诉，指控其恶意诬告。
3月3日上午，冯法官（Judge Feng）再次审理对应则灵博士的指控，判处应则灵博士有期徒刑五个月，缓刑两年。

据3月3日《华通亚报》及其他本地报纸报道：-
外国人缴纳所得税
外交部目前正就外国在华居民缴纳所得税一事，与各国领事馆进行谈判。
据悉，过去几天内，许多在沪外籍人士主动前往所得税征收局上海办事处，表示愿意缴纳所得税。这些外籍人士多为俄国人，另有少数在教会机构工作的英国人和美国人。

据3月3日《大美晚报》及其他本地报纸报道：-
全国救国会七领袖被捕
沈钧儒（Sung Chung Sz）、王造时（Wang Chao Shih）、沙千里（Soo Chi Lien）和史良小姐（Miss Sze Liang），这四位被当地警察局逮捕并随后移交苏州高等法院羁押的七人中的成员，均为律师。他们被捕后，司法部指令江苏高等法院、上海地方法院和上海律师公会暂停他们的律师执业资格。
近日，上海律师公会召开会议，审议了这四位律师担任该公会执行委员资格的问题。
经过激烈讨论，会议决议保留他们的执行委员资格，理由是他们并未被判定犯有任何刑事罪行，只是被暂时停止执业。

March 1, 1937.
4
Afternoon Translation.

At 3 p.m. yesterday the Kwangtung Fellow
Provincials' Association held a meeting which was attended
by several tens of representatives from public bodies.
Mr. Li Ta Chao (李大超) presided.
Mr. Lu Chwang made the following report:-
"On October 3 last year, the Hongkong Government
detailed police officers to force the residents in the city
to remove from their houses before December 31. The
officers said that if the residents did not remove, fire
would be set to their houses. On December 29 the Hongkong
Government sent two policemen and five coolies to the city
to demolish house No.25, whereupon the residents concerned
sent a long-distance telephone report to Mr. Tiao Tsoh Chi
(刁作謙), special delegate of the Foreign Office of the
Chinese Government, and asked him to put a stop to the action
of the Hongkong Government. Mr. Tiao sent a telegraphic
report to the Foreign Ministry at Nanking and was informed
by the Foreign Minister that the Chinese Government would
lodge a protest with the British Ambassador to China and
that Mr. Tiao could open negotiations with the Hongkong
Government. On January 4 Mr. Tiao made an investigation
into the demolished house at Kowloon and collected evidence.
I have been appointed by the residents at Kowloon to submit
an appeal to the National Government to preserve China's
sovereign rights and I hope that public bodies in Shanghai
will give their support to this appeal."
It is reported that Mr. Lu Chwang will leave for
Nanking to submit an appeal to the Ministry of Foreign
Affairs for negotiations with the British authorities. The
Kwangtung Fellow Provincials' Association has decided to
submit a petition to the Ministry requesting it to open
negotiations.

Crystal (晶報) publishes the following report:

THE ARREST OF THE SIX POPULAR FRONT LEADERS

In connection with the arrest of six leaders of
the Popular Front in Shanghai, General Chiang Kai Shek,
Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission, is said to have
informed newspapermen that consideration will be shown them
if anybody is prepared to offer security for their release
and if the arrested persons will repent and work for the
salvation of the nation on the basis of the policy of the
Government.
It is reported that two members of the Central
Executive Committee of the Kuomintang are working in
behalf of the arrested persons and it is probable that they
may be released on bail.

1937年3月1日。
4
下午译件。

昨日下午3时，广东同乡会举行会议，数十个公共团体的代表出席。
李大超（Li Ta Chao）先生主持。
卢庄（Lu Chwang）先生作如下报告：-
“去年10月3日，香港政府派遣警察强迫城内居民在12月31日前搬离住所。警官称，如果居民不搬迁，将烧毁他们的房屋。12月29日，香港政府派遣两名警察和五名苦力到城内拆除25号房屋，随即有关居民向中国政府外交部特派员刁作谦（Tiao Tsoh Chi）先生打长途电话报告，请求他制止香港政府的行动。刁先生向南京外交部发电报告，并获外交部长告知，中国政府将向英国驻华大使提出抗议，且刁先生可与香港政府展开谈判。1月4日，刁先生对九龙被拆房屋进行了调查并收集证据。我受九龙居民委托，向国民政府提交请愿书以维护中国主权，希望上海各公共团体支持此项请愿。”
据悉，卢庄先生将前往南京，向外交部提交请愿书，以便与英国当局进行谈判。广东同乡会已决定向部方提交请愿书，请求开启谈判。

《晶报》（Crystal）刊登如下报道：

人民阵线六领袖被捕

关于上海人民阵线六领袖被捕一事，据说军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军告知新闻记者，如果有人愿意提供担保释放他们，且被捕人员能够悔过并在政府政策基础上为国救亡工作，则将对他们予以宽大处理。
据报道，国民党中央执行委员会的两名委员正在为被捕人员奔走，他们很可能被保释。

《晶报》（ ）刊登如下报道：-

人民阵线六领袖被捕

关于上海人民阵线六领袖被捕一事，据说军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军告知新闻记者，如果有人愿意提供担保释放他们，且被捕人员能够悔过并在政府政策基础上为国救亡工作，则将对他们予以宽大处理。

January 19, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Min Pao and other local newspapers publish the following
correspondence from Soochow :-

THE CASE AGAINST MR. SUNG CHUN SZ AND OTHERS

In connection with the case against Mr. Sung
Chun Sz ( 沈钧儒 ), etc., it is learned that as both
Mr. Sung Chun Sz and Miss Sze Liang ( 史良 ) are lawyers,
the Kiangsu High Court has instructed the Chinese Bar
Associations at Soochow and Shanghai to prohibit them from
practising law in these two districts.
According to the regulations drawn up by the
Ministry of Justice, the Procuratorate of the Kiangsu High
Court has also notified the Procuratorate of the Shanghai
District Court to instruct the Shanghai Chinese Bar
Association not to allow the two other lawyers Soo Chi
Lee ( 沙千里 ) and Wong Zau Shih ( 王造时 ) to practise
in Shanghai.

Min Pao and other local newspapers (Chengchow Telegram) :-

THE JAPANESE SPECIAL ORGAN AT CHENGCHOW

New documentary evidence has been unearthed
in connection with the case against the Japanese Special
Affairs Organ in Chengchow. It is learned that this
organization is actually the chief communication centre
for Honan, Shensi and Kansu Provinces. Separate organs are
in existence in Honan to undertake secret work there.
On January 18, the Japanese Army stationed in
North China held a military conference in Tientsin at which
Shiga (one of the three Japanese ronins who were arrested
by the Chengchow authorities and later handed over to the
Japanese Consulate at Chengchow) was present to make a
report on the Chengchow Case.
It is learned that on January 18 the Office
of the Special Delegate at Chengchow forwarded copies of
this evidence to the Ministry of Foreign Affairs.

Hwa Tung Yen Pao dated January 18 published the following poem
written by one "Pei" ( 培 ) :-

"A WARNING"

Fellow countrymen! Have you forgotten
That in autumn of 1931
The frontier borders of our North-east
Were suddenly invaded by the cruel enemy?
In addition to the loss of several hundreds
of thousands of miles of territory,
Our 30,000,000 fellow-countrymen have thus
been made slaves.
The ambitious desires of the enemy can never
be satisfied.
After the seizure of our North-east,
They are now contemplating the occupation of
North China.
pages.zh:
1937年1月19日。
下午译件。

《民报》及其他本地报纸刊登来自苏州的如下通讯：-

沈钧儒先生等人案件

关于沈钧儒（Sung Chun Sz）先生等人案件，据悉由于沈钧儒先生和史良（Sze Liang）小姐均为律师，江苏高等法院已指令苏州和上海的中国律师公会禁止他们在这两个区域执业。
根据司法部制定的规章，江苏高等法院检察处也已通知上海地方法院检察处，指令上海中国律师公会不允许另外两名律师沙千里（Soo Chi Lee）和王造时（Wong Zau Shih）在上海执业。

《民报》及其他本地报纸（郑州电）：-

日本驻郑州特务机关

关于郑州日本特务机关案件，已发掘出新的书面证据。据悉，该组织实际上是河南、陕西和甘肃三省的主要通讯中心。在河南设有单独机构，以在那里从事秘密工作。
1月18日，驻扎在华北的日本军队在天津举行军事会议，志贺（Shiga，被郑州当局逮捕并随后移交给日本驻郑州领事馆的三名日本浪人之一）出席会议，就郑州案件作了报告。
据悉，1月18日，驻郑州特派员办公室将此证据副本送交外交部。

1月18日《华通言报》刊登了一位署名“培”（Pei）的人所写的如下诗歌：

“警告”

同胞们！你们是否忘记
在1931年秋
我们东北的边疆
突然遭到残暴敌人的入侵？
除了丧失数十万平方里的领土，
我们三千万同胞 thus
沦为奴隶。
敌人的野心永远无法满足。
在侵占我们东北之后，
他们现在正图谋占领华北。

pages.en:
February 5, 1937.
Afternoon Translation

Shanghai Public Daily News ( 市公日刊 ) publishes the following brief comment :-

THE POLICE AND HAWKERS

It is proper that those hawkers who in peddling their wares, create obstruction to traffic or who pay no heed to sanitation should be suppressed. But on reflection, one sees that these hawkers are being compelled to do such a low class of business because they have no other means to earn a living.
One regrettable fact is that the authorities of the Foreign Settlements have no fixed measures by which to handle these hawkers. They arrest the hawkers but release them soon afterwards when the hawkers have paid a fine. Furthermore, there are certain Police officers who regard hawkers as "meat and fish" and squeeze and extortion have become common.
The Chinese Ratepayers' Association is taking up the case of the hawkers. We hope that the Settlement authorities will not be too harsh towards hawkers at this time of trade depression and will instruct Police officers not to take advantage of their authority to oppress hawkers.

Shanghai Public Daily News :-

THE ARREST OF SUNG CHUN SZ AND OTHERS

Sung Chun Sz ( 沈鈞儒 ), Chang Nai Chi ( 章乃器 ), Li Kung Pu ( 李公樸 ), Wong Chao Sz ( 王造時 ), Soo Chi Li ( 沙千里 ), Chow Tao Feng ( 鄒韜奮 ) and Miss Sze Liang ( 史良 ) are being held by the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow for investigation.
On January 25, Jen Chung Kao ( 任仲高 ), the principal of a primary school, Koo Lieu Shing ( 顧留馨 ), a merchant, and some 20 others, acting as representatives of the National Salvation Associations of various public bodies, visited the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow and requested that Sung Chun Sz and the six others be released. On the advice of a Court officer, the callers withdrew.
On January 30, the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court in Shanghai issued summonses against Jen Chung Kao and Koo Lieu Shing, citing them to appear at the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow at 2 p.m. February 3 as witnesses.
Accordingly, Jen and Koo appeared at the Soochow High Court at 2 p.m. February 3. The Procurator interrogated them up to 6 p.m. and ordered that Jen and Koo furnish shop security for their appearance at any time required by the Court.
The two men are being detained for they cannot find the necessary security. Their families are making arrangements to find the security.
pages.zh:
1937年2月5日。
下午译件

《市公日刊》发表如下短评：-

警察与小贩

对于那些在叫卖货物时阻碍交通或不注意卫生的小贩，予以取缔是恰当的。但反思之下，人们看到这些小贩是因为没有其他谋生手段，才被迫从事这种低微的职业。
一个令人遗憾的事实是，租界当局没有固定的措施来处理这些小贩。他们逮捕小贩，但在小贩缴纳罚款后很快又将其释放。此外，某些警员将小贩视为“鱼肉”，敲诈勒索已成常态。
华人纳税会正在关注小贩的案件。我们希望租界当局在贸易萧条时期不要对小贩过于严厉，并指示警员不得利用职权压迫小贩。

《市公日刊》：-

沈钧儒等人被捕

沈钧儒（Sung Chun Sz）、章乃器（Chang Nai Chi）、李公朴（Li Kung Pu）、王造时（Wong Chao Sz）、沙千里（Soo Chi Li）、邹韬奋（Chow Tao Feng）和史良小姐（Miss Sze Liang）正被江苏高等法院羁押于苏州接受调查。
1月25日，小学校长任仲高（Jen Chung Kao）、商人顾留馨（Koo Lieu Shing）及其他约20人，作为各公共团体救国会的代表，访问了苏州江苏高等法院，请求释放沈钧儒等六人。在一名法院职员的建议下，来访者退去。
1月30日，江苏高等法院上海第二分院发出传票，传唤任仲高和顾留馨作为证人，于2月3日下午2时出庭苏州江苏高等法院。
据此，任、顾二人于2月3日下午2时出现在苏州高等法院。检察官审讯他们直至下午6时，并命令任、顾二人提供铺保，以便在法院要求的任何时间到庭。
两人因无法找到必要的担保而被拘留。他们的家人正在安排寻找担保。

Lih Pao (Soochow telegram):-

THE ARREST OF SEVEN MEMBERS OF THE POPULAR FRONT

Two months have now elapsed since Sung Chu Sz
(沈儒), Chang Nai Chi (章乃器) and five others were
escorted to Soochow for investigation. As the case is
very complicated, a formal charge against them has not yet
been filed.

On February 3, the Procurator of the Kiangsu
High Court at Soochow handed down a ruling that the
period of detention of Sung Chun Sz and the six others
be extended for two more months.

人民阵线七成员被捕

沈钧儒（Sung Chu Sz）、章乃器（Chang Nai Chi）等五人被押解至苏州接受调查，至今已过两个月。由于案情非常复杂，尚未对他们正式起诉。

February 2, 1937. 3. Afternoon Translation.

Shanghai Evening News dated February 1 :-

THE ARREST OF THE SEVEN MEMBERS OF THE CHINESE POPULAR FRONT

After Sung Chun Sz (沈鈞儒), Chang Nai Chi
(章乃器), Chow Tao Feng (鄒韜奮), Li Kung Pu (李公樸), Wong
Chao Shih (王造時), Sc Chi Li (沙千里) and Miss Sze Liang
(史良), members of the Chinese Popular Front, were transferred
to Soochow, the National Government adopted a lenient attitude
towards them. It is believed that conditions are now
favourable for these seven persons.
On January 12 the China Various Circles National
Salvation Federation submitted a long petition to General
Chiang Kai Shek, Chairman of the Military Affairs Commission,
explaining the position of the seven prisoners.
The Federation has also issued a manifesto.
On January 20 more than twenty representatives
were sent by the Federation to submit a petition to the
Kiangsu High Court at Soochow. They were received by the
Procurator and allowed to hand the prisoners a written note
of consolation. They left Soochow on the next day. They
had intended to proceeded to Nanking to appeal to the National
Government, but the plan was abandoned owing to the pressure
of time.
On their return the representatives were
summoned by the local authorities and questioned regarding
their views. The representatives gave prompt replies and
were allowed to go after the interrogation. A small section
of the representatives were at first alarmed and thought they
would be arrested.

2月1日《上海晚报》：

中国民众阵线七成员被捕

继沈钧儒 (Sung Chun Sz)、章乃器 (Chang Nai Chi)、邹韬奋 (Chow Tao Feng)、李公朴 (Li Kung Pu)、王造时 (Wong Chao Shih)、沙千里 (Sc Chi Li) 和史良女士 (Miss Sze Liang) 等中国民众阵线成员被转移至苏州后，国民政府对他们采取了宽大态度。据信，目前这七人的处境有利。
1月12日，全国各界救国联合会向军事委员会委员长蒋介石将军提交了一份长篇请愿书，说明七名囚犯的情况。
该联合会还发表了一份宣言。
1月20日，联合会派出二十多名代表前往苏州的江苏高等法院提交请愿书。他们受到检察官的接见，并获准向囚犯递交慰问信。他们于次日离开苏州。他们原打算前往南京向国民政府上诉，但因时间紧迫而放弃了该计划。
代表们返回后，被地方当局传唤并就其观点接受问询。代表们迅速作答，并在讯问后被允许离开。部分代表起初感到惊慌，以为会被逮捕。

January 23, 1937.

MAIL IC I

STUDENTS' NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION ACTIVE
TO PROMOTE ANTI-JAPANESE POPULAR FRONT

Large numbers of C..ires
youths in Shanghai are now greatly interested in the
National Unification and Salvation Movement, while the
members of the Shanghai Various Circles' National
Salvation Association, several leaders of which were
arrested, are reported to be planning to promote an
anti-Japanese popular front movement by effecting the
release of their arrested leaders and showing opposition to
Wang Ching Wei.

At 2.30 p.m. January 22 about
140 communist male and female students of Great China,
Chinan and Kwang Hwa Universities held a meeting in a
dormitory of Futan University. It is believed that they
discussed ways and means to effect the release of the
arrested leaders of the National Salvation Movement and
to oppose Wang Ching Wei. The recent activities of red
students, labourers and women's organizations since the
outbreak of the Sian incident are very noticeable.

LABOURERS PLAN GENERAL STRIKE DURING CHINESE
NEW YEAR

Following the failure of strikes
among Japanese cotton mills, seven leaders of the anti-
Japanese Popular Front movement were arrested. The
workers are, however, still continuing their activities
in planning to bring about a general strike. The recent
labour troubles at Chinese and British factories are
reported to have been instigated by "red" elements.
Members of the Workers' Welfare Association are attempting
to secure the control of power among workers at various
factories and mills, whilst there is another party known
as the Patriotic Anti-Japanese Association which acts as
a strong strike agitation element among labourers. "Red"
elements are trying to bring about a general strike during
the Chinese New Year, but the Workers' Welfare Association
is trying to obstruct their activities in order to secure
the favour of workers for the purpose of declaring strikes
according to its own plans. The authorities concerned
are paying close attention to the above mentioned matters.
pages.zh:
1937年1月23日。

MAIL IC I

学生救国会积极促进抗日人民阵线

上海的大量中国青年现在对全国统一救亡运动表现出极大兴趣，而上海各界救国联合会的成员（其中几名领导人已被捕）据报正计划通过促成被捕领导人的释放以及表示反对汪精卫 (Wang Ching Wei)，来推动抗日人民阵线运动。

1月22日下午2时30分，约140名来自大夏大学、暨南大学和光华大学的男女共产主义学生在复旦大学的一间宿舍内举行会议。据信，他们讨论了促成救亡运动被捕领导人释放以及反对汪精卫的方法和手段。自西安事变爆发以来，“赤色”学生、劳工和妇女组织的近期活动非常引人注目。

劳工计划在春节期间举行总罢工

继日资棉纺厂罢工失败及七名抗日人民阵线运动领导人被捕之后，工人们仍在继续活动，策划发动总罢工。据报道，近期华资和英资工厂的劳资纠纷是由“赤色”分子煽动的。工人福利会的成员正试图掌控各工厂和纱厂工人中的权力，同时还有一个名为“抗日爱国会”的派别，在劳工中充当强有力的罢工煽动元素。“赤色”分子正试图在春节期间发动总罢工，但工人福利会正试图阻挠他们的活动，以便赢得工人的好感，从而按照其自身计划宣布罢工。有关当局正密切关注上述事项。

Sh. : i Evening News dated January 21 :-
THE CASE AGAINST MISS SZE LIANG, MR. SUNG CHUN SZ AND OTHERS

Miss Sze Liang (史良), the female lawyer who was arrested with Mr. Sung Chun Sz (沈钧儒) and five others on charges of offences against the State, was interrogated by Prosecutor Oong (翁) of the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow on the afternoon of January 19. She was confronted with another prisoner named Loo Tsing (罗青) who was previously arrested in connection with the same case. During the interrogation, Loo Tsing requested that he be given similar treatment as Mr. Sung and the others. His request was not entertained.

On the afternoon of January 20, twenty-one representatives of students in Shanghai called at the Kiangsu High Court to request permission to see Mr. Sung Chun Sz and the others. On being told by a procurator that an order had been given not to allow any person to interview these prisoners, the representatives submitted a written petition asking for the release of Mr. Sung and the others.

The students' representatives later went to the Branch Detention House of the Kiangsu High Court where Mr. Sung and his companions were being held, and were again told that these prisoners could not be interviewed. They were, however, informed by Mr. Chiang (蒋), the officer in charge of the Detention House, that Mr. Sung and the others were in good health and that the food which they had brought with them would be given to the prisoners by the Detention House officer.

The representatives then made an attempt to interview Miss Sze Liang at the Female Detention House, but again met with failure, whereupon they returned to Shanghai.

Sun Kuo Wan Pao (生活晚报), an evening paper, of Jan. 21 :-

Some time ago, Mr. Sung Chun Sz and six others were arrested on suspicion of being connected with certain affairs. They are being held in the Detention House of the Third Gaol of the Soochow High Court. Inquiries are being made by both the Soochow High Court and the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court and it is hard to surmise how the case will be concluded.

According to law, whenever a lawyer is involved in a criminal case, he or she should be suspended from his or her duties as a lawyer during the period of investigations or trial of the case, irrespective of whether he or she be found guilty or not. Of the seven arrested persons, Messrs Sung Chun Sz, Soo Chi Lien (沙千里) and Wong Shao Sz (王造时) and Miss Sze Liang are all lawyers. After they were handed over from Shanghai to the Soochow High Court, the latter immediately sent a petition to the Ministry of Justice requesting that the Chinese Bar Association of Shanghai be instructed through the Shanghai District Court to suspend them from their duties. 1月21日《上海晚报》：
针对史良女士、沈钧儒先生及其他人的案件

女律师史良女士 (Miss Sze Liang) 与沈钧儒先生 (Mr. Sung Chun Sz) 及其他五人因涉嫌危害国家罪被捕，于1月19日下午在苏州由江苏高等法院翁检察官 (Procurator Oong) 进行讯问。她与另一名此前因同一案件被捕、名为罗青 (Loo Tsing) 的囚犯当面对质。在讯问期间，罗青要求获得与沈先生等人相同的待遇。他的请求未被受理。

1月20日下午，二十一名上海学生代表前往江苏高等法院，请求获准会见沈钧儒先生等人。在被告知已有命令禁止任何人会见这些囚犯后，代表们提交了一份书面请愿书，要求释放沈先生等人。

学生代表随后前往关押沈先生及其同伴的江苏高等法院分支看守所，再次被告知不得会见这些囚犯。然而，看守所负责人蒋先生 (Mr. Chiang) 告知他们，沈先生等人健康状况良好，且他们带来的食物将由看守所官员转交给囚犯。

代表们随后试图在女子看守所会见史良女士，但再次未能成功，随即返回上海。

1月21日晚报《生活晚报》(Sun Kuo Wan Pao)：

前一段时间，沈钧儒先生及其他六人因涉嫌与某些事件有关而被捕。他们现被关押在苏州高等法院第三监狱的看守所内。苏州高等法院和江苏高等法院第二分院正在进行调查，很难推测此案将如何结案。

根据法律，凡律师卷入刑事案件，无论其是否被判有罪，在案件调查或审判期间均应暂停其律师职务。在被捕的七人中，沈钧儒先生、沙千里先生 (Soo Chi Lien)、王造时先生 (Wong Shao Sz) 和史良女士均为律师。在他们从上海移交给苏州高等法院后，后者立即向司法部呈文，请求通过上海地方法院指令上海律师公会暂停他们的职务。因此，上海律师公会已

issued notice suspending Messrs Soo Chi Lien and Wong
Shao Sz and Miss Sze Liang, but Mr. Sung Chun Sz was not
mentioned. The public may therefore think that special
treatment is being accorded Mr. Sung. In reality, however,
Mr. Sung is also suspended in the same way as the others.
Mr. Sung Chun Sz was a responsible official
in the functions of the Shanghai Bar Association and he
has been a member of the Executive Committee of the

closely connected with the Bar Association that its

When the order from the Ministry of Justice came to the
Bar Association instructing that the four lawyers in
question be suspended, the Association published a notice
in the newspapers suspending three only, excluding Mr.Sung
for the sake of his reputation.
The Bar Association is obviously favouring
Mr. Sung.

沈钧儒先生在上海律师公会的运作中担任负责官员，自该公会改组以来，他一直是执行委员会的成员。正是他指导着公会的事务。他与律师公会关系如此密切，以至于在其被捕后，公会成员努力促成他的释放。
当司法部的命令到达律师公会，指示暂停上述四名律师的职务时，公会在报纸上发布通知，仅暂停了三人的职务，出于维护声誉的考虑将沈先生排除在外。
律师公会显然在偏袒沈先生。

Min Pao and other local newspapers publish the following

THE CASE AGAINST MR. SUNG CHUN SZ AND OTHERS

《民报》及其他本地报纸刊登了来自苏州的下列通信：

控告宋春霖先生等人案

据悉，在涉及宋春霖（宋春霖）先生等人的案件中，由于宋春霖先生和史良（史良）女士均为律师，江苏高等法院已指示苏州和上海的中国律师公会禁止他们在这两个地区执业。

根据司法部制定的规章，江苏高等法院检察处也已通知上海地方法院检察处，指示上海中国律师公会不允许另外两名律师沙千里（沙千里）和王造时（王造时）在上海执业。

Ta Kung Pao publishes the following telegram from Nanking:-

THE LAW OF CONNIVANCE IN ADULTERY

The Judicial Yuan has given the following
explanation of the text of Article 245, Section 2, of the
Chinese Criminal Code :-
No private complaint can be made when the
spouse has connived at the other party's adultery with
another person, and such right of private complaint can
not be exercised should the spouse later repent. Connivance
means the act of the spouse in allowing the other party to
commit the offence, the consent of the spouse to the adultery
with the third party not being in question.

"Crystal"(晶報) published the following article on
January 14 :-

CONDITIONS IN KANSU PROVINCE

The following is an authentic report received
by the Kansu Fellow Provincials Association in Nanking
regarding conditions in Kansu showing that the situation
is not so serious as reported in the newspapers:-
During the past twelve months, General Ma
Ho Tsing(马步青), the Defence Commissioner of Liangchow
(凉州), Kansu, and his men, about 5,000 in number, have
had 12 encounters with the Red bandits under Tsu Teh and
Mao Tse Tung. Owing to a shortage of munitions, General
Ma is now holding out in Liangchow which is surrounded by
Communist influence. It is reported that the bandits
are about 30,000 strong.
On November 27, the Leftist elements in
Shensi and Kansu held a meeting at Pa Yien Tsung Village
(八里镇), about 160 li to the south-east of Lanchow.
In addition to Tsu Teh, Mao Tse Tung and other notorious
Red bandit leaders, about ten Russian advisors were present.

纵容通奸罪

司法院对《中华民国刑法》第245条第2款的条文作出如下解释：
如果配偶纵容另一方与他人通奸，则不得提起自诉；即使配偶日后反悔，也不得行使此项自诉权。纵容是指配偶允许另一方实施该犯罪行为，即配偶对与第三方通奸表示同意，对此不存在疑问。

《晶报》于1月14日刊登了下列文章：

甘肃省局势

以下是南京甘肃同乡会收到的关于甘肃局势的真实报告，表明情况并不像报纸报道的那样严重：
在过去十二个月里，甘肃凉州（凉州）防守司令马步青（马步青）将军及其部下约5,000人，与朱德和毛泽东率领的红色匪徒发生了12次遭遇战。由于弹药短缺，马将军目前坚守在被共产主义势力包围的凉州。据报道，匪徒人数约为30,000人。

NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION CHANGES NAME INTO
"ASSOCIATION TO AVERT NATIONAL RUIN"

Since the arrest of several
leaders of the National Salvation Association, activities
of the various national salvation associations have
been closely watched by the Chinese authorities. As
a result, the anti-Japanese popular front has become
inactive. During the detention of General Chiang Kai
Shek at Sian, the members of the national salvation
associations attempted to effect the release of their
arrested leaders. After General Chiang Kai Shek was
liberated, these members organized an association of
cultural circles to avert national ruin, a women's
association to avert national ruin and a workers
association to avert national ruin. All these associations
are nothing but national salvation associations with a
different name; their object is anti-Japanese. These
new associations will publish monthly magazines to
propagate anti-Japanese activities.
pages.zh:
全国救国会更名为“抗亡协会”

自从全国救国会几位领导人被捕以来，各类救国会的活动一直受到中国当局的严密监视。结果，抗日人民阵线变得不活跃。在蒋介石将军被扣留在西安期间，救国会成员试图促成被捕领导人的释放。蒋介石将军获释后，这些成员组织了文化界抗亡协会、妇女抗亡协会和工人抗亡协会。所有这些协会不过是改头换面的全国救国会；其目标是抗日。这些新协会将出版月刊，以宣传抗日活动。

THE ARREST OF SUNG CHUN SZ AND OTHERS

A certain newspaper of Peiping recently
published a report to the effect that members of Sung

family are at Peiping, therefore the report published
by the Peiping newspaper is false.

January 12, 1937. Morning Translation. E

Recently, the authorities of the French
Concession adopted a new method of dealing with "Pi-Sais".
Every afternoon, a party of policemen is detailed to
Rue de l'arche, Rue Hue, etc., and any pedestrian who is
somewhat poorly dressed is placed under arrest and bound
together with ropes before being taken to the police
station where he will be put to all kinds of coolie work,
such as sweeping floors, cutting flowers, etc. After
this, he will be kept in room for 24 hours before he is
released.

It is learned that during the past week
many persons, such as small merchants and workers who
are not "pi-Sais", have been arrested by the French police.
It is to be hoped that the Chinese Ratepayers Association
will request the police not to commit such mistakes.

China Times and other local newspapers:-

THE ARREST OF SEVEN REACTIONARY SUSPECTS

Sung Chun Sz and six other reactionary
suspects who were arrested in Shanghai and later transferred
to Soochow have made statements at the Procuratorate of
the Soochow High Court.

In their statements, the suspects state
that they held meetings on December 12, the birth-day
anniversary of Dr. Sun Yat Sen, at the Youths Federation,
the Young Women's Federation and the Ningpo Fellow
Provincials Association in Shanghai.

The High Court at Soochow has requested
the Second Branch of the Kiangsu High Court in Shanghai
to make enquiries to check these statements.

On the morning of January 9, the Second
Branch of the Kiangsu High Court summoned for interrogation
Hsu Yi (徐逸) of the Youths Federation, Chang Chih Hsueh (張志學)
of the Young Women's Federation and Tung Chin Ching of 董琴卿
the Ningpo Fellow Provincials Association.

According to a statement made by Hsu Yi,
the Youths Federation has no auditorium and no meetings
were held in the Federation on that day. The rooms of the
Federation were all occupied on that day but he could not
say whether or not conferences were held in the rooms.

According to Chang Chih Hsueh's statement,
Sung Chun Sz had once written to him requesting that the
auditorium of the Young Women's Federation be loaned for
holding a meeting on December 12. When the request was
referred to the S.M.C., permission for the meeting could
not be secured, therefore Sung's request was rejected.
However, on December 12, a large number of people called
at the Federation but as the latter refused to accommodate
them in the auditorium, they assembled in the compound.
As the day was a holiday, only foreign members of the
Managing Committee were present in the Federation and they
could not say whether Sung Chun Sz and others were among
the crowd which had gathered in the compound.

According to a statement made by Tung Chin
Ching, he received a telephone call on December 12 at the

1937年1月12日。上午译件。E

近期，法租界当局采取了一种处理“皮萨伊”（Pi-Sais，音译，指乞丐或流浪汉）的新方法。每天下午，一队警察被派往阿尔克路（Rue de l'arche）、胡路（Rue Hue，音译）等地，任何衣着稍显破旧的行人都会被逮捕，并用绳索捆绑在一起，随后被带往警察局，在那里被迫从事各种苦力工作，如扫地、修剪花草等。此后，他们将被关押在房间内24小时，然后予以释放。

据悉，在过去一周内，许多并非“皮萨伊”的人，如小商贩和工人，被法国警察逮捕。希望华人纳税会能要求警方不要犯此类错误。

《时事新报》及其他本地报纸：

逮捕七名反动嫌疑犯

在上海被捕并随后被转移至苏州的宋春霖及其他六名反动嫌疑犯，已在苏州高等法院检察处作了陈述。

在陈述中，嫌疑犯称他们于12月12日孙中山博士诞辰纪念日，在上海的青年联合会、女青年联合会和宁波同乡会举行了会议。

苏州高等法院已请求位于上海的江苏高等法院第二分院进行调查，以核实这些陈述。

1月9日上午，江苏高等法院第二分院传唤青年联合会的徐逸（徐逸）、女青年联合会的张志学（張志學）以及宁波同乡会的董琴卿（董琴卿）前来接受审讯。

据徐逸陈述，青年联合会没有礼堂，当天联合会在内并未举行任何会议。当天联合会的所有房间都被占用，但他无法说明房间内是否举行了会议。

据张志学陈述，宋春霖曾写信给他，请求借用女青年联合会的礼堂于12月12日举行会议。当此请求转呈工部局（S.M.C.）时，未能获得会议许可，因此拒绝了宋的请求。然而，12月12日，大量人员来到联合会，由于联合会拒绝让他们使用礼堂，这些人便聚集在院子里。由于当天是假日，联合会管理委员会中只有外籍委员在场，他们无法说明宋春霖等人是否在聚集于院子的人群中。

据董琴卿陈述，他于12月12日在
