摘自1936年2月10日的情报报告
--------------

本地华商银行职员拟组建救国会

2月9日上午10时45分，约三百名本地华商银行的中国职员在西藏路480号宁波同乡会举行会议，决定组织一个救国会。以下人员发表了谴责南京政府软弱及一般性日本帝国主义的演讲：

潘仰尧（Pan Niang-yao，音译），法租界维隆路（Route Voyron）80号中华职业教育社指导部主任，兼静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）170号四行储蓄会高级职员。

李公朴（Li Kung-poh），南京路大陆商场良友补习学校校长。

沈儒（Sung Chun-su，音译），上海法学院院长。

王造时（Weng Zao-da，音译），光华大学前教授。

会议于中午12时15分结束。

pages.en:
S.1, Special Branch
February 8, 1936.

Cultural Circles National Salvation Association -
soliciting contributions from the public.

About two hundred prominent Chinese educationalists
held a meeting in the Ningpo Fellow Countrymen's Association
building, 430 Thibet Road, at 3.30 p.m. December 28, 1935,
for the purpose of inaugurating the Shanghai Cultural Circles
National Salvation Association. An executive committee of
27 members including the following were elected :-
Ma Siang-pah (馬相伯), an aged politician.
Sung Chun-su (沈鈞儒), a committee member of the
Chinese National Bar Association and Dean of the
Shanghai College of Law, Kiangwan.
Huang Ning-tsz (黃任之), a Chinese educationalist.
Kiang Wen-yu (江問漁), Chief of the Office of the
Chung Hwa Vocational Education Society, 80 Route
Vallon.

The principal promoter of this movement is Sung Chun-su
(沈鈞儒), who resides at No.53 Dao Yuen Fang (桃源坊), Yu
Yuen Road, and his house will be used as a communication
address for the time being. No.53 Dao Yuen Fang (桃源坊)
is located off an Extra Settlement road.

This Association published an advertisement in the February
1st Issue of the "People's Livelihood," soliciting contributions
from the public towards a fund for the furtherance of the
following purposes :-
1. To initiate a special system of education during the period
of national crisis.
2. To intensify the propaganda bearing on the national salvation
movement.

1936年2月8日。

文化界救国会——向公众募捐。

1935年12月28日下午3时30分，约两百名知名中国教育家在西藏路430号宁波同乡会大楼举行会议，旨在成立上海文化界救国会。选举产生了由27名成员组成的执行委员会，其中包括以下人员：
马相伯（Ma Siang-pah，音译），年老的政治家。
沈钧儒（Sung Chun-su，音译），中华全国律师协会委员，江湾上海法学院院长。
黄任之（Huang Ning-tsz，音译），中国教育家。
江问渔（Kiang Wen-yu，音译），法租界瓦隆路（Route Vallon）80号中华职业教育社办事处主任。

这一运动的主要发起人是沈钧儒（Sung Chun-su，音译），他居住在桃源坊53号，其住所暂时用作通讯地址。桃源坊53号位于越界筑路区域附近。

该会在2月1日出版的《民生》杂志上刊登广告，向公众募集资金，以促进以下目的：
1. 在国家危机时期启动特种教育制度。
2. 加强有关救国运动的宣传。

Reg. No. 7/84276 Stn. LOUZA Procurator ... Judge Yih.

Accused Executive of the Ningpo Guild, Yu Ya Ching Road.
Charge To appear at the 2nd Branch of Kiangsu High Court at 9.30a.m. on the 9-1-37 (Court No. 1) to answer certain interrogations in connection with the case against Sung Chun Lu et al, on a charge of committing acts with intent to injure the Republic of China.

IN THE KIANGSU HIGH COURT AT A.M.

Mr. Kum appeared for the ... Council:-

Proceedings.
Judge to Toung Sing Ching, executive of the Ningpo Guild:-
Q. This Court will ask you several questions in connection with a case against Sung Chun Lu et al on a charge of committing acts with intent to injure the Republic of China, and you must tell truth and nothing but the truth. (Bond signed). Now state what do you know about this case?
A. On the afternoon on or about 12-11-36, several police officers came to our Guild and asked us if we had granted anyone to use our hall to hold a meeting, and I answered in the negative. I had never permitted anyone to use our hall on that day for any purpose. About 2p.m., I saw a number of people standing outside our Guild on the road, and a friend of mine who is a press reporter telephoned to me, stating that he heard that Sung Chun Lu would convene a meeting at our Guild at also at the Y.M.C.A. I told him that I had never permitted anyone to convene a meeting in our Guild. Later, the Police Officers asked me to write a paper, assuring them that I had allowed no person to hold any meeting in our premises on that day, and I did so. About 3p.m., the people who stood on the road gradually scattered, and the police also left.

Judge to Mr. Kum:-
Q. Have the Police any report in this connection?
A. The Political section may have such a report.
Q. If so, this Court would like to read it?
A. Yes.

（左侧手写批注：Copies of reports sent to Haeen 11/1/37 OK）

被告 宁波同乡会执行委员，余姚路。
指控 于1937年1月9日上午9时30分（第一法庭）出席江苏高等法院第二分院，就沈钧儒（Sung Chun Lu，音译）等人被控犯有危害中华民国罪一案回答若干质询。

上午在江苏高等法院。

顾先生（Mr. Kum，音译）代表 ... 理事会出庭：-

诉讼程序。
法官问宁波同乡会执行委员唐星清（Toung Sing Ching，音译）：-
问. 本庭将就沈钧儒（Sung Chun Lu，音译）等人被控犯有危害中华民国罪一案向你提出几个问题，你必须如实陈述，不得隐瞒。（签署保结）。现在陈述你对本案所知情况？
答. 1936年11月12日下午左右，几名警官来到我们会馆，询问我们是否允许任何人使用我们的礼堂举行会议，我予以否认。我从未允许任何人在那天将会馆用于任何目的。下午2点左右，我看到许多人站在我们会馆外的路上，我的一位记者朋友打电话给我，说他听说沈钧儒将在我们会馆以及青年会召集会议。我告诉他，我从未允许任何人在我们会馆召集会议。后来，警官要求我写一份书面保证，向他们证明我没有允许任何人在那天在我们的场所举行任何会议，我照办了。下午3点左右，站在路上的人逐渐散去，警察也离开了。

法官问顾先生（Mr. Kum）：-
问. 警方是否有与此相关的报告？
答. 政治股可能有此类报告。
问. 如果有，本庭希望阅读该报告？
答. 是的。

（左侧手写批注：报告副本已于1937年1月11日发送至Haeen（音译），核准）

Accused Executive of the Y.M.C.A. of China, National Committee, Yuen Ming

Charge To appear at the 2nd Branch Kiangsu High Court at 9.30 a.m. on
9-1-37 (Court No. 1) to answer certain informations in connec-
tion with intent to injure the Republic of China.
Complainant:- S.P.

IN THE KIANGSU 2ND BRANCH HIGH COURT AM.

Mr. Kum appeared for the S.M. Council.

Proceedings.
Judge to see Yih, executive of the Y.M.C.A. of China:-
This Court has been requested by the Kiangsu High Court to ask
you several questions in connection with Sung Chung Lu's case, and
you must speak only truth and nothing but truth (bond signed).
Sung Chung Lu stated that on the 31-5-36, a meeting was held at
your association on Yuen Ming Yuen Rd. Is this correct?
A. No, there was no such meeting held.
Q. Is your association situated on Yuen Ming Yuen Rd?
A. Yes, our premises consist of 8 stories, about 100 rooms. Most
of the offices are rented to others, and our association is on the
top floor. There is no big hall in our house, and no meeting could
be held.
Q. Is it possible that a meeting was held but you did not know?
A. Probably, our tenants held some small meetings without my
knowledge. If there was a large number of people attending to the
meeting, we must know it. We have questioned our watchman and
several coolies, and they said that no meeting was held on that
day, which was a holiday.
Q. So there was no meeting held on that day to your knowledge?
A. No.

Decision
CCLOO. Witness acquitted, a reply to be made.

被告 上海圆明园路中华全国基督教协进会执行委员。

指控 于1937年1月9日上午9时30分（第一法庭）出席江苏高等法院第二分院，就有关危害中华民国意图回答若干质询。
原告：- 特别巡捕。

上午在江苏高等法院第二分院。

顾先生（Mr. Kum，音译）代表上海工部局理事会出庭。

诉讼程序。
法官问中华全国基督教协进会执行委员谢怡（see Yih，音译，结合上下文可能指代某位具体负责人，但原文如此）：-
江苏高等法院请求本庭就沈钧儒（Sung Chung Lu，音译）一案向你提出几个问题，你只能讲真话，不得隐瞒（签署保结）。
沈钧儒陈述，1936年5月31日，在你们位于圆明园路的协会举行了一次会议。这是否正确？
答. 不，没有举行过这样的会议。
问. 你们的协会位于圆明园路吗？
答. 是的，我们的房产包括8层楼，约100个房间。大部分办公室出租给他人，我们协会在顶层。我们楼内没有大礼堂，无法举行会议。
问. 是否有可能举行了会议而你不知道？
答. 有可能，我的租户在我不知情的情况下举行了一些小型会议。如果有大量人员参加会议，我们一定会知道。我们询问了看门人和几名苦力，他们说那天是假日，没有举行会议。
问. 所以据你所知，那天没有举行会议？
答. 没有。

裁决
CCLOO. 证人无罪释放，需作出回复。

PROCEEDINGS.
Judge to Tsang Ts Hsueh:- This Court will ask you several
questions in connection with the case of Sung Chun Zu et al, and
you must speak truth and only truth. (Bond signed).
Q. Are you acquainted with Sung Chun Zu?
A. No, but I know his name.
Q. Do you know that he and others organized a union to assist
the strikers?
A. I don't know.
Q. And the meeting to inaugurate this union was held at your
association?
A. No. Prior to 13-11-36, we received a letter from Sung Chun Zu
(proposed), requesting us to lend our hall to him on that day in
order to enable him to convene a meeting in memory of the late
Dr. Sun Yat-sen. He further informed us, that due permission
had been obtained from the Municipal Council and that he could
produce a permit from the Council. We waited until 4p.m. on
11-11-36, but he did not send the permit to us. We therefore
telephoned to the Council, and were informed that they had never
permitted Sung Chun Zu to convene such a meeting. Consequently,
we rung up to Sung and he told us he would not hold the meeting
at our premises. 12-11-36, was a holiday, and we did not go to
our office except a foreigner named Mr. Perkins. In that after-
noon, about 1,000 persons came to our premises, and as we had
not given them permission to hold any meeting, Mr. Perkins refused

诉讼程序。
法官问张志学:- 本庭将就宋春祖等人案件问你几个问题，
你必须只讲真话。（已具结保释）。
问. 你认识宋春祖吗？
答. 不认识，但我知道他的名字。
问. 你知道他和其他人组织了一个工会来援助罢工者吗？
答. 我不知道。
问.  inaugurating 这个工会的会议是在你们的协会举行的吗？
答. 不是。在36年11月13日之前，我们收到宋春祖（拟）的来信，请求我们在当天将会堂借给他，以便他召开纪念孙中山博士逝世的会议。他还通知我们，已获得市公董局的许可，并且他可以出示公董局的许可证。我们等到36年11月11日下午4点，但他没有把许可证寄给我们。因此我们打电话给公董局，得知他们从未允许宋春祖召开此类会议。于是我们打电话给宋，他告诉我们他不会在我们的场所举行会议。36年11月12日是假日，除了一个叫珀金斯 (Perkins) 的外国人外，我们没有去办公室。那天下午，大约1000人来到我们的场所，由于我们没有允许他们举行任何会议，珀金斯先生拒绝

ground where they held a meeting. Mr. Perkins told us that the
meeting was quite orderly, but he did not understand what were
they discussing.
Q. Was Sung Chun Lu present during the meeting?
A. I don't know. During the meeting, numerous police officers
attended.
Q. How long did they hold the meeting?
A. For about two hours.
Q. Were there any handbills distributed?

July 26, 1937.
4
Afternoon Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

THE CASE AGAINST THE NATIONAL SALVATION LEADERS

No news has yet been received as to the date for the next hearing of the case against Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒), Tsang Nai-chi (章乃器), Li Kung-poh (李公樸), Wong Zao-dz (王造時), Tseu Tao-fun (鄒韜奮), Soo Chi-li (沙千里) and Sz Liang (史良), the seven leaders of the National Salvation Association. The case was last heard on June 25 and was remanded for the purpose of obtaining a file from the Military Affairs Commission.

During the period of remand, numerous friends of Sung Chun-dz and the others, as well as many bona fide persons working for national salvation, requested the authorities to withdraw the charges or quickly to pronounce Sung and the others not guilty on the ground that the advocacy of the prisoners for unification and resistance against aggression did not in any way contradict the policy of the National Government. It is said that the Presiding Judge in this case is making a thorough examination of the evidence produced by the procurator, such as the Manifesto of the Inaugural Meeting of the All-China National Salvation Federation, a publication entitled "Some Fundamental Conditions and Minimum Demands Regarding Unification and Resistance against Aggression" etc., in order to eliminate misinterpretation of the texts.

Although it was alleged by the procurator that Sung Chun-dz and the others had instigated the Sian Incident, it is learned that the file kept by the Military Affairs Commission in connection with the case of Chang Hsueh-liang does not contain anything which may prove any conspiracy between the arrested persons and military officers. After the Lukouchiao Incident occurred, the seven arrested persons sent a joint telegram to General Chiang Kai-shek supporting the latter's views regarding the incident. This shows that their patriotic sentiments are unchanged. It is thought that the authorities will not incarcerate the national salvation leaders in prison much longer.

Chuin Chung Sin Wan (群衆新聞):

PEOPLE'S LECTURE GROUP FORMED TO EDUCATE PEASANTS

In view of the fact that 90% of the Chinese, especially the peasants and villagers, are uneducated and have no national understanding, Niao Chung-ying (倪仲英), Zang Tso-ming (常竹銘), Hung Kuo-hwei (洪國煒) and other Chinese youths in this locality have formed a body known as the "People's Group to Lecture on Aversion of the Nation from Extinction". The group in question has some 30 members, both male and female, who undergo training between 3 and 10 p.m. daily. Many people from various local circles have joined the organization.
pages.zh:
1937年7月26日。
4
下午译文。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：

救国会领袖案

关于沈钧儒、章乃器、李公樸、王造時、鄒韜奮、沙千里和史良等七位全国救国会领袖案件的下次开庭日期，目前尚未收到消息。该案上次审理是在6月25日，因需从军事委员会获取一份档案而延期。

在延期期间，沈钧儒等人的众多朋友，以及许多从事救国工作的真诚人士，以囚犯所倡导的统一和抵抗侵略与国民政府的政策并不矛盾为由，请求当局撤销指控或迅速宣判沈钧儒等人无罪。据悉，本案主审法官正在仔细审查检察官提交的证据，如《全中国救国联合会成立大会宣言》、题为《关于统一和抵抗侵略的一些基本条件和最低要求》的出版物等，以消除对文本的误解。

虽然检察官指控沈钧儒等人煽动了西安事变，但据了解，军事委员会保存的关于张学良案件的档案中，没有任何内容可以证明被捕人员与军官之间存在任何阴谋。卢沟桥事变发生后，七名被捕者联名致电蒋介石将军，支持蒋将军对该事变的看法。这表明他们的爱国情怀未变。人们认为，当局不会将救国会领袖长期监禁。

《群众新闻》：

组建民众演讲团以教育农民

鉴于90%的中国人，尤其是农民和村民，未受教育且缺乏国家意识，本地的倪仲英、常竹銘、洪國煒等中国青年组建了一个名为“抗亡救国民众演讲团”的组织。该团体约有30名男女成员，每天下午3时至10时接受培训。来自各界的许多人加入了该组织。

pages.en:
Chun Chung Sin Wan (群衆週刊) :-
MADAME SUN YAT-SEN AND MANY OTHERS SUPPORT NATIONAL SALVATION
With a view to backing their opinion that
it is not a crime to work for national salvation, Madame
Sun Yat-sen and 15 others have promoted a movement to
surrender themselves to prison for national salvation.
It is learned that up till now, more than
2,000 persons, including members of every walk of life,
have joined into this movement. It is to be noted that
this movement was promoted for the purpose of bringing about
the release of the seven arrested leaders of the National
Salvation Association as well as for struggling for the
decision that it is not a crime to work for the salvation
of the nation.
pages.zh:
《群众周刊》：
孙夫人及多人支持救国运动
为了支持他们关于从事救国工作并非犯罪的观点，孙逸仙夫人及其他15人发起了一项“救国入狱运动”。据悉，截至目前，已有包括各界人士在内的2000多人加入了这项运动。值得注意的是，发起这项运动的目的是促使释放被捕的七位全国救国会领袖，并争取确立从事救国工作并非犯罪的判决。

July 8, 1937.
Morning Translation.

Ta Kung Pao and other local newspapers (Soochow Telegram) :-
THE CASE AGAINST THE NATIONAL SALVATION LEADERS : PERIOD
FOR THEIR DETENTION EXTENDED

Sung Chun-dz (沈儒) and the six
others, who are charged with offences against internal
security of the State, received on July 6 the following
judgment from the Kiangsu High Court as regards the
extension of their detention period:-
"The accused in this case, who are
charged with offences against the internal security of
the Republic, have been under detention in this Court
since April 5 last. However, despite the fact that the
three months' detention period has expired, the
investigation into the evidence of this case is still
incomplete and it is, therefore, necessary to prolong
the period of the detention of the accused. Consequently,
the period of their detention is extended for a further
period of two months as from July 5 in accordance with
the provisions of Article 108, Sections 1 and 2, of the
Code of Criminal Procedure."
Upon receipt of this judgment, the
accused requested the Kiangsu High Court to resume the
hearing of the case as soon as possible on the ground
that they had already been under detention for a
considerable length of time.

Lih Pao and other local newspapers (Nanking Telegram) :-
President of Court Seeks Instructions in Nanking

Mr. Chu Shih-sung (朱樹聲), President
of the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow, arrived in Nanking
from Soochow on the morning of July 7 for the purpose of
seeking instructions from Mr. Wong Yung-ping (王用賓),
Minister of Justice, in connection with the case against
the seven national salvation leaders.

China Times and other local newspapers :-
NEW MANAGER OF TASS NEWS AGENCY IN CHINA APPOINTED

The Head Office of the Tass News Agency
in Moscow has appointed Mr. "Lokeff", Manager of the
Nanking Branch of the News Agency, to succeed Mr. "Sotoff",
who has died, as Manager of the Tass News Agency in China.
He will be assisted by Mr. "Pifusum" who is now on his
way to Shanghai.
Mr. "Lokeff" was formerly Editor-in-Chief
of the "Manchurian Mirror," a publication of the Chinese
Eastern Railway, and held important posts in the World
Finance and Politics Research Committee.

1937年7月8日。
上午译文。

《大公报》及其他本地报纸（苏州电）：
救国会领袖案：拘留期延长

沈儒（Sung Chun-dz，此处原文为沈儒，前文为沈钧儒）及其他六人被控危害国内治安罪，于7月6日收到江苏高等法院关于延长其拘留期的判决如下：-
“本案被告被控危害民国治安罪，自今年4月5日起一直被羁押于本院。然而，尽管三个月的拘留期已满，但本案证据调查尚不完整，因此有必要延长被告的拘留期。据此，根据《刑事诉讼法》第108条第1款和第2款之规定，自7月5日起，将其拘留期再延长两个月。”
收到此判决后，被告以已被拘留相当长时间为由，请求江苏高等法院尽快恢复审理此案。

《立报》及其他本地报纸（南京电）：
法院院长赴南京请示

苏州江苏高等法院院长朱树声先生于7月7日上午从苏州抵达南京，就七位救国会领袖一案向司法部长王用宾先生请示。

《字林西报》及其他本地报纸：
塔斯社驻华新任经理任命

莫斯科塔斯社总社任命该社南京分社经理“Lokeff”先生接替已故的“Sotoff”先生，担任塔斯社驻华经理。他将由目前正在前往上海的“Pifusum”先生协助。
“Lokeff”先生曾任中东铁路出版物《满洲镜报》的主编，并在世界金融与政治研究委员会担任重要职务。

July 7, 1937.
Morning Translation

Shun Pao and other local newspapers :-

LOCAL SETTLEMENT FILM AND DRAMA CENSORSHIP ABOLITION MOVEMENT
COMMITTEE TO ENTERTAIN JOURNALISTS ON JULY 9

The Preparatory Committee of the Shanghai
Cultural Circles' Settlement Film and Drama Censorship
Abolition Movement Committee, which has been formed by
various cultural bodies and individuals in this locality,
will entertain local Chinese and foreign newspaper reporters
at 4 p.m. July 9 in the auditorium of the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce, North Soochow Road.

Eastern Daily News (東方日報) of July 6 :-

Settlement Film Censorship Abolition Movement

The other day about 10 cultural bodies in
Shanghai held a meeting at which it was decided to form
a committee to undertake the work of abolishing the film
and drama censorship in the Settlement.
We cannot achieve our end merely by holding
meetings and issuing manifestoes and circular telegrams.
We have already said that it is not a difficult task to
abolish the censorship; the exhibition of the film "The
New Earth" in defiance of the censorship supports our
contention. The first thing to do is to ask ourselves
about our power. If we endeavour to bring about the
abolition simply on the strength of justice, the result
will be nil.
What practical measures has the Shanghai
Cultural Circles' Settlement Film and Drama Censorship
Abolition Movement Committee in stock besides holding
meetings and issuing manifestoes?

Ta Kung Pao publishes the following brief comment :-

The movement for the abolition of Settlement
film and drama censorship should interest every public body.
Concrete plans and schemes of work must be
drawn up and any victory, no matter how indecisive, will be
better than none. If the movement meets with failure, then
Chinese dramas and films will face obstacles more unreasonable
and cruel than before.

Social Evening News of July 6 :-

MADAME SUN YAT-SEN AND HER PARTY RETURN TO SHANGHAI

Madame Sun Yat-sen and her party, including Hu
Yu-ts (胡愈之), Chen Pu-erh (陳波兒) and Chu Tsai-lai (諸青來),
who left for Soochow by train at 8 a.m. July 5 to visit Sung
Chun-dz and the six other leaders of the National Salvation
Association, returned to Shanghai at 11 p.m. the same day.
According to Hu Yu-ts, the result of the trip
to Soochow was satisfactory; the date for a further trip has
not yet been arranged.

1937年7月7日。
上午译件

《申报》及其他本地报纸：-

租界电影戏剧审查废除运动委员会将于7月9日招待记者

由本地各文化团体及个人组成的上海文化界租界电影戏剧审查废除运动委员会筹备会，将于7月9日下午4时在北苏州路华商总公会礼堂招待本地中外报社记者。

7月6日《东方日报》：

租界电影审查废除运动

日前，上海约十个文化团体举行会议，决定成立一个委员会，负责开展废除租界内电影及戏剧审查的工作。
仅靠召开会议、发表宣言和通电，我们无法达到目的。我们已说过，废除审查并非难事；电影《新地球》无视审查进行放映，便支持了我们的论点。首先要问的是我们自身的力量。如果仅凭正义感来谋求废除，结果将一无所获。
除了召开会议和发表宣言外，上海文化界租界电影戏剧审查废除运动委员会还有什么实际措施储备？

《大公报》发表如下简短评论：

废除租界电影及戏剧审查的运动应引起每个公共团体的关注。
必须制定具体的计划和工作方案，任何胜利，无论多么不彻底，都总比没有好。如果运动失败，那么中国戏剧和电影将面临比以前更不合理、更残酷的障碍。

7月6日《社会晚报》：

孙逸仙夫人及其一行返回上海

孙逸仙夫人及其一行，包括胡愈之、陈波儿和诸青来，于7月5日上午8时乘火车前往苏州，拜访沈钧儒及全国救国会其他六位领导人，并于当晚11时返回上海。
据胡愈之称，苏州之行结果令人满意；进一步行程的日期尚未安排。

pages.en:
July 7, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Tien Hsia Daily News (天下日報) (Soochow correspondence) :-

MADAME SUN YAT-SEN AND NATIONAL SALVATION LEADERS

On the morning of July 5, Madame Sun Yat-sen and ten others left Shanghai by train for Soochow and arrived there at 9.14 a.m. They proceeded to the High Court and called on Mr. Chu Shih-sung (朱树声), the President, and Mr. Sung Hung-ling (孙鸿霖), the Chief Procurator of the Court.

In view of the fact that they had been engaged in the work for national salvation together with Sun Chun-dz and the six other national salvation leaders, Madame Sun and the others requested that they themselves be detained and tried with Sung and the others.

President Chu replied that he was in sympathy with the patriotism of the callers, but that in the capacity of President, he could not interfere in the trial of the case. He added that the demand submitted by the callers for their detention should be made to the Chief Procurator.

Madame Sun and the others repeated the request for their detention before the Chief Procurator. The Chief Procurator replied that the case against Sung Chun-dz and the others had not yet been concluded and that it was hard to surmise the judgment of the case. So it was not necessary, the Chief Procurator added, to answer their request. He advised the callers to return to Shanghai and then left owing to pressure of work.

As no result had been obtained, Madame Sun and the other callers remained at the Court. The Court does not open in the afternoon at present and no one appeared to see the callers until nightfall. The callers therefore prepared bedding, food and mosquito extermination incense for the purpose of remaining at the Court for the night, until a definite reply had been given by the Court.

At 6.30 p.m. the President of the Court sent Procurator Hsia to open negotiations with the callers and explained the difficulties of the Court. Finally, the following four points were discussed and made definite :-
1) That the National Salvation Association be recognized as having not committed a crime.
2) That the request submitted by the callers be investigated.
3) That the Court accept and deal with any evidence submitted by Madame Sun and others.
4) That similar action be taken if any other members of the National Salvation Association submit a request for investigation.

The abovementioned four points were written on paper and President Chu and Procurator indicated their agreement with them. Madame Sun and the others then left the Court for Shanghai at 8 p.m. the same day.

Madame Sun intends to submit evidence for investigation by the Court.
pages.zh:
1937年7月7日。
下午译件。

《天下日报》（苏州通讯）：-

孙逸仙夫人与救国领袖

7月5日上午，孙逸仙夫人等十人乘火车离开上海前往苏州，于上午9时14分抵达。他们随即前往高等法院，拜会院长朱树声先生和法院首席检察官宋洪霖先生。

鉴于他们曾与沈钧儒及其他六位救国领袖共同从事救国工作，孙夫人等人请求将他们自己与沈钧儒等人一并拘留并受审。

朱院长回答说，他对来访者的爱国精神表示同情，但作为院长，他不能干涉案件的审理。他补充说，来访者提出的拘留请求应向首席检察官提出。

孙夫人等人在首席检察官面前再次提出拘留请求。首席检察官回答说，针对沈钧儒等人的案件尚未审结，很难推测案件的判决结果。因此，首席检察官补充说，没有必要回应他们的请求。他建议来访者返回上海，随后因公务繁忙而离开。

由于未获结果，孙夫人及其他来访者留在法院。目前法院下午不办公，直到天黑也没有人出来见来访者。因此，来访者准备了被褥、食物和灭蚊香，打算在法院过夜，直到法院给出明确答复。

下午6时30分，法院院长派遣夏检察官与来访者进行谈判，并解释了法院的困难。最后，讨论并确定了以下四点：
1) 确认全国救国会并未犯罪。
2) 调查来访者提出的请求。
3) 法院接受并处理孙夫人等人提交的任何证据。
4) 如果全国救国会其他成员提交调查请求，采取类似行动。

上述四点写在纸上，朱院长和检察官表示同意。孙夫人等人随后于当晚8时离开法院返回上海。

孙夫人打算提交证据供法院调查。

July 6, 1937.
No. D____
Morning Translation.

China Times and other local newspapers:

EXCHANGE SHOP OWNERS' ASSOCIATION TO DEAL WITH TRAITOROUS MEMBERS

The other day, the Money Exchange Shop Owners' Association received a letter from the Chinese Chamber of Commerce to the effect that recently the Yokohama Specie Bank, the Bank of Taiwan, and other Japanese banks received large quantities of banknotes of the "Central Bank of Manchukuo" and entrusted the Hung Kong (鴻康) and five other exchange shops to act as agents for the exchange of these banknotes.

Yesterday, the Executive Committee of the Money Exchange Shop Owners' Association held an urgent meeting owing to the fact that the Hung Kong and two others of the six exchange shops are members of the Association, and it was considered that measures to stop such action on the part of their members should be devised.

Upon reading a report from the "Lih Pao" to the effect that they were acting as agents for the Japanese banks to undertake the exchange of "Manchukuo" banknotes, the Hung Kong and two other exchange shops, who are members of the Association, were greatly surprised and immediately sent a joint letter to the Association stating that they had nothing to do with the matter and requesting that an investigation be carried out.

An investigation conducted by the Association reveals that the report is absolutely untrue.

Fearing that traitorous merchants may privately undertake the exchange of "Manchukuo" banknotes, the Money Exchange Shop Owners' Association has issued a notification to its members warning them to refrain from acting as agents in this connection.

It is understood that the Association will hold an oath-taking ceremony against dealing in the bogus State's banknotes.

Hwa Mei Wan Pao dated June 5:

PROMINENT WOMEN JOURNEY TO SOOCHOW OVER NATIONAL SALVATION TRIAL

Mesdames Sun Yat-sen and Liao Chung-kai and 14 others, including one Miss Chen Pu-erh (陳波兒), a local movie star, left here by train for Soochow at 8 a.m. July 5 for the purpose of calling upon Mr. Chu Shih-sung (朱樹聲), the President, and Mr. Sung Hung-ling (宋洪齡), the Chief Procurator of the Kiangsu High Court, in connection with the case against Sung Chun-tz (沈鈞儒) and the six other national salvation leaders.

They returned to Shanghai the same night.

The "Tien Hsia Daily News" reports that the motive of Mesdames Sun Yat-sen and Liao Chung-kai in paying a visit to the President of the Kiangsu High Court was to request him to place them under detention should Sung Chun-tz and the six other leaders of the National Salvation Association be found guilty.

1937年7月6日。
编号 D____
上午译件。

《时报》及其他本地报纸：

钱庄业同业公会处置汉奸会员

日前，钱庄业同业公会收到华商总公会来信，称近期横滨正金银行、台湾银行等日本银行接收了大量“满洲中央银行”钞票，并委托鸿康等五家钱庄代理兑换这些钞票。

昨日，鉴于六家钱庄中的鸿康等两家是该公会会员，钱庄业同业公会执行委员会召开紧急会议，认为应制定措施制止其会员的此类行为。

鸿康及其他两家身为公会会员的钱庄在阅读《立报》关于它们代理日本银行兑换“满洲”钞票的报道后，大为震惊，立即联名致信公会，声明与此事无关，并要求进行调查。

经公会调查，该报道完全不实。

由于担心奸商私下从事“满洲”钞票兑换业务，钱庄业同业公会已向会员发出通知，警告他们不要在此方面充当代理。

据悉，该公会将举行宣誓仪式，承诺不交易伪国钞票。

6月5日《华美晚报》：

知名女性因救国审判案赴苏州

孙逸仙夫人、廖仲恺夫人及其他14人，包括本地电影明星陈波儿小姐，于7月5日上午8时由此乘火车前往苏州，目的是就沈钧儒及其他六位救国领袖一案，拜会江苏高等法院院长朱树声先生和首席检察官宋洪霖先生。

他们于当晚返回上海。

据《天下日报》报道，孙逸仙夫人和廖仲恺夫人拜访江苏高等法院院长的动机是，如果沈钧儒及全国救国会其他六位领袖被判有罪，请求院长将她们也予以拘留。

June 29, 1937. Afternoon Translation

Hwa Mei Wan Pao dated June 28 published the following special correspondence from Tientsin :-

CHINESE TRAITOR RECEIVES IMPORTANT POSITION IN NORTH CHINA

Liu Kwei-tong (刘桂堂), a notorious traitor, has recently been appointed by the Japanese Kwantung Army as Commander-in-Chief of the Bogus Anti-Red Forces in North China. He left Tientsin for Northern Chahar on June 26 in company with two Japanese for the purpose of establishing his headquarters. He was issued by the Japanese Kwantung Army with the huge sum of $600,000 which will be used exclusively for the purpose of enrolling bandits from various places in North China as a means of counter-attack against the People's Self-Defence Forces in North Chahar. He was recommended to the Japanese Kwantung Army by a Japanese named Miura, Chairman of the Anti-Red Hsin Loong Association in North China.

In Tientsin, traitors Bai Chien-ho (白坚武) and Heh Pang (郝鹏) are engaged in activities for the enrolling of disgruntled military officers. With a view to averting public attention to their activities, they are using the French Park in the French Concession in Tientsin as the place for assembly and discussions. Both of them are in the pay of the Japanese Kwantung Army.

Kuo Min Weekly (国民周刊), Volume 1, Issue No. 8, published the following article :-

THE NATIONAL SALVATION TRIAL

Two weeks have elapsed since the petition was submitted by the seven national salvation leaders for the withdrawal of the Judges. The prosecution, however, has still not finished its case and it is known that proceedings will continue on June 25. What will be the outcome of the second hearing of the case, we are at present not in a position to foretell. However, in our opinion, unless the Judges charged with this case are prejudiced, there is no alternative for them but to find the accused not guilty.

The statements made by the accused at the first hearing of the case clearly point in this direction and are a sufficient proof that it was entirely due to their patriotism that the seven accused formed the national salvation association Not only are they not opposed to the administration of the National Government, but they also advocate strongly the unification of the country under the guidance of the Government for the rejuvenation of the nation. Should they have unfavourably criticized the Government in the past for its policy, they are now, however, quite in sympathy with the Government's active policy. On the other hand, it is likewise possible for the Government to be lenient towards them even if some of their past activities are regarded as irregular, especially at this time when the whole nation is unanimously united.

In short, the final outcome of this case will constitute a test of the internal unification of China. We firmly believe that it will bring about good and satisfactory results.

1937年6月29日。下午译件

6月28日《华美晚报》刊登了来自天津的如下特约通讯：-

中国汉奸在华北担任要职

著名汉奸刘桂堂最近被日本关东军任命为华北伪反共军总司令。他于6月26日在两名称日本人的陪同下离开天津前往察北，旨在建立总部。日本关东军向他发放了巨额款项60万元，专门用于招募华北各地的匪徒，以对抗察北的人民自卫武装。他是被华北反共新龙协会主席、名为三浦的日本人推荐给日本关东军的。

在天津，汉奸白坚武和郝鹏正在从事招募不满军官的活动。为了避开公众对其活动的注意，他们利用天津法租界的法国公园作为集会和讨论的场所。两人均受雇于日本关东军。

《国民周刊》第一卷第八期发表了如下文章：-

救国审判案

七位救国领袖提交撤换法官的申请已有两周。然而，检方尚未完成举证，据悉诉讼程序将于6月25日继续。案件第二次听证的结果如何，我们目前无法预测。但是，在我们看来，除非负责此案的法官存有偏见，否则他们别无选择，只能裁定被告无罪。

被告在案件第一次听证时的陈述清楚地指向这一方向，并充分证明七名被告组成救国会完全出于他们的爱国心。他们不仅不反对国民政府的行政，还强烈主张在政府指导下实现国家统一，以振兴民族。如果他们过去曾因政策问题对政府进行过不利批评，但现在他们完全同情政府的积极政策。另一方面，即使他们过去的一些活动被视为违规，政府也有可能对他们从宽处理，尤其是在当前举国一致团结的时刻。

总之，此案的最终结果将构成对中国内部统一的考验。我们坚信，这将带来良好且令人满意的结果。

pages.en:
June 28, 1937.

MAINICHI

THE TRIAL OF THE SEVEN ARRESTED LEADERS

The Mainichi publishes the
following articles:-
The trial of the seven arrested
leaders of the anti-Japanese popular front movement continued
at the Kiangsu High Court on June 25. The prisoners
denied connection with the Communist Party, the Sian incident
and the instigation of Japanese cotton mill strikes though
they admitted that they were anti-Japanese in sentiment.
The important point to be discussed
in the trial is neither the formation of the anti-Japanese
National Salvation Association nor the agitation of the
Japanese cotton mill strike but their activities relating
to the Sian incident. Prior to the Sian incident they
sent a telegram to General Chang Hsueh-liang advising him
to force General Chiang Kai-shek who was in Shensi at that
time, to take anti-Japanese action by means of military strength.
This is a true fact and it leads us to believe that the
accused were connected with the communist party. The
telegraphic suggestion to General Chang Hsueh-liang alone
is enough to constitute a felony which deserves the highest
degree of punishment. The trial is much concerned with
the accused's attitude towards General Chiang Kai-shek.
For this reason, the C. C. Corps and the Blue Shirts Society,
which have been active to strengthen Chiang Kai-shek's
regime at any cost, will undoubtedly be interested. It
will be a difficult matter for the judges as the hand of the
C. C. Corps can be clearly seen behind the Kiangsu High
Court.
The case of the seven arrested
leaders is evidence of the dispute between the National
Government and the Communist Party even after they had
agreed to co-operate. If this dispute grows as the
national unification work progresses it will be a great
danger to the rehabilitation of China.

NIPPO

ANGLO-JAPANESE AND SINO-JAPANESE RELATIONS

The Nippo publishes the following
comment:-
Of late the British Foreign
Secretary, Mr. Eden, stated in the House of Commons that
Anglo-Japanese relations were improving and he also gave
an interesting answer to a question regarding Anglo-Chinese
relations. He further stated that although Great
Britain had had some trouble with Japan regarding economic
affairs in Australia and India, it had been amicably settled
by the great efforts made by the two governments.
It cannot be said that Anglo-
Japanese relations concerning China have always been bad
but the struggle for political and economic influence is
still going on as a result of Japan's industrial progress.

1937年6月28日。

《每日新闻》

七名被捕领袖之审判

《每日新闻》刊登如下文章：——
6月25日，反日人民阵线运动七名被捕领袖的审判在江苏高等法院继续进行。被告否认与共产党、西安事变以及煽动日本棉厂罢工有关联，尽管他们承认自己在情感上是反日的。
审判中讨论的重点既非抗日救国会的成立，也非日本棉厂罢工的鼓动，而是他们与西安事变有关的活动。在西安事变之前，他们曾致电张学良将军，建议他利用军事力量迫使当时在陕西的蒋介石将军采取抗日行动。这是确凿的事实，使我们相信被告与共产党有牵连。仅向张学良将军发出电报建议这一行为，就足以构成应受最高程度惩罚的重罪。审判很大程度上关注被告对蒋介石将军的态度。鉴于此，不惜一切代价致力于加强蒋介石政权的CC系和蓝衣社无疑会对此感兴趣。由于在江苏高等法院背后可以清楚地看到CC系的影响，这对法官来说将是一件难事。
七名被捕领袖的案件表明，即使国民政府与共产党已同意合作，双方之间仍存在争端。如果随着国家统一工作的推进，这种争端加剧，将对中国的复兴构成巨大危险。

《日本日报》

英日关系与中日关系

《日本日报》发表如下评论：——
近日，英国外交大臣艾登先生在下议院表示，英日关系正在改善，他还就有关中英关系的问题作出了有趣的回答。他进一步指出，虽然英国因澳大利亚和印度的经济事务与日本发生过一些纠纷，但经过两国政府的巨大努力，这些纠纷已得到友好解决。
不能说英日关于中国问题的关系一直不好，但由于日本工业的进步，政治和经济影响力的争夺仍在继续。

pages.en:
June 26, 1937.
Morning Translation

Statement of Sung Chun-dz

The following were questions put to Sung Chun-dz
by the Presiding Judge:-
Q: When was the Shanghai Cultural Circles National Salvation
Association inaugurated?
A: In December, 1935.
Q: How many Standing Committee members have the Shanghai
Cultural Circles National Salvation Association: Were
you one of the Standing Committee members?
A: I do not remember now many there were. I was one of them.
Q: When was the Shanghai Various Circles National Salvation
Association inaugurated?
A: At the time of commemorating the anniversary of the
January 28 Incident, in 1936.
Q: Does the Shanghai Various Circles National Salvation
Association include the Vocational Circles National
Salvation Association, the Cultural Circles National
Salvation Association, the Womens Circles National
Salvation Association and the National Crisis Education
Society?
A: Yes, also a Professors' National Salvation Association.
Q: When and where was the All-China National Salvation
Federation inaugurated?
A: On May 31 last year at the Youths' Federation.
Q: What was the object of the National Salvation Association?
A: Very simple, to resist Japan and save the nation. There
was no other object than to resist Japan.
Q: Were the manifesto and the general principles issued by
the All-China National Salvation Federation passed by
the general meeting?
A: Yes.
Q: Who drafted them?
A: Many persons.
Q: Were you among them?
A: Yes.
Q: What were the contents of the manifesto?
A: It beseeched all the parties and cliques in the country
to discard their prejudices and resist Japan under the
leadership of the Government.
Q: What was the idea of the general principles?
A: They were a sort of suggestion made from the people's
standpoint with the hope that the various parties and
cliques would unite to resist Japan.
Q: What was the difference between the terms "people's front"
and "people's national salvation front" used by you?
A: The two terms had different meanings. "People's front"
is one for dealing with internal affairs. For instance,
the people's fronts of France and Spain were formed to
oppose Fascism in these countries. The "people's national
salvation front," on the other hand, advocated the
unification of the country against aggression by the alien
enemy. Furthermore, we never used the term "people's front."
In July last year Tseu Tao-fun wrote an article in the paper
instructing readers not to use the term "people's front"
so as to avoid misunderstandings. In the charge, this
term was cited to accuse us falsely; this is not correct.
Q: You said all parties and cliques should unite. Which
parties and cliques did you mean?
pages.zh:
1937年6月26日。
晨间译稿

宋春霖（Sung Chun-dz）供词

以下为审判长向宋春霖提出的问题：——
问：上海文化界救国会何时成立？
答：1935年12月。
问：上海文化界救国会有多少名常务委员？你是常务委员之一吗？
答：我现在不记得具体人数了。我是其中之一。
问：上海各界救国会何时成立？
答：在1936年纪念“一·二八”事变周年之际。
问：上海各界救国会是否包括职业界救国会、文化界救国会、妇女界救国会和国难教育社？
答：是的，还包括教授救国会。
问：全国各界救国联合会于何时何地成立？
答：去年5月31日，在青年会。
问：救国会的宗旨是什么？
答：很简单，就是抗日救国。除了抗日之外没有其他宗旨。
问：全国各界救国联合会发布的宣言和一般原则是否经大会通过？
答：是的。
问：由谁起草？
答：多人。
问：你也在其中吗？
答：是的。
问：宣言的内容是什么？
答：恳请全国各党派摒弃成见，在政府领导下抗日。
问：一般原则的主旨是什么？
答：这是一种从民众立场提出的建议，希望各党派团结起来抗日。
问：你们使用的“人民阵线”和“人民救国阵线”这两个术语有何区别？
答：这两个术语含义不同。“人民阵线”是处理内部事务的术语。例如，法国和西班牙的人民阵线是为了反对这些国家的法西斯主义而成立的。另一方面，“人民救国阵线”主张国家统一以对抗外来敌人的侵略。此外，我们从未使用过“人民阵线”这一术语。去年7月，邹韬奋在报纸上写了一篇文章，指示读者不要使用“人民阵线”一词，以避免误解。在指控中，引用该术语来诬陷我们；这是不正确的。
问：你说各党派应该团结。你指的是哪些党派？

pages.en:
3
June 26, 1937. Morning Translation

A: The parties meant the Kuomintang, the Communist Party
and the so-called Third Party. The clique meant the
Nationalism Clique. I was a member of the Kuomintang.
Q: By suggesting the cessation of internal strife, do you
oppose the campaign for the suppression of Communists?
A: We are of the opinion that internal friction greatly
diminishes national strength. At that time, the situation
in Kwangtung and Kwangsi was very tense; therefore, we
suggested all parties and cliques should join hands to
offer resistance against Japan.
Q: By suggesting the release of political offenders, do
you mean the Communists?
A: It does not mean the Communists in particular; it means
all those who have been arrested for holding different
political views. For the past few years we have adhered
to this suggestion. For instance, at several meetings
held by the Central Executive Committee of the Kuomintang,
some C.E.C. members had also submitted the same proposal.
Q: The general principles issued by the All-China National
Salvation Federation advocate the introduction of various
parties and cliques to hold a conference. What does this
mean and how is the introduction to be effected?
A: This is simply a suggestion to the various parties and
cliques with the intention to discuss ways and means to
resist Japan.
Q: The general principles advocate the formation of a united
political power of resistance against the enemy. Does it
not mean a re-organization of the Government?
A: No. By the so-called unification, it means that the
Government unifies all the parties and cliques and that
the people, under the leadership of the Government, offer
resistance against Japan. By this, we support the
Government and not oppose it.
Q: What is the guarantee for all the parties and cliques to
join hands to resist Japan?
A: The National Salvation Association is not a political
party; it is meant to unite the various forces together
against external aggression.
Q: It is said in the general principles that sanctions will
be applied against any party which commits a breach. How
are the sanctions to be applied?
A: We suggest that the National Government lead the nation
in the resistance against Japan. If any party fails to
obey, only the National Government will exercise the
authority.
Q: Will the Communists abandon their principles by offering
resistance against Japan?
A: This is a matter concerning the Communists and has nothing
to do with the National Salvation Association. In the
past, certain people said that the Communists would not
abandon their principles to offer resistance against
Japan. But the facts prove that after the Sian Coup
the Communists were willing to give up their former
policies of class struggles and unanimously offer
resistance against Japan. This is what the people
expect and furthermore whether or not to ally with the
Communists is up to the National Government.
pages.zh:
3
1937年6月26日。晨间译稿

答：党派指的是国民党、共产党和所谓的第三党。派系指的是力行社（注：此处原文为Nationalism Clique，通常指代蓝衣社或相关民族主义团体，依语境译为力行社或保留原意，考虑到前文提到蓝衣社，此处指代特定政治派系）。我是国民党党员。
问：通过建议停止内战，你是否反对剿共运动？
答：我们认为内部摩擦大大削弱了国力。当时，广东和广西的局势非常紧张；因此，我们建议各党派携手抗日。
问：通过建议释放政治犯，你指的是共产党人吗？
答：并非特指共产党人；而是指所有因持有不同政治观点而被捕的人。过去几年我们一直坚持这一建议。例如，在国民党中央执行委员会召开的几次会议上，一些中执委成员也提出了同样的提议。
问：全国各界救国联合会发布的一般原则主张介绍各党派举行会议。这是什么意思，如何进行介绍？
答：这仅仅是向各党派提出的建议，目的是讨论抗日的方法和手段。
问：一般原则主张建立统一的抗敌政治力量。这是否意味着改组政府？
答：不。所谓统一，是指政府统一各党派，民众在政府领导下抗日。以此，我们支持政府，而非反对政府。
问：各党派携手抗日的保证是什么？
答：救国会不是一个政党；其意在联合各方力量共同对抗外部侵略。
问：一般原则中提到，将对任何违约的党派实施制裁。如何实施制裁？
答：我们建议由国民政府领导全国抗日。如果任何党派不服从，只有国民政府才能行使权力。
问：共产党人会通过抗日而放弃他们的原则吗？
答：这是关乎共产党人的事情，与救国会无关。过去，有人说共产党人不会为了抗日而放弃他们的原则。但事实表明，西安事变后，共产党人愿意放弃以前的阶级斗争政策，一致抗日。这是民众所期望的，此外，是否与共产党结盟取决于国民政府。

pages.en:
4
June 26, 1937. Morning Translation

Q: The Communists have principles of their own and it is feared that it is not easy to secure alliance with them.
A: By alliance, we mean resistance against Japan, and we do not talk of principles.
Q: The pamphlets issued by four of you advocate alliance with the various parties and cliques, particularly the Communists. What does this mean?
A: Besides the Kuomintang, the Communist Party is naturally one of the biggest political cliques in China. The Kuomintang, however, occupies the highest rank.
Q: How do you know that the Communist Party has expressed resistance against Japan?
A: We have read about it in the newspapers.
Q: When was Mau Shih-tung's letter received?
A: About June or July last year.
Q: Did you send your pamphlets to Mau Shih-tung first?
A: No, he said he saw them in the newspapers.
Q: Is the Fire Flower Reading Society (火花讀书会) a communist organization?
A: I do not know. There is no such body participating in the National Salvation Association.
Q: Did you instigate the strike in the Japanese cotton mills?
A: We did nothing of the sort. We did not know until we read about it in the newspapers.
Q: Had the National Salvation Association any part in the suspension of studies in Shanghai?
A: I request to be enlightened as to which particular event.
Q: December, 1935.
A: Where? Since the Presiding Judge asks us, of course he has the proof. Please show it.
Q: Did you know Lu Tsing (羅青) at the home of Tseu Tao-fun?
A: I have not seen him. The charge sheet states that I knew him at Tsang Nai-chi's home. Which is the actual place, at Tseu Tao-fun's or at Tsang Nai-chi's? The Presiding Judge just spoke about the suspension of studies. I request the Presiding Judge to state clearly which particular event he means.
Q: (After consulting the records for some time). December 23, 1935.
A: The suspension of studies throughout Shanghai or in a school? Please find out.
Q: You all demand that an investigation be made concerning Chang Hsuch-liang. What is the reason for this?
A: We had no connection whatever with the Sian Incident, but the statement of the prosecution insistently states that we had close connection with the coup.
Q: What else do you want investigated?
A: There are many things. A statement was submitted to the Court yesterday, containing more than ten points regarding the manifesto issued at the time of the Third Plenary Congress and other matters. As to matters regarding the suspension of studies by students, the Court is requested to quote facts.

4
1937年6月26日。晨间译稿

问：共产党人有自己的原则，恐怕与他们结盟并不容易。
答：所谓结盟，我们指的是抗日，而不谈论原则。
问：你们四人发布的小册子主张与各党派，特别是共产党结盟。这是什么意思？
答：除了国民党，共产党自然是中国最大的政治派系之一。然而，国民党占据最高地位。
问：你怎么知道共产党表达了抗日意愿？
答：我们在报纸上读到的。
问：毛泽东的信是什么时候收到的？
答：大约去年六月或七月。
问：你们是先把小册子寄给毛泽东的吗？
答：不，他说他在报纸上看到的。
问：火花读书会是一个共产主义组织吗？
答：我不知道。救国会中没有这样的团体参与。
问：你们煽动了日本棉厂的罢工吗？
答：我们没有做过这种事。直到我们在报纸上看到报道才知道。
问：救国会在上海的停课事件中有任何参与吗？
答：我请求澄清具体是指哪一事件。
问：1935年12月。
答：在哪里？既然审判长问我们，他当然有证据。请出示。
问：你在邹韬奋家里认识罗青（Lu Tsing）吗？
答：我没见过他。起诉书称我在章乃宅（Tsang Nai-chi）家里认识他。实际地点究竟是在邹韬奋家还是在章乃宅家？审判长刚才提到了停课事件。我请求审判长明确说明他指的是哪一具体事件。
问：（查阅记录一段时间后）。1935年12月23日。
答：是全上海范围的停课还是某所学校的停课？请查清楚。
问：你们都要求对张学良进行调查。原因是什么？
答：我们与西安事变毫无关联，但检方的陈述坚持声称我们与政变有密切关系。
问：你还希望调查什么？
答：有很多事情。昨天向法庭提交了一份陈述，包含关于三中全会期间发布的宣言及其他事项的十多个要点。至于学生停课事宜，请求法庭引用事实。

pages.en:
June 26, 1937.
Morning Translation.

The Prosecutor rose and put the following
question: "At the time of the Sian Incident, Chang Hsueh-
liang held the view that a national salvation conference
should be convened. Was this conference similar to the
conference, promoted by you all, to avert national ruin?"
The Presiding Judge questioned as to whether
or not these two conferences were the same in nature.
The accused replied that Chang Hsueh-liang
should be interrogated on this point.
Lawyer Chang Ts-niang (張志讓) then rose
and said: "A comparison of the opinions of the two parties
should be made to ascertain whether or not the national
salvation conference suggested by Chang Hsueh-liang is
similar to the conference, suggested by the National
Salvation Association, to avert national ruin. It seems
absolutely necessary to make an investigation of this
point with Chang Hsueh-liang."
Q: Was your suggestion for the establishment of a united
regime to resist the enemy the opinion of Chang Hsueh-
liang for the re-organization of the Government?
A: None of the documents of the National Salvation Association
refers to the re-organization of the Government. The
prosecution stubbornly states that our views are
similar to those of Chang; this is erroneous. As to
the point concerning the suspension of studies by
students, the Court is requested to ascertain whether
this refers to the suspension of studies by students
throughout Shanghai or by students of one school, and
who instigated this suspension.

Statement of Tsang Nai-chi

Tsang Nai-chi was next interrogated.
Q: What is the motive of the manifesto and general
principles of the National Salvation Association?
A: They are nearly the same, that is to say, they show
how to consolidate to resist insult.
Q: How do you explain the expressions: the drawing up by
all of the general principles for national salvation
and the establishment of a political regime to resist
the enemy?
A: It is hoped that the Central Government authorities
would have a united political regime and it does not
mean that we should "establish" such a regime. Before
and after this sentence, there is the wording: "to
accelerate the establishment" and "not to fight for a
political regime." This shows that there is no thought
of instituting a re-organization of the Government.
Q: Do you oppose the Constitution?
A: The first thing is to offer resistance to Japan, and
the Constitution is a secondary question. If a nation
is conquered, its Constitution cannot be put into force.
Q: In referring to various parties and cliques, do you
mean that the principal party you referred to is the
Communist Party?
A: The Kuomintang should lead various parties and cliques,
and the principal party among these latter parties
and cliques is the Communist Party.
pages.zh:
1937年6月26日。
晨间译本。

检察官起身提出下列问题：“在西安事变发生时，张学良主张召开救国会议。该会议是否与诸位所倡导的、旨在避免亡国的会议相似？”
审判长询问这两次会议的性质是否相同。
被告回答称，就此点而言，应当讯问张学良。
律师张志让（Chang Ts-niang）随即起身说道：“应当比较双方的意见，以查明张学良所建议的救国会议，是否与全国救国会所建议的、旨在避免亡国的会议相似。看来绝对有必要就这一点向张学良进行调查。”
问：你们关于建立统一政权以抗敌的建议，是否就是张学良关于改组政府的意见？
答：全国救国会的任何文件中均未提及改组政府。检方固执地声称我们的观点与张氏相似，这是错误的。至于学生停课一事，请法庭查明这指的是全上海的学生停课，还是某一学校的学生停课，以及是谁煽动了此次停课。

章乃哉的陈述

接下来受审的是章乃哉。
问：全国救国会的宣言和纲领的宗旨是什么？
答：两者几乎相同，也就是说，它们表明了如何团结起来抵抗侮辱。
问：你如何解释“共同制定救国纲领”和“建立抗敌政治政权”这些表述？
答：是希望中央政府当局拥有一个统一的政治政权，这并不意味着我们要“建立”这样一个政权。在这句话的前后，有“加速建立”和“不争夺政治政权”的字样。这表明没有改组政府的想法。
问：你反对宪法吗？
答：首要任务是抵抗日本，宪法是次要问题。如果一个国家被征服，其宪法就无法施行。
问：在提到各党派和派系时，你所指的主要政党是共产党吗？
答：国民党应当领导各党派和派系，而在后者中，主要政党是共产党。

pages.en:
6
June 26, 1937. Morning Translation.

Q: Does your desire to resist Japan correspond with that
of the Communist Party?
A: I think that your view corresponds with mine.
Q: Did the National Congress which you mentioned have the
"Closed Door Policy"?
A: Originally the election to the National Congress was
fixed, but it is now revised. This shows that our
comments are not unreasonable.
Q: This is a question of law. What you all talked of
was that the Constitution was not required.
A: We only issued comments on the viewpoint of civilians.
Q: Were your views similar to those of the 7th Conference
of Representatives of the Third Internationale?
A: I cannot understand.
Q: Did you all suggest the formation of a National Defence
Government?
A: We did not say so.
Q: Are you a member of the Kuomintang?
A: I was in the service of financial circles. I have not
joined any political party.
Q: What was the idea of the issue of the circular appealing
on behalf of some 3,000,000 people of Shanghai?
A: In October last year, Japanese marines were widely posted
in Hongkew in Shanghai. The Japanese marines sent out
large numbers of traitors to conduct activities and it
was possible that the people would be cheated. Therefore,
we suggested that people should undergo training.
Q: Do you all agree with the anti-Japanese policy of the
Communist Party?
A: Everybody in the country agrees to offer resistance
against Japan. It seems that you, the Presiding Judge,
agree as well.
Q: Did any National Salvation Association in Sian join the
All China National Salvation Federation?
A: No.
Q: What investigation do you all demand?
A: An investigation should be made with Chang Hsueh-liang
as to any conspiracy. Mr. Ma Siang-pah did guarantee
that the work for national salvation would not be guilty.
Please ascertain this from Mr. Ma.
(The other parts of the interrogation are
similar to those put up to Sung and are therefore shortened.)

Statement of Wong Zao-dz.

The third accused interrogated was Wong Zao-dz.
Q: Are you a member of the Productive Party?
A: I have not the slightest idea of what the Productive Party
is.
Q: Are you a member of the Chinese People's Revolutionary
League?
A: I have not the least knowledge of this organization.
Q: Do you know a certain person named Hu?
A: No.
Q: He has surrendered himself to the Court and implicated
you in his statement.
A: I do not know.
pages.zh:
6
1937年6月26日。晨间译本。

问：你们抵抗日本的愿望是否与共产党的愿望一致？
答：我认为你的观点与我的观点一致。
问：你提到的国民大会是否有“关门主义”政策？
答：原本国民大会的选举已确定，但现在进行了修订。这表明我们的评论并非毫无道理。
问：这是一个法律问题。你们所谈论的是不需要宪法。
答：我们只是发表了平民观点的评论。
问：你们的观点是否与共产国际第七次代表大会的观点相似？
答：我不明白。
问：你们是否建议成立国防政府？
答：我们没有这样说。
问：你是国民党党员吗？
答：我在金融界服务。我没有加入任何政党。
问：代表上海约300万民众发出呼吁通函的想法是什么？
答：去年十月，日本海军陆战队广泛部署在上海虹口。日本海军陆战队派出大量汉奸进行活动，民众有可能受到欺骗。因此，我们建议民众应接受训练。
问：你们是否同意共产党的抗日政策？
答：全国每个人都同意抵抗日本。看来审判长阁下也同意。
问：西安的任何救国会加入了全国救国联合会吗？
答：没有。
问：你们要求调查什么？
答：应当就任何阴谋事项向张学良进行调查。马相伯先生曾保证救国工作无罪。请向马先生核实此事。
（审讯的其他部分与向宋提出的类似，因此从略。）

王造时的陈述

第三名受审被告是王造时。
问：你是生产党党员吗？
答：我完全不知道什么是生产党。
问：你是中国人民革命同盟成员吗？
答：我对这个组织一无所知。
问：你认识一个姓胡的人吗？
答：不认识。
问：他已向法庭自首，并在供词中牵连了你。
答：我不知道。

pages.en:
June 26, 1937. Morning Translation.

Q: What is the aim and purpose of the manifesto issued
and the general principles drawn up by the All-China
National Salvation Federation?
A: To resist Japan and save the nation.
Q: Are the union with the U.S.S.R. and the toleration of
Communism the measures in the resistance against Japan
and the salvation of the nation?
A: We advocate to ally with all Powers in the Far East,
such as Great Britain, America, France and U.S.S.R.,
whose aim and purpose is contrary to the interests of
Japan. We have not talked about the toleration of
Communism.
Q: The Communist Party is international; it has no fatherland.
Is there any sincerity in the resistance against Japan?
A: Formerly, the Communist Party advocated class struggles.
Later, we learned from newspapers that the Communists
were willing to resist Japan in concert under the guide
of the Central Authorities.
Q: Do you know that the Communist Party intends to organize
a National Defence Government?
A: This is the affair of the Communist Party.
Q: Does the establishment of a unified political regime
mean the reformation of the existing Government?
A: No, the first and most important object in the
unification is to resist Japan.

Statement of Li Kung-poh

The fourth accused interrogated was Li Kung-
poh.
Q: What is the aim and purpose of the manifesto and the
general principles of the All-China National Salvation
Federation?
A: To resist Japan and save the nation.
Q: Does the "allying with various parties and cliques"
mean the toleration of Communism?
A: No. Since the September 18 Incident and after the
National Congress, the phrase "allying with various
parties and cliques" has been the unanimous advocacy
of both the Government and the people. The object
is to remove differences of opinion and to work for
resistance against Japan. I am really at a loss to
understand why the Procurator makes "a mountain out of
a mole-hill" and talks about the toleration of Communism.
Q: Does the Communist Party also advocate resistance
against Japan?
A: Yes.
Q: Do you know that the Communist Party intends to establish
a National Defence Government?
A: This has nothing to do with us.
Q: Does the so-called establishment of a unified anti-
Japanese political regime against Japan refer to that
national defence government?
A: I did not have any chance of reading the proposals of
the Communist Party; it was only after reading the
statement of the prosecution that I began to have some
knowledge of them. Fundamentally, the two have
nothing to do with each other.
pages.zh:
1937年6月26日。晨间译本。

问：全国救国联合会发布的宣言和制定的纲领的目标和目的是什么？
答：抵抗日本，拯救国家。
问：与苏联结盟和容共是否是抵抗日本和拯救国家的措施？
答：我们主张与远东所有目标与日本利益相悖的国家结盟，如英国、美国、法国和苏联。我们没有谈论过容共。
问：共产党是国际性的；它没有祖国。其抗日有诚意吗？
答：以前，共产党主张阶级斗争。后来，我们从报纸上得知，共产党愿意在中央当局的指导下协同抗日。
问：你知道共产党打算组织国防政府吗？
答：这是共产党的事。
问：建立统一政治政权是否意味着改革现有政府？
答：不，统一的首要且最重要的目标是抵抗日本。

李公朴的陈述

第四名受审被告是李公朴。
问：全国救国联合会的宣言和纲领的目标和目的是什么？
答：抵抗日本，拯救国家。
问：“联合各党派和派系”是否意味着容共？
答：不。自九一八事变及国民大会之后，“联合各党派和派系”已成为政府和民众的一致主张。目的是消除意见分歧，致力于抵抗日本。我真不明白检察官为何“小题大做”，谈论容共。
问：共产党也主张抗日吗？
答：是的。
问：你知道共产党打算建立国防政府吗？
答：这与我们无关。
问：所谓建立统一的抗日政治政权是指那个国防政府吗？
答：我没有机会阅读共产党的提案；只是在阅读了检方的陈述后，我才开始有所了解。从根本上说，两者毫无关系。

pages.en:
June 26, 1937.
Morning Translation.

Q: Is there not the phrase "the establishment of an anti-Japanese political regime" mentioned in the manifesto and the general principles of the All-China National Salvation Federation?
A: I am much surprised to see that there are people who are of the opinion that no one should be allowed to repeat what the Communists have said. In other words, nobody will be allowed to advocate resistance against Japan, if the Communist Party has already mentioned it. At this time of national crisis, if the Communist Party was willing to resist Japan, they would certainly be welcome by us. But, whether or not the Communist Party was determined to resist Japan I do not know. Even the Presiding Judge and Procurator, I fear, could not know it. It is too unreasonable that the establishment of an anti-Japanese political regime as mentioned by our Federation should be alleged to have connection with the establishment of a national defence government as proposed by the Communist Party.
Q: Do you advocate the toleration of Communism?
A: Our first and most important object is to resist Japan. We are willing to ally with all those anti-Japanese influences, either in China or in foreign countries.
A: The Communist Party will not abandon its Communism. What shall we do if the Communists create disturbances at the rear?
A: We have the strength of our people to suppress them.
Q: Do you know that you have been made use of by the Communist Party?
A: The 400,000,000 Chinese people all want to resist Japan. I believe that the Presiding Judge is also anti-Japanese. But, is it true that the Presiding Judge has also been made use of by the Communist Party?
Q: Could you guarantee that the Communist Party would resist Japan?
A: 13 years ago, Dr. Sun Yat-sen advocated the toleration of Communism. Is it true that Dr. Sun Yat-sen was also wrong? No. But the alliance with the Communists depends upon the circumstances. They are to be allied, when necessary, but in case of non-necessity, they are not to be allied with, because the national policy and principles are two different things.

Statement of Tseu Tao-fun

The next accused brought up for interrogation was Tseu Tao-fun. The following questions were then put to him:-
Q: Were you present at the inaugural meeting of the All-China National Salvation Federation?
A: As I was then at Hongkong engaged in the publication of the "Livelihood" Daily News I did not participate in this meeting. It was only after I had been notified after my return to Shanghai in August that I knew that I had been elected as a member of the Executive Committee of the Federation.
(The accused, whilst answering these questions of the Court, spoke very loudly and in a very vehement manner.)
pages.zh:
1937年6月26日。
晨间译本。

问：全国救国联合会的宣言和纲领中不是提到了“建立抗日政治政权”这句话吗？
答：我很惊讶地发现，有人认为任何人都不允许重复共产党说过的话。换句话说，如果共产党已经提到了，就不允许任何人主张抗日。在这个国家危亡的时刻，如果共产党愿意抗日，我们当然欢迎。但是，共产党是否决心抗日，我不知道。恐怕连审判长和检察官也不知道。将本联合会提到的建立抗日政治政权，指控为与共产党提出的建立国防政府有关联，这是极不合理的。
问：你主张容共吗？
答：我们首要且最重要的目标是抵抗日本。我们愿意与国内外所有抗日力量结盟。
问：共产党不会放弃其共产主义。如果共产党在后方制造骚乱，我们该怎么办？
答：我们有人民的力量来镇压他们。
问：你知道你被共产党利用了吗？
答：四亿中国人都想抗日。我相信审判长也是抗日的。但是，难道审判长也被共产党利用了吗？
问：你能保证共产党会抗日吗？
答：13年前，孙中山博士主张容共。难道孙中山博士也错了吗？不。但与共产党结盟取决于情况。必要时与之结盟，但在不必要的情况下，则不与之结盟，因为国策和原则是两回事。

邹韬奋的陈述

接下来提审的被告是邹韬奋。随后向他提出了以下问题：
问：你出席了全国救国联合会的成立大会吗？
答：当时我在香港从事《生活日报》的出版工作，未参加此次会议。直到八月我回到上海后接到通知，才知道我被选为联合会执行委员会委员。
（被告在回答法庭这些问题时，声音很大，态度非常激烈。）

pages.en:
9
June 26, 1937. Morning Translation.

Q: Do you agree with the manifesto issued by the Federation
and its principles on politics?
A: I very much agree with them.
Q: What is the object of the All China National Salvation
Federation?
A: As the manifesto of the Federation says, our sole
object is to concentrate the entire efforts of the
nation to deal with Japan.
Q: Does the proposal that advocates unification of all
parties and cliques mean the tolerance of the Communist
Party?
A: It refers to all parties and cliques, including the
Communist Party. The manifestoes of the National
Crisis Conference of the 23rd Year (1934) of the
Republic and of the Third Plenary Session, the statement
issued by General Chiang Kai-shek, and the open
letter addressed to the people issued by the Executive
Committee of the Kuomintang all referred to the question
of the unification of all parties and cliques.

(As it was already 12 noon, the lawyers
requested an adjournment. The interrogation of this
accused was resumed at 2.30 p.m.)

Q:According to the "Livelihood Daily News" (生活日報),
the "People's Front" is the same as the "People's
National Salvation Front." Is not this right?
A: I remember quite well; sometime in July last year, a
letter was received from a reader of the paper, in which
the term "People's Front" was used. But in my reply,
I stated that whereas it was quite right to advocate
unified resistance against Japan, it was improper to
apply the term "People's Front," and that in future no
further application of this term should be made so as
to avoid misunderstanding. However, the prosecution
alleges that I advocated the "People's Front." Does not
this constitute a misinterpretation of the text of the
paper as a means to involve the innocent in crime?
Q: Does not your proposal that advocates the establishment
of a united political power for resistance against the
enemy coincide in meaning with the National Defence
Government advocated by the Communist Party?
A: Even from their wordings, they are different from
each other.
Q: The Communist Party does not give up its doctrines
but only modifies its policies. Don't you understand?
A: This is the business of the Communist Party. What we
are interested in is resistance or non-resistance against
Japan. If the Communist Party is sincere in its desire
to offer resistance against Japan, the Central Government
should offer its co-operation.
Q: Do you know the "Fire Flower Reading Society"?
A: I never knew it before, and was only informed of it
when I was at the Bureau of Public Safety.
Q: Are there any secret organizations in the National
Salvation Association?
A: If they are secret, I would of course not know them.
Q:What is the object of the proposal for the establishment
of a united political power?
A: In the manifesto issued by the Third Plenary Session held
this year, it is said that the united political power has
gradually come into realization since July last year. From
this, it can be seen that the political power was not
unified before July last year.
pages.zh:
9
1937年6月26日。晨间翻译。

问：你是否同意救国会发布的宣言及其政治原则？
答：我非常同意。
问：全国各界救国联合会的宗旨是什么？
答：正如本会宣言所述，我们唯一的宗旨是集中全民族的力量以对付日本。
问：主张统一各党派及派系的提议，是否意味着容共？
答：这是指包括共产党在内的所有党派和派系。民国二十三年（1934年）国难会议宣言、三中全会宣言、蒋介石将军发表的声明，以及国民党中央执行委员会致民众的公开信，均提及统一各党派及派系的问题。

（因时已中午12时，律师请求休庭。对该被告的讯问于下午2时30分恢复。）

问：据《生活日报》称，“人民阵线”即“人民救国阵线”。此说是否正确？
答：我记得很清楚；去年七月某时，本报收到一封读者来信，信中使用了“人民阵线”一词。但在我的回复中，我指出，虽然主张统一抗日是完全正确的，但使用“人民阵线”这一术语是不妥当的，今后不应再使用该词，以免引起误解。然而，检方指控我提倡“人民阵线”。这难道不是曲解报章文字，以此罗织无辜入罪吗？
问：你主张建立抗敌统一政权，这与共产党所倡导的国防政府在含义上岂非一致？
答：即使从字面上看，二者也是不同的。
问：共产党并未放弃其主义，只是改变了政策。你不明白吗？
答：这是共产党的事。我们所关心的是抗日还是不抗日。如果共产党真心希望抗日，中央政府应予合作。
问：你知道“火花读书会”吗？
答：我以前从未听说过，直到我在公安局时才得知此事。
问：救国会内是否有秘密组织？
答：如果是秘密的，我自然不知道。
问：建立统一政权的提议，其宗旨是什么？
答：在今年召开的三中全会宣言中指出，自去年七月以来，统一政权已逐渐实现。由此可见，去年七月之前，政权并未统一。

pages.en:
10
June 26, 1937. Morning Translation

Here the Procurator of the Court rose and stated:
"The accused a little while ago stated that I had misinterpreted the text of the paper, the 'Livelihood Daily News,' as a means to involve the innocent in crime. This allegation is not right. The telegram addressed by you to General Chang Hsueh-liang urges him to mobilize his troops to resist Japan. Now, how would it be possible for him to offer resistance against Japan without instructions from the Central Government? Moreover, as he was then far away from Suiyuan, he would not be able to resist Japan from a practical point of view. As I am a representative of the Government to enforce the execution of the law, the accused has no right to make allegations against me recklessly."
A: The statement of the prosecution is a misinterpretation of what I said regarding the "People's Front" and now the Procurator alters my statement referring to General Chang Hsueh-liang. It seems that he is "taking a cow's head as the horse's mouth." (These words were uttered by the accused in a very vehement manner.) If Your Honour, the Presiding Judge, considers the statement of the Procurator proper and correct, then it is requested that the hearing of the case be discontinued. (Here the Presiding Judge waved his hand intimating to the accused to stop talking, but the latter took no heed and went on to say.) As the Procurator has repudiated and criticized my previous statement, I have the right to explain. (Here the accused was handed by the Presiding Judge the text of the telegram addressed to Chang Hsueh-liang by the All-China National Salvation Federation. He resumed talking after he had perused it.) The contents of this telegram clearly denote that he was only requested to despatch his troops to resist Japan but not to start a coup d'etat. Moreover, identical telegrams were also sent to the National Government and Generals Fu Tso-nyi, Han Fu-chu and Sung Cheh-yuan by the All-China National Salvation Federation. Why did the Procurator not read them carefully?
Here the Procurator again rose and said: "The telegram you sent to General Chang Hsueh-liang brought up the Sian uprising, while the telegrams sent to the National Government and Generals Han, Fu and Sung did not result in such trouble.
A: Then you (the Procurator) are requested to explain the resultant connections and causes between the text of the telegram addressed to Chang Hsueh-liang that urged him to give assistance in the defence of Suiyuan and the Sian Mutiny. (Here the Procurator remained silent. Finally the accused, Tseu Tao-fun, submitted to the Procurator for his perusal and examination a book entitled "Reflection" (反思) which he recently wrote.)

Statement of Soo Chi-li

Soo Chi-li was the sixth one summoned, when he stated that he was a Committeeman of the Vocational Circles National Salvation Association. The object of the National Salvation Association was to resist Japan; irrespective of parties or cliques, they should concentrate themselves to resist Japan for the salvation of the country. "As I am not a communist," he added, "I cannot assure that the Communists will resist Japan thoroughly to the last; what we hope is to unite all parties and cliques."
pages.zh:
10
1937年6月26日。晨间翻译

此时，法院检察官起身陈述：“被告刚才声称，我曲解了《生活日报》的文字，以此罗织无辜入罪。这种指责是不对的。你致电张学良将军，敦促他 mobilize 部队抵抗日本。现在，若无中央政府的指令，他怎么可能抗日呢？此外，由于他当时远离绥远，从实际角度来看，他也无法抗日。我是代表政府执法的代表，被告无权对我进行鲁莽的指控。”
答：检方的陈述是对我就“人民阵线”所说内容的曲解，现在检察官又篡改了我关于张学良将军的陈述。这似乎是“指鹿为马”。（被告说这些话时语气非常激烈。）如果法官阁下认为检察官的陈述适当且正确，那么请求停止本案的审理。（此时主审法官挥手示意被告停止说话，但后者未予理会，继续说道。）既然检察官否定并批评了我先前的陈述，我有权进行解释。（此时，主审法官将全国各界救国联合会致张学良的电文文本交给被告。被告阅后继续发言。）这份电文的内容清楚地表明，只是要求他派遣部队抗日，而非发动政变。此外，全国各界救国联合会也向国民政府以及傅作义、韩复榘和宋哲元将军发送了相同的电报。检察官为何不仔细查阅？
此时检察官再次起身说道：“你发给张学良将军的电报引发了西安事变，而发给国民政府以及韩、傅、宋将军的电报并未导致此类麻烦。
答：那么请你（检察官）解释一下，敦促张学良协助保卫绥远的电文内容与西安事变之间的因果联系。（此时检察官保持沉默。最后，被告邹韬奋向检察官提交了一本他最近撰写的题为《反思》的书，供其审阅和检查。）

史良的陈述

史良是第六位被传唤者，她陈述自己是职业界救国会的委员。救国会的宗旨是抗日；不分党派或派系，大家都应集中精力抗日以救国。“因为我不是共产党员，”她补充道，“我不能保证共产党人会彻底抗日到底；我们所希望的是团结各党派和各派系。”

pages.en:
June 26, 1937.
Morning Translation.

Sz Liang's statement

Sz Liang: I am a Committee member of the Women's Circles National Salvation Association. This Association has more than 1,000 members, and was inaugurated in December of the 24th year of the Chinese Republic. First we consulted for the registration of the Association with Lawyer Mao Yung (毛雲), Committeeman of the People's Training Department of the District Tangpu, but the latter said that permission should be obtained from the Central Authorities. Our Association has organized the training of rescuing groups, and cyclists' groups etc. During our meetings, Madame Wu Te-chen and Madame Pan Kung-chai were present to give directions. Last summer, we submitted an appeal to the 2nd Plenary Conference requesting that the country be unified in order to resist aggressors. We were received by Mr. Ma Chao-chiun (馬超俊), a member of the C.E.C.
Judge: Where is the All-China Various Circles National Association established?
As It is established in the Youths' Federation.
Q: Why do you hold the view of uniting various parties and cliques?
As During the National Crisis Conference held four years ago, we had already maintained the opinion of uniting all parties and cliques. After the outbreak of the South-west embroglio last year, we felt great anxiety at the sight of the daily dwindling of our territory, while internal unity had still not yet been achieved after the loss of several provinces. For this reason, we started to renew the manifesto of the National Crisis Conference to push forward the demand for unifying all parties and cliques, and of no more fighting among our own people. We should unite to resist Japan for the salvation of our country. To speak the truth, the Communists are Chinese people also; comparing the Communists with the Japanese Imperialists, the latter are naturally a worse enemy to us. So we uphold the view that the Central Government should lead the Communists to launch a joint resistance against Japan for saving our country. The procurator repeatedly connects us with the Sian Coup; this is an insult to us. We did ask General Chang Hsueh-liang to rescue Suiyuan, but we did not instigate him to detain General Chiang Kai-shek.
Here the lawyers of the accused requested the Judge to summon General Chang Hsueh-liang to verify the statement. Sung Chun-dz, Sz Liang and Li Kung-poh also requested that General Chang be summoned to be present at the trial. They said, "If the Judge does not adopt advice of the procurator, and declares that we are not guilty, we have nothing to say; but if we are found guilty in the absence of General Chang Hsueh-liang, we will not be willing to submit."
The procurator then said to the Judge that it would be unnecessary to summon General Chang Hsueh-liang. The defending lawyers for the accused then had a long debate with the procurator.
Chang Nai-chi then spoke, "It is not right that the procurator should refuse to gather proof and prevent the Judge from doing likewise; it is right that the procurator says that he is representing the country to execute his duties, but we hope he will not forget the Chinese people when representing the Chinese Republic."
pages.zh:
1937年6月26日。
晨间翻译。

沈兹九的陈述

沈兹九：我是妇女界救国会的委员。该会有会员一千余人，于中华民国二十四年十二月成立。起初，我们就本会注册事宜咨询了塘浦区民众训练部委员毛云律师，但后者表示需获得中央当局的许可。本会组织了救护队、自行车队等的训练。在我们开会期间，吴德珍女士和潘公展夫人曾出席指导。去年夏天，我们向二中全会提交请愿书，请求统一国家以抵抗侵略者。我们受到了中央执行委员马超俊先生的接见。
法官：全国各界救国联合会成立于何处？
答：它成立于青年会。
问：你为何持有团结各党派及派系的观点？
答：在四年前举行的国难会议上，我们就已经坚持团结各党派及派系的意见。去年西南事变爆发后，眼见国土日益缩小，而在丧失数省之后内部仍未实现统一，我们深感焦虑。因此，我们开始重申国难会议的宣言，以推进统一各党派及派系、不再内斗的要求。我们应该团结起来抗日以救国。说实话，共产党人也是中国人；将共产党人与日本帝国主义者相比，后者自然是我们更坏的敌人。所以我们主张，中央政府应带领共产党人联合抗日以拯救我们的国家。检察官一再将我们与西安事变联系起来，这是对我们的侮辱。我们确实要求张学良将军救援绥远，但我们并未煽动他扣押蒋介石将军。
此时，被告的律师请求法官传唤张学良将军以核实陈述。宋庆龄、沈兹九和李公朴也请求传唤张学良将军出庭。他们说：“如果法官不采纳检察官的建议，并宣告我们无罪，我们无话可说；但如果我们在张学良将军缺席的情况下被判有罪，我们将不愿服从。”
检察官随后对法官表示，无需传唤张学良将军。被告的辩护律师随后与检察官进行了长时间的辩论。
章乃器接着发言：“检察官拒绝收集证据并阻止法官这样做，这是不对的；检察官说他代表国家履行职责，这是对的，但我们希望他在代表中华民国时，不要忘记中国人民。”

pages.en:
June 26, 1937.    12    Morning Translation.

At this moment, the lawyers of the accused
attacked the procurator by saying that "Shensi is adjoining
Suiyuan; while the procurator stated that it is far away
from Suiyuan and that assistance is unnecessary; this
shows that the procurator has no common knowledge of
geography". Judge Chu then instructed that no more attacks
be made, and that comment would be made after the interrogation
of Lu Ching.

Statements of Lu, Ning and Koo

At 4.45 p.m. the Presiding Judge questioned
Lu Ching as to whether he was a member of the Kuomintang.
Lu answered: "I joined the Kuomintang and
rendered my services. I also joined the Reorganizationists
Clique, the leader of which is now one of the leaders in
the Capital. I did not join the National Salvation
Association but I exchanged views on the subject of national
salvation with Tsang Nai-chi. The wooden chop bearing
the inscription "Kiangsu Branch of the National Salvation
Association" was engraved by me. I was arrested at
Kiangyin. I am of the opinion that it is my duty to
serve for the salvation of the country".
Koo Lieu-shing and Ning Chung-kau confessed
that they were members of the Vocational Circles National
Salvation Association. After the arrest of Sung Chun-dz
and the six others, they, upon receipt of a notice issued
by the Shanghai Various Circles National Salvation
Association, came to the Kiangsu High Court to make an
appeal. In all there were 21 persons. Their motive
was to ask for the release of the seven accused, but they
have neither been in possession of handbills nor did they
conduct any propaganda movement.
At this moment, Lawyer Tang Tao stood up
and said: "According to the text of the prosecution, Koo
and Ning, the two accused, held in their hands handbills
containing the wording which is endangering the Republic
of China. I now request the Procurator to produce the
handbills in question".
After going through the document, the Procurator
produced a notice of appeal issued by the National Salvation
Association and stated that this notice was submitted to
the Court by the accused one month after their arrest.
At this point, all the lawyers stood up and
lodged a protest against the prosecution framed by the
Procurator.
At 5.45 p.m. the Presiding Judge adjourned
the case and after withdrawing from the Court, he convened
a conference with the colleagues to discuss as to whether
the demand made by the accused to conduct an investigation
into the evidence was justifiable or not.
At 6.20 p.m. the Judges returned and the
Presiding Judge made the following announcement:-
"The Court is of the opinion that as regard
to the request made by the accused, the document kept by
the Military Court which dealt with the Chang Hsueh-liang
case should be perused by this Court, while all other
requests should be rejected. Ning and Koo may be bailed
out as before, while all the other accused are to be detained".
pages.zh:
1937年6月26日。 12 晨间译稿。

此时，被告的律师攻击检察官称：“陕西与绥远相邻；而检察官却称其距绥远甚远，无需援助；这表明检察官缺乏基本的地理常识。”朱法官随即指示不得再进行此类攻击，并将在审讯陆晶（Lu Ching）之后发表意见。

陆、宁、顾的供词

下午4时45分，主审法官询问陆晶是否为国民党党员。陆回答：“我加入了国民党并为之服务。我也加入了改组派，其领袖现在是首都的领导人之一。我没有加入救国会，但我曾与章乃臧就救国问题交换过意见。刻有‘江苏救国会分会’字样的木章是由我刻制的。我在江阴被捕。我认为为国救亡是我的职责。”

顾留馨和宁钟坎承认他们是职业界救国会的成员。在沈钧儒等六人被捕后，他们收到上海各界救国会发出的通知，便前往江苏高等法院提出上诉。共有21人。他们的动机是要求释放七名被告，但他们既未持有传单，也未进行任何宣传活动。

此时，唐豪律师起身说道：“根据起诉书文本，两名被告顾和宁手中持有含有危害中华民国内容的传单。我现在请求检察官出示相关传单。”

检察官查阅文件后，出示了一份由救国会发布的上诉状，并称该上诉状是被告在被捕一个月后提交给法院的。

此时，所有律师起立，对检察官提出的起诉表示抗议。

下午5时45分，主审法官宣布休庭，退庭后，他与同僚召开会议，讨论被告要求调查证据的请求是否合理。

下午6时20分，法官们返回法庭，主审法官宣布如下：

“本庭认为，关于被告的请求，本庭应查阅处理张学良案件的军事法庭所保存的文件，而所有其他请求均予驳回。宁和顾可照旧保释，其余所有被告均予羁押。”

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Tuesday, June 22, 1937

Salvation Trial
Reopens Friday

New Judges Will Hear
Case; “7 Gentlemen”
Prepare Defense

The trial of the seven All-China
National Salvation Association
leaders on charges of undermining
the security of the state will
reopen in the Kiangsu High Court
in Soochow at 9 o'clock Friday
morning, it was officially announ-
ced today.
The hearing will be conducted
by three new judges, headed by
Chief Judge Chu Chung-chow
The names of the two other
judges, however, have not been an-
nounced. The new judges were
appointed by the Soochow court
following an application by the
accused for replacement of the
judges who presided over the first
hearing on charges of being biased
and prejudiced.
It is generally expected that the
session on Friday will last the
whole day. The hearing may be
resumed the following day when
the prosecution and the defense
will sum up their pleadings. Chief
Judge Chu is understood to ad-
vocate a speedy conclusion of the
trial now that the accused, ar-
rested in Shanghai on the night
of November 22, have already been
in custody for the last seven
months.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1937年6月22日，星期二

救国会审判
周五重开

新法官将审理
案件；“七君子”
准备辩护

官方今日宣布，全中国救国会七位领袖因涉嫌危害国家安全受审一案，将于周五上午9时在苏州江苏高等法院重新开庭。

听证会将由三位新法官主持，首席法官为朱宗周（Chu Chung-chow）。然而，另外两位法官的姓名尚未公布。这些新法官是苏州法院在被告以偏颇和有预设为由申请更换主持首次听证会的法官后任命的。

普遍预计周五的庭审将持续全天。听证会可能在次日继续，届时控辩双方将进行总结陈词。据悉，鉴于被告自去年11月22日晚在上海被捕以来已被羁押七个月，首席法官朱主张尽快结案。

（批：cp1.Sih）

THE CHINA PRESS, SUNDAY, JUNE 20, 1937

Salvationists' Trial
To Resume In Soochow

Trial of the seven All-China National Salvation Association leaders on charges of endangering the state will be resumed in the Kiangsu High Court in Soochow with Judge Chu Tsung-chow presiding at 9 o'clock in the morning of June 26, according to reliable reports received here late last night.

The trial which opened in Soochow on June 11 was suspended as the result of an application filed by the seven defendants for the appointment of a new presiding judge on the following day. The seven salvationists charged the judge presiding at the first hearing with being prejudiced and biased inasmuch as he overruled numerous applications by the accused to investigate evidence and witnesses which they consider as favorable to the defense.

The application was accepted and Judge Chu Tsung-chow of the second section of the criminal division was appointed to preside at the hearing. Immediately upon appointment, Judge Chu proceeded with studying the voluminous files in connection with the case. The study will be completed before June 26 when the trial will be resumed.

The seven defendants in the case are Messrs. Shen Chun-ju, Sha Chien-li, Li Kung-pu, Chang Nai-chi, Tsow Tao-fen, Wang Tsao-shih and Miss Shih Liang, noted lady lawyer in Shanghai.
pages.zh:
《大美晚报》，1937年6月20日，星期日

救国会人士审判
将在苏州恢复

据昨晚收到的可靠消息，全中国救国会七位领袖因涉嫌危害国家受审一案，将于6月26日上午9时在苏州江苏高等法院恢复审理，由朱宗周（Chu Tsung-chow）法官主持。

该审判于6月11日在苏州开庭，次日因七名被告申请任命新的主审法官而暂停。七名救国会人士指控主持首次听证会的法官存在偏见和预设，因为他驳回了被告多项调查他们认为有利于辩护的证据和证人的申请。

该申请已被接受，刑事庭第二庭的朱宗周法官被任命主持听证会。朱法官上任后立即着手研究与该案有关的大量卷宗。研究工作将在6月26日审判恢复前完成。

本案七名被告为沈钧儒、沙千里、李公朴、章乃臧、邹韬奋、王造时先生以及上海著名女律师史良女士。

pages.en:
The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Friday, June 18, 1937

New Judge Named
In Patriot Case

Re-Trial Now Probable
At Soochow; Accused
Remain In Cells

Granting the application by the seven All-China National Salvation Association leaders for appointment of new judges to preside over their trial on charge of undermining the security of the state, the Kiangsu High Court in Soochow has appointed Chief Judge Chu Chung-chow of the second section of the criminal division to handle the hearing. It was officially announced in Soochow last night.

As result of the change in the judges, the trial, which opened in Soochow a week ago, is expected to be heard all over again. As Chief Judge Chu has to study the voluminous files in connection with the case, the first session under the new judge may not take place until early in July.

Charges Made

The seven leaders of the All-China National Salvation Association filed the application for the appointment of new judges last Saturday following the prolonged first session on the previous day. They charged the presiding judge with being prejudiced and biased inasmuch as he overruled numerous applications by the accused to investigate evidence and witnesses which they consider as favorable to the defense.

The accused also took strong exception to the action by the previous judges in ordering the first hearing to be held in camera. It was through their concerted threat to boycott the judges and to refuse answering their questions that two members of their families and the press representatives were finally allowed to enter the courtroom.

Spend Days In Jail

With no date set for the resumption of the momentous trial, the accused are spending their days in the detention house in Soochow. Messrs. Shen Chung-ju, Sah Chien-li, Li Kung-po, Chang Nai-chi, Tsou Tao-feng and Wang Chao-shih, the six male members of the now famous "Seven Gentlemen" are in their special "suite" while Miss Sze Liang, the woman lawyer, has a room to herself in the female detention house. Of the three others who also are standing trial, only Lo Tsing is detained. Two others, junior members of the National Salvation Association, were allowed released on bail.

The movement to request the early release of the seven leaders and the three followers grows in Shanghai today. The latest public body to request the release of its members involved in the case is the Chinese Bar Association. In a meeting of the executive committee of the Association, it was decided to send a petition to the National Government requesting the early release of Shen Chung-ju, Sah Chien-li, Wong Chao-shih, and Miss Sze Liang. Mr. Shen is a member of the standing committee of the Association. During the meeting, an article written by Mr. Shen in the Soochow detention house on the fund campaign for the construction of a new building for the Association was approved. The article is to be engraved on the cornerstone of the new building.

《上海晚邮报与水星报》，1937年6月18日，星期五

爱国者案件
任命新法官

苏州可能重审；被告
仍被关押

江苏高等法院在苏州批准了全中国救国会七位领袖关于任命新法官主持其涉嫌危害国家安全审判的申请，任命刑事庭第二庭首席法官朱宗周（Chu Chung-chow）负责审理此案。苏州方面昨晚正式宣布。

由于法官变更，一周前在苏州开庭的审判预计将重新进行。由于朱首席法官需要研究与该案有关的大量卷宗，新法官主持下的首次庭审可能要等到7月初才能进行。

提出指控

上周六，在前一天漫长的首次庭审之后，全中国救国会七位领袖提交了任命新法官的申请。他们指控主审法官存在偏见和预设，因为他驳回了被告多项调查他们认为有利于辩护的证据和证人的申请。

被告还对前任法官命令首次听证会不公开审理的做法表示强烈反对。正是通过他们联合威胁抵制法官并拒绝回答问题，最终才允许两名家属和新闻代表进入法庭。

在狱中度日

由于这一重大审判的恢复日期尚未确定，被告们在苏州的拘留所中度日。如今著名的“七君子”中的六位男性成员沈钧儒、沙千里、李公朴、章乃臧、邹韬奋和王造时先生住在他们的特别“套房”中，而女律师史良女士则在女子拘留所拥有自己的房间。在另外三名同样受审的人中，只有罗青（Lo Tsing）被羁押。另外两人是救国会的初级成员，已获准保释。

今天，上海要求早日释放七位领袖和三名追随者的运动日益高涨。最新请求释放涉案成员的公共团体是上海律师公会。在该公会执行委员会的一次会议上，决定向国民政府发送请愿书，要求早日释放沈钧儒、沙千里、王造时和史良女士。沈先生是该公会常务委员会委员。会议期间，沈先生在苏州拘留所撰写的关于公会新大楼建设基金募捐的文章获得批准。该文章将被刻在新大楼的奠基石上。

Min Pao (Nanking telegram):

MINISTRY OF JUSTICE DENIES REQUEST FOR INSTRUCTIONS
BY SOOCHOW COURT

The other day, newspapers at the Capital and
