June 15, 1937.
Morning Translation.

Lih Pao :-

NEW DEVELOPMENTS EXPECTED IN THE CASE AGAINST SUNG CHUN-DZ
AND OTHERS : MR. TU YUEH-SUNG PROCEEDS TO SOOCHOW

A rumour was in circulation in Shanghai on
June 14 to the effect that Sung Chun-dz ( 宋春澍 ), Wong
Zaq-dz ( 王造時 ), Tsang Nai-chi ( 章乃器 ), Li Kung-poh
( 李公樸 ), Tseu Tao-fun ( 鄒奮 ), Soo Chi-li ( 沙千里 )
and Sz Liang ( 史良 ) had been released on bail put up by
Mr. Tu Yueh-sung ( 杜月笙 ) and Mr. Chien Yung-min ( 錢永銘 ),
a well-known local banker.
Information secured by our reporter shows
that it is true that Messrs Tu and Chien proceeded to
Soochow on June 13 and visited Sung Chun-dz and the others.
They returned to Shanghai on June 14. When interviewed
by our reporter, Mr. Tu did not deny that he had undertaken
the work for the release of Sung and others.
The request for the release of the seven
accused requires approval from the Government.
New developments are expected to take place in the course
of a day or two.

Lih Pao publishes the following telegram from Nanking :-

In connection with the case against Sung
Chun-dz and the others, the accused have requested that
Judges Fang ( 方 ), Cheng ( 鄭 ) and Wang ( 汪 ) be withdrawn.
Mr. Chu Zu-sung ( 朱祖祥 ), President of the Kiangsu High
Court at Soochow, on June 12, sent a telegram to Nanking
reporting the matter.
Upon receipt of the above telegram, Mr.
Hung Loh-tung ( 洪蘭友 ), Vice Minister of Justice, invited
department chiefs of his Ministry to discuss the subject.
It was decided that the Soochow High Court possesses the
right to decide the case and that the High Court may
reject the request for the withdrawal of the three Judges
if it regards the request as unreasonable. It was also
resolved that the accused may refer the matter to the
Supreme Court for decision in the event of their dissatisfaction.
A few days ago, Messrs Hsu Sing-loh ( 徐新六 ),
Li Fohpsung ( 李馥蓀 ), Ling Kong-hou ( 林康侯 ), Yu Chu-ting
( 俞佐庭 ) and other financial leaders in Shanghai sent
the following joint telegram to President Lin Sen of the
National Government, General Chiang Kai-shek, Mr. Wang
Ching-wei and Mr. Chu Cheng, President of the Judicial
Yuan :-

"Tsang Nai-chi has rendered service to
financial circles in Shanghai for over ten years and his
knowledge and experience are excellent. The Government
is taking in hand economic reconstruction work and requires
men of talent. We request that Mr. Tsang be released".
The Book-Dealers' Association of Shanghai
has sent a telegram to the Government authorities asking
for the liberation of Tseu Tao-fun.

宋春澍等人案件预计将有新进展：杜月笙先生前往苏州

本报记者获得的消息显示，杜、钱二人确于6月13日前往苏州，探望了宋春澍等人。他们于6月14日返回上海。本报记者采访杜先生时，他并未否认自己曾为释放宋春澍等人奔走。

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

HAWKERS ON EXTRA-SETTLEMENT ROAD AT YINGZIANGKONG
REFUSE TO TAKE OUT SETTLEMENT LICENCES

Early yesterday morning, a large number of uniform men and detectives of the Settlement Police arrived on the extra-Settlement road at the end of Yingziangkong (引翔港) and forced the vegetable stall-keepers there to take out licences from the S.M.C.
As they had never before paid such dues and furthermore, as the area in question comes within the jurisdiction of the Chinese authorities, the vegetable stall-keepers unanimously refused to take out licences from the Council. Consequent upon this refusal, they were immediately driven away by the Police from the area and other vegetable hawkers were prevented from landing at the Jukong Wharf (虬江碼頭) and passing through the area in question.
Alleging that the action of the S.M.C. in forcing payment for merely passing through a section of the extra-Settlement road at Yingziangkong is unreasonable, especially at this time when negotiations over the extra-Settlement roads question are under way, and that it is liable to affect their livelihood, the vegetable hawkers have submitted a joint appeal to various circles asking for support.

Min Pao and other local newspapers:

CASE AGAINST SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS TO BE HEARD
AT SOOCHOW ON JUNE 11

The case against Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒), Tsang Nai-chi (章乃器), Tseu Tao-fun (鄒韜奮), Wong Zao-dz (王造時), Li Kung-poh (李公樸), Soo Chi-li (沙千里) and Sz Liang (史良), who were arrested by the Chinese Police with the assistance of the Police authorities of the Foreign Settlements in November last year on a charge of endangering the internal security of the Republic of China, will be heard at the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow at 1 p.m. June 11. The accused have engaged 21 noted lawyers of Shanghai and Soochow to act in their defence.

引翔港越界筑路路段的小贩拒绝领取租界执照

由于他们此前从未缴纳此类捐税，且该区域属于中国当局管辖范围，蔬菜摊主一致拒绝向工部局领取执照。鉴于此拒绝行为，警方立即将他们驱离该区域，并阻止其他蔬菜小贩在虬江码头卸货及通过该区域。
蔬菜小贩们声称，工部局强迫人们仅为通过引翔港一段越界筑路路段而缴费的做法是不合理的，尤其是在当前正就越界筑路问题进行谈判之际，此举恐影响其生计。为此，他们已联合向各界提出申诉，寻求支持。

宋春澍等人案将于6月11日在苏州审理

June 8, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

Shanghai Public Daily News (市民日報) (comment) :-

THE DEMOLITION OF LOFTS

The S.M.C. desires to have the lofts in the International Settlement demolished on the ground that they are harmful to public health. To guard against further construction of lofts, the Council eventually intends to fix a stipulation that in future the height of rooms to be constructed be not more than 8 feet.
This restriction is not reasonable. Although no lofts can be constructed in rooms 8 feet high, yet as a matter of fact, it is to be feared that the unhealthy condition of a room 8 feet high will be similar to that of a loft.
We are of the opinion that the construction of lofts is entirely due to financial difficulties. Therefore, house rents and the Municipal Rate should be first reduced, if it is truly desired to demolish lofts.

Shanghai Kwangtung Pao (上海廣東報) publishes the following letter received from one Tsa Ts-kwen (詹子寬) :-

I hereby express my opinion as follows regarding the intention of the S.M.C. to demolish straw huts and lofts :-
The problem of residence is a big one to the poor people of Shanghai. Although sanitary equipment is important, yet the location of houses and the amount of the house rents are the most important matters to them, for they have to find houses convenient to their professions. Owing to high house rents, nobody is in a position to rent desirable houses. But the landlords are willing to leave their houses unoccupied. It is not strange that houses are not occupied for several years after construction. Who wants to live in straw huts or lofts? People have to do so on account of poverty.
I quite agree with the suggestion that the S.M.C. collect the Municipal Rate from vacant houses, for this may reduce the number of unoccupied houses.

Min Pao and other local newspapers :-

THE CASE AGAINST SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS : THEIR ANSWER TO THE PROSECUTION

In connection with the case against Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒), Wong Zao-dz (王造時), Li Kung-poh (李公樸), Soo Chi-li (沙千里), Tsang Nai-chi (章乃器), Tseu Tao-fun (鄒韜奮) and Sz Liang (史良), who have all been charged with offences against the internal security of the State, it is learned that the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow will resume the hearing of the case at 1 p.m. June 11.
Messrs. Kiang Yung (江庸), Liu Chung-yeu (劉崇佑), Yui Tsong-loh (俞鍾駱) and 18 other well-known lawyers at Shanghai and Soochow have been retained by these accused to act in their defence.

1937年6月8日。
午后译件。

《市民日报》（评论）：

拆除阁楼

工部局以有害公共卫生为由，希望拆除国际公共租界内的阁楼。为防止进一步建造阁楼，工部局最终打算规定，今后建造的房间高度不得超过8英尺。
这一限制并不合理。虽然8英尺高的房间无法建造阁楼，但事实上，人们担心8英尺高房间的不卫生状况将与阁楼类似。
我们认为，建造阁楼完全是由于经济困难所致。因此，若真欲拆除阁楼，应首先降低房屋租金和市政捐。

《上海广东报》刊登了一封来自詹子宽先生的来信：

本人谨就工部局意图拆除草棚和阁楼一事，发表如下意见：
住房问题是上海贫民的大问题。虽然卫生设施很重要，但对他们而言，房屋的位置和租金数额才是最重要的事项，因为他们必须寻找便于从事职业的住所。由于房租高昂，无人有能力租赁理想的房屋。但房东宁愿让房屋空置。房屋建成后数年无人居住，这并不奇怪。谁愿意住在草棚或阁楼里呢？人们是因为贫穷才不得不如此。
我完全赞同工部局对空置房屋征收市政捐的建议，因为这可能会减少空置房屋的数量。

《民报》及其他本地报纸：

宋春澍等人案：他们对起诉的答辩

据悉，沈钧儒、王造时、李公朴、沙千里、章乃器、邹韬奋和史良均被指控犯有危害国家安全罪，江苏高等法院将于6月11日下午1时恢复审理此案。
江庸、刘崇佑、俞钟骆及其他18位上海和苏州的知名律师已受聘为这些被告担任辩护律师。

pages.en:
June 8, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

The following is the text of their reply
to the prosecution, submitted to the Kiangsu High Court
at Soochow, which was jointly drafted by their lawyers:-

Facts of the Offence and Evidence

The accused in this case, noticing the
gravity of the national crisis, were in sorrow at the
imminent downfall of China. Their patriotism is not beyond
that shown by other fellow countrymen. At that time, both
the National Salvation Association and the accused were of
the opinion that the only alternative to avert national
extinction was to bring about unification of the people
throughout the country as a means of resistance against
outside aggression. For this reason, their speeches and
activities were all directed in this movement. The reason
why they advocated peaceful unification and concentration
of national strength was purely for the purpose of bringing
about the attainment of this object. All this can be
verified by the following items of this reply, that deal
with the National Salvation Association and the personal
correspondence and documents of the various accused concerned.
Later, the antagonistic feelings against
the enemy of the people throughout the country became more
and more energetic. Such a tendency among the people of
the country has brought strong support to the diplomatic
negotiations and policy of the Government, resulting in
the frustration of the plots of the traitorous elements,
the aversion of a serious crisis in North China, the
adoption of a stronger attitude in the Government's diplomatic
negotiations with Japan and a slight diminution in the
arrogant attitude of the enemy. However, just at the time
when the accused were regretting that their strength for
national salvation was too weak and that they had not yet
completed 1/100th of their duty towards their nation, they
were arrested one after another in the International
Settlement and the French Concession in Shanghai at mid-
night on November 22 last year, and were subsequently
charged in accordance with Article 6 of the Law Governing
Punishment of Persons Who Commit Acts With Intent To Injure
the Republic of China.

The Items of the Reply

According to Article 6 of the Law Governing
Punishment of Persons Who Commit Acts With Intent To Injure
the Republic of China, whoever is suspected of having
organized associations, held meetings or propagated a
doctrine irreconcilable with the Three Principles of the
People shall be punishable.
Whether the object of the National Salvation
Association is for the purpose of working for the salvation
of the nation or otherwise or whether the doctrine it
propagated is irreconcilable with the Three Principles of
the People or otherwise does not merit discussion. The
prosecution brought against the accused by the Kiangsu High
Court, though it contains 10 points dealing with the evidence
for this prosecution lacks sound and thorough understanding
and observation of the circumstances and evidence of this case.
pages.zh:
1937年6月8日。
午后译件。

以下是由他们的律师共同起草并提交给苏州江苏高等法院的答辩状全文：

犯罪事实与证据

本案被告鉴于国家危机深重，为国家 imminent 灭亡而悲痛。其爱国之心不亚于其他同胞。当时，全国救国会及被告均认为，避免国家灭亡的唯一出路是实现全国民众的统一，以此作为抵抗外来侵略的手段。因此，他们的言论和活动均指向这一运动。他们主张和平统一和集中国力，纯粹是为了实现这一目标。这一点可通过本答辩状中涉及全国救国会及各被告个人往来信函和文件的以下项目得到证实。
后来，全国民众对敌忾同仇的情绪日益高涨。民众中的这种倾向有力支持了政府的外交谈判和政策，导致奸徒阴谋破产，避免了华北的严重危机，使政府在对日外交谈判中采取更强硬的态度，敌人的傲慢态度也略有收敛。然而，就在被告们遗憾自己救国力量薄弱、尚未完成对国家责任的百分之一时，他们于去年11月22日午夜在上海国际公共租界和法租界相继被捕，随后依据《危害民国紧急治罪法》第六条被提起公诉。

答辩要点

根据《危害民国紧急治罪法》第六条，凡涉嫌组织团体、举行集会或宣传与三民主义不相容之主义者，均应受处罚。
全国救国会的宗旨是否旨在救国，或其宣传的主张是否与三民主义不相容，这些问题无需赘述。江苏高等法院对被告提起的公诉，虽列有10项关于公诉证据的内容，但缺乏对本案情势和证据的健全且透彻的理解与审视。

It is only a misinterpretation of the various documents
of the National Salvation Association. With a view to
clearing off this misconception, the following items of
the reply are submitted:-
(1) In the First Item of the prosecution,
it was alleged that the accused were intentionally obstruct-
ing the national policy of the Central Government towards
uprooting the Red Menace.
The National Salvation Association was
inaugurated for the purpose of dealing with Japan. The
question of Soviet Russia and the Communist Party has
nothing to do with the object and the principle of the
Association. As the prosecution lacks thorough understanding
of the contents of the various documents it referred to as
regards problems dealing with Japan, what the prosecution
alleged cannot, therefore, be regarded as sound and concrete.
It may be recalled that each time the proposal for a Sino-
Japanese joint operation against Reds was brought up for
discussion by Japan during the Sino-Japanese parleys held
at Nanking last year, it was rejected by the National
Government. From this, it can be seen that the policy
of the National Salvation Association towards the Red problem
is not inconsistent with that of the Government. That the
prosecution alleges that the accused were intentionally
obstructing the national policy of the Government towards
uprooting the Red menace indicates that it lacks sound
understanding of the true policy of the National Government.
(2) In the Second Item of the prosecution,
the accused were alleged to have recklessly attacked the
present Government, disregarding its controlling power.
It must be noted that the National Salvation
Association advocated unanimous unification throughout the
country because of the increasing aggression through alien
invasion. Such a tendency of the Association cannot be
taken as evidence for offence, especially in view of the
fact that the Government is earnestly desirous of peaceful
unification. As regards the terms "resistance against the
enemy" and "the salvation of the nation" contained in the
expressions "a unified political power for resistance against
the enemy" and "a unified political power for the salvation
of the nation," they constitute the unanimous demands of
the people throughout the country. For this reason, it
was recognized at that time that so long as the Government
could express its determination for resistance against the
enemy and for the salvation of the nation, it would be easy
for the Government to unify its political power. Moreover,
only when the Government possesses a unified political
power, will it be able successfully to carry out its
resistance against the enemy for the salvation of the nation.
The object and the method of the National Salvation
Association for advocating peaceful unification as mentioned
in the manifesto issued by the National Salvation Federation
of Various Circles Throughout the Country is quite in
conformity with the policy of General Chiang Kai-shek. It
is indispensable to bring about a unified political power
in order to resist the enemy and to avert national extinction,
while to bring about peace in the country constitutes the
principal path for the realization of such a unified
political power, and the admission of members of all parties
and cliques to a conference to decide upon measures for
resistance against the enemy is the only way to bring about
a peaceful unification.

这仅仅是对救国会各种文件的误解。为了澄清这一误会，现提交以下答复要点：

(1) 在起诉书第一项中，指控被告故意阻碍中央政府铲除“赤祸”的国家政策。
全国救国会的成立旨在应对日本问题。苏联和共产党的问题与本会的宗旨和原则无关。由于起诉方对其所引用的关于对日问题的各种文件内容缺乏透彻理解，因此其指控不能被视为合理和确凿。值得回顾的是，去年在南京举行的中日谈判期间，每当日本提出中日联合剿共的建议时，均被国民政府拒绝。由此可见，救国会对赤色问题的政策与政府的政策并不矛盾。起诉方指控被告故意阻碍政府铲除赤祸的国家政策，表明其对国民政府的真实政策缺乏正确的理解。

(2) 在起诉书第二项中，指控被告无视政府的统治权力，肆意攻击现政府。
必须指出，全国救国会主张全国统一，是因为外敌入侵日益加剧。鉴于政府真诚渴望和平统一，救国会的这种倾向不能被视为犯罪证据。至于“抗日统一政权”和“救国统一政权”表述中所包含的“抗敌”和“救国”字样，它们构成了全国人民的一致要求。因此，当时人们认识到，只要政府能表达出抗敌救国的决心，政府就易于统一其政治权力。而且，只有当政府拥有统一的政治权力时，才能成功地进行抗敌救国斗争。正如《全国各界救国联合会宣言》所述，全国救国会倡导和平统一的目标和方法，与蒋介石将军的政策完全一致。为了抵抗敌人和避免国家灭亡，建立统一的政治权力是必不可少的，而实现国内和平则是实现这种统一政治权力的主要途径，容纳各党派人士参加会议以决定抗敌方略，是实现和平统一的唯一途径。

TO THE PROSECUTION

(Continued from yesterday)

Such a proposal of the National Salvation
Association does not conflict with the national policy of
the Government. Moreover, the Government has the right
to decide whether or not such a proposal can be accepted.
Therefore, there is nothing illegal in this proposal which
was suggested by a body formed by the people due to their
patriotism.
(3) In the Third Item of the prosecution,
several excerpts from the booklet entitled "united resistance
against alien aggression" and a few replies of the accused
to questions asked by the Court were taken as reference
to allege that the accused were deliberately propagating
for the Communist Party and holding the Kuomintang and
the Government as among other parties and cliques. For
this reason, the accused were alleged in this prosecution
to have despised the present Government and to have
disseminated propaganda advantageous to the Communist Party.
However, this allegation proves just the contrary, as the
prosecution lacks a sound and thorough study of the contents
of the booklet in question. It must be noted that this
booklet was issued by Sung Chun-dz, Tsang Nai-chi, Tseu
Tao-fun and Dao Ying-ts (陶行知), it is not a document
of the National Salvation Association; it was only intended
to urge the Kuomintang to co-operate with the various
parties and cliques in order to bring about a united
resistance against Japan. The Communist Party is only one
of the important parties and cliques that the Kuomintang
was urged in this booklet to co-operate with and to lead.
The reason why the accused hoped that the Communist Party
would join hands with the Kuomintang to resist Japan was
because of the increasing aggression of outside invasion,
which deserves the concentration of all the national
military strength to cope with the situation; every drop
of blood and every round of ammunition should be utilized
for resistance against alien aggression. The proposal of
the accused for a joint and united operation against Japan
among all parties and cliques of the country is one of
the basic principles of our late leader Dr. Sun Yat-sen.
It is, therefore, improper to criticize the actions of
the accused and to bring up this prosecution before a
thorough study of the circumstances of the case has been
made.
(4) In the Fourth Item of the prosecution,
it was alleged that the slogans used by the National
Salvation Association, such as "The United Front," "The
People's National Salvation Front," etc., were the same
as "The People's Front". It was alleged in the Eighth
Item of the prosecution that the "People's Front" was the
slogan passed by the Third Internationale at its 7th
Conference of Representatives. Therefore, the prosecution
alleges that the slogan used by the accused was that of

全国救国会的这一提议并不违背政府的国家政策。此外，政府有权决定是否接受此类提议。因此，这一由民众出于爱国热情组成的团体所提出的提议并无任何违法之处。

(3) 在起诉书第三项中，引用了小册子《联合抗外侵略》中的几段摘录以及被告对法庭提问的几点回答，以此指控被告故意宣传共产党，并将国民党及政府视为众多党派和派系之一。因此，起诉方在此项指控中称被告蔑视现政府并散布有利于共产党的宣传。
然而，这一指控恰恰证明了相反的情况，因为起诉方缺乏对相关小册子内容的健全和深入研究。必须指出，这本小册子是由沈钧儒、章乃器、邹韬奋和陶行知（Dao Ying-ts (陶行知)）发行的，它并非全国救国会的文件；其目的仅是敦促国民党与各党派合作，以实现联合抗日。共产党只是这本小册子中敦促国民党合作并领导的众多重要党派之一。被告希望共产党与国民党携手抗日的原因，是因为外敌入侵日益加剧，这需要集中全国所有的军事力量来应对局势；每一滴血和每一发子弹都应用于抵抗外敌侵略。被告提出的全国各党派联合共同抗日的建议，是我们已故领袖孙中山先生的基本原则之一。因此，在未对案情进行彻底研究之前就批评被告的行为并提出此项起诉是不恰当的。

(4) 在起诉书第四项中，指控全国救国会使用的口号，如“统一战线”、“人民救国阵线”等，与“人民阵线”相同。起诉书第八项指控称，“人民阵线”是第三国际在其第七次代表大会上通过的口号。因此，起诉方指控被告使用的口号是

the Third Internationale. However, it must be remembered
that, in all, seven kinds of slogans were pointed out in
the prosecution as having been used in the periodicals
issued by the National Salvation Association, but none
of them was in identical terms with the "People's Front".
Moreover, the prosecution contains no remarks about the
meaning of the various slogans and the contents of the
periodicals of the Association. It is not known on what
ground the prosecution can allege that these slogans are
the same as that of the "People's Front". It must be
noted that the main object of the various "Fronts" used
in the periodicals issued by the National Salvation
Association was to urge the entire nation to bring about
a united resistance against the enemy for the salvation
of the nation. This can be verified by the meaning of
the wording of the titles of these slogans. They have
absolutely no affiliation whatever with "Fronts" promoted
by other countries. The prosecution not only lacks
thorough understanding of the true meaning of the various
"Fronts" appearing in the documents of the National
Salvation Association, but it seems that it was drafted
without knowledge of the true sense of the wording of
these terms and contains an arbitrary allegation that the
slogans used by the Association were one and the same as the
"People's Front". It may be recalled that the "People's
Front" prevailing in France and Spain is of an internal nature,
but the various "Fronts" contained in the documents of the
National Salvation Association were all intended to deal
with alien aggression; they are absolutely different from
each other. The true purpose for the advocacy of these
"Fronts" by the accused was to get the Kuomintang to act
as a guide to co-operate with the various parties and
cliques to bring about a united resistance against the
enemy, and the reason why the bandit suppression campaign
of the National Government was regarded as civil war in
the documents of the Association was for the purpose of
urging the Government to reserve its military strength
and that of the Communist Party in dealing with alien
aggression. All this can be proved by the thorough contents
of the wordings of these documents.
(5) In the Fifth Item of the prosecution,
it was alleged that the several points mentioned in the
letter (printed matter) from Mau Shih-tung (毛泽东),
criticizing the National Constitution appear to be in
conformity in several parts with the speech of the accused.
But a study of this speech referred to in the prosecution,
which dealt with the draft of the Constitution, reveals
that the principal aim of the accused was that at this time
of acute national crisis, the most urgent task for the
Government was to direct all its attention towards the
work of averting national extinction and maintaining the
existence of the country; the question of the enforcement
of the Constitution was only of secondary importance;
otherwise not only would the Government be unable to
safeguard the country, but there would be left no time
for it to talk about Constitution. The purpose of this
speech was to offer a suggestion to the Government; it
contained nothing whatever similar to the wording of the

第三国际的口号。然而，必须记住，起诉方总共指出了救国会刊物中使用的七种口号，但没有一种在措辞上与“人民阵线”完全相同。此外，起诉方并未对各种口号的含义及该会刊物的内容进行评论。不知起诉方依据何种理由指控这些口号与“人民阵线”相同。必须指出，全国救国会刊物中使用的各种“阵线”的主要目的是敦促全民族团结起来，共同抗敌救国。这可以从这些口号标题的字面含义中得到证实。它们与其他国家 promoted 的“阵线”绝对没有任何关联。起诉方不仅缺乏对全国救国会文件中出现的各种“阵线”真正含义的透彻理解，而且似乎是在不了解这些术语真实字义的情况下起草的，并武断地指控该会使用的口号与“人民阵线”是一回事。值得回顾的是，在法国和西班牙流行的“人民阵线”具有内部性质，但全国救国会文件中包含的各种“阵线”均旨在应对外敌侵略；两者截然不同。被告倡导这些“阵线”的真正目的是让国民党作为引导者，与各党派合作，实现联合抗敌；而在该会文件中将国民政府的剿共运动视为内战，其目的是为了敦促政府在应对外敌侵略时保留自身及共产党的军事实力。所有这些都可以从这些文件措辞的完整内容中得到证明。

(5) 在起诉书第五项中，指控毛泽东（Mau Shih-tung (毛泽东)）来信（印刷品）中批评《国民宪法》的几点，在几个方面似乎与被告的演讲相符。但对起诉方所引用的这篇涉及宪法草案的演讲进行研究后发现，被告的主要意图是，在国家危机严峻的时刻，政府最紧迫的任务是将全部注意力集中在避免国家灭亡和维护国家生存的工作上；实施宪法的问题仅处于次要地位；否则，政府不仅无法保卫国家，也将无暇谈论宪法。这次演讲的目的是向政府提出建议；其中没有任何内容与

pages.en:
June 9, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

contents of the letter from Mau Shih-tung. It is,
therefore, quite obvious that the allegation of the
prosecution that the meaning of the speech of the accused
was the same as that of the letter from Mau Shih-tung
is incorrect.
(6) In the Sixth Item of the prosecution,
it was alleged that the accused had done their best to
instigate the workers as a means to attain their illegal
purpose. But it must be noted that the "Strike Support
Committee" was inaugurated after the strike of the workers
of the Japanese cotton mills in Shanghai had taken place.
As it was then winter and as many of the workers had
been rendered unemployed and were facing starvation
because of the strike, this Committee was formed for the
purpose of extending them a little financial support in
order to enable them to avoid starvation.
(7) In the Seventh Item of the prosecution,
it stated that the newspaper "Struggle" (鬥爭報), seized
at the home of Tseu Tao-fun, could not be regarded as
evidence beneficial to the accused.
It must be noted that Tseu Tao-fun had
not known previously of the existence of this paper. It
was only after he had been told by his friend that in
this paper there were articles about him and Tsang Nai-chi
that he asked his friend to get a copy for his perusal.
This is how the paper came into his possession.
(8) In the Ninth Item of the prosecution,
the Sian Incident was taken as reference to allege that
the accused had conspired with military leaders in carrying
out subversive activities. But it must be noted that the
Sian Mutiny broke out on December 12 last year, while the
accused had already been arrested on November 22 the same
year. At the time of the outbreak of the incident, they
were held in custody in the detention house of the Kiangsu
High Court at Soochow. Not only were they unable to
conspire with outsiders, but they were also ignorant of
the affair. As regards the demand made by General Chang
Hsueh-liang for the release of the accused, it must be
noted that the activities of General Chang had nothing to
do with the accused who had already been held in detention
for 20 days at that time. Moreover, it was General Chang
alone in this country who asked for the release of these
accused. From a logical point of view, it is, therefore,
unreasonable to allege on such evidence that the accused
conspired with military leaders for subversive activities.
(9) In the Tenth Item of the prosecution,
Tsang Nai-chi, Sung Chun-tz and Tseu Tao-fun were
implicated in the activities of Lo Ching (羅青), who
was held as having participated in an organization the
intent of which was to injure the Republic of China.
It must be noted that Tsang Nai-chi never
detailed Lo Ching to undertake the responsibility for the
formation of any National Salvation Association, nor did
the National Salvation Federation of the Various Circles
Throughout the Country send out any representative to
organize any organizations. Moreover, the various National
Salvation Associations in the various other places were
established by the persons at those places. They are not
pages.zh:
1937年6月9日。
下午译本。

毛时栋（Mau Shih-tung，音译）来信的内容。因此，检方指控被告演讲的含义与毛时栋来信的含义相同，这一说法显然是不正确的。
(6) 在起诉书第六项中，指控被告竭力煽动工人，以此作为达到其非法目的的手段。但必须指出，“罢工后援会”是在上海日本棉纱厂工人罢工发生之后才成立的。当时正值冬季，许多工人因罢工而失业，面临饥饿威胁，成立该委员会的目的是向他们提供少许经济援助，使他们免于挨饿。
(7) 在起诉书第七项中，称在邹韬奋家中搜获的《斗争》报不能被视为对被告有利的证据。
必须指出，邹韬奋此前并不知道该报的存在。只是在他的朋友告诉他该报上有关于他和章乃器的文章后，他才请朋友弄来一份供他阅览。该报就是这样落入他手中的。
(8) 在起诉书第九项中，引用西安事变作为依据，指控被告与军事领袖共谋进行颠覆活动。但必须指出，西安兵变发生于去年12月12日，而被告已于同年11月22日被捕。事变发生时，他们被羁押在苏州江苏高等法院的看守所内。他们不仅无法与外界串通，而且对该事一无所知。至于张学良将军要求释放被告一事，必须指出，张将军的活动与被告无关，当时被告已被拘留20天。此外，在全国范围内，只有张将军一人要求释放这些被告。因此，从逻辑角度来看，仅凭此类证据指控被告与军事领袖共谋进行颠覆活动是不合理的。
(9) 在起诉书第十项中，章乃器、沈钧儒和邹韬奋被牵连进罗青（Lo Ching）的活动，罗青被认为参与了一个意图危害中华民国的组织。
必须指出，章乃器从未委派罗青负责组建任何救国会，全国各界救国联合会也未派出任何代表去组织任何团体。此外，其他各地的各种救国会均由当地人士建立。它们并非

pages.en:
June 9, 1937;
6 Afternoon Translation.

members of the National Salvation Federation of the
Various Circles Throughout the Country, therefore they
have not had any affiliations with the Federation.
In view of the foregoing explanations,
it can be seen that the national salvation work undertaken
by the accused was for the purpose of urging the entire
nation to adopt an unanimous resistance against alien
invasion. Their work is quite in conformity with the
past as well as the present policies of the National
Government. It appears that the prosecution lacks
thorough understanding of the motive of the National
Salvation Association and the national policy of the
Government, and therefore none of the evidence it contained
can stand.
The Kiangsu High Court is, therefore,
requested to deal with the case impartially and to acquit
the accused so as to uphold justice. The Court is also
requested to cease detention of the accused so as to
enable them to attend hearings of the case whenever
required.
pages.zh:
1937年6月9日；
6 下午译本。

全国各界救国联合会的成员，因此它们与该联合会没有任何隶属关系。
鉴于上述解释，可以看出，被告所从事的救国工作，目的是敦促全民族采取一致行动抵抗外敌入侵。他们的工作完全符合国民政府过去及现在的政策。看来，检方对救国会的动机以及政府的国家政策缺乏透彻了解，因此其所包含的证据均站不住脚。
因此，请求江苏高等法院公正处理此案，宣告被告无罪，以维护正义。同时请求法院停止对被告的羁押，以便他们在需要时能够出庭受审。

April 7, 1937.
Afternoon Translation

Eastern Times and other local newspapers :-

THE CASE AGAINST SUNG CHUN-DZ AND OTHERS

The following is the text of the prosecution
brought by the Procurator of the Soochow High Court against
Sung Chun-dz (沈鈞儒) and others for offences against
the internal security of the State:-

针对沈钧儒等人的案件

以下是苏州高等法院检察官针对沈钧儒（Sung Chun-dz）等人危害国家内部安全罪行的起诉书文本：-
本案被告姓名及详情如下：-
沈钧儒，男，64岁，律师，住上海愚园路桃源坊51号。
王造时（Wong Zao-dz），男，35岁，律师，住上海提丰路（Tifeng Road，音译）7B号。
李公朴（Li Kung-poh），男，36岁，育才补习学校校长，住上海愚园路亨昌里24号。
沙千里（Soo Chi-li），男，35岁，律师，住上海爱文义路（Avenue Road）524弄14号。

犯罪事实及证据

沈钧儒、王造时、李公朴、沙千里、章乃器、邹韬奋、史良和陶行知（仍在逃）因对现政府施政不满，借口通过统一各党派及各阶层来抵抗敌人和外敌侵略，提倡人民阵线以救国。起初，他们组织了一个名为文化界、职业界和妇女界救国会的团体。后来，他们与大学教授救国会、学生救国会、工人救国会、国难教育社及其他各种团体合作，组织了上海各界救国联合会，并开始发行印刷品，以此扩大其影响力和吸引力。

pages.en:
April 7, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

Ying-ts (who is still at large), under the pretext of resisting the enemy and alien aggression by the unification of various Parties and circles, promoted the People's Front for National Salvation. At first they organized a body known as the National Salvation Association of the Cultural Circles, Professional Circles and Women's Circles. Later, in collaboration with the University Professors' National Salvation Association, the Students' National Salvation Association, the Workers' National Salvation Association, the National Crisis Educational Society and various other bodies, they organized the National Salvation Federation of the Various Circles of Shanghai and started the publication of printed matter as a means of extending its influence and attraction.

Not long afterwards, they extended the sphere of the Federation and formed the National Salvation Federation of the Various Circles Throughout the Country. On May 31 of the 25th Year of the Chinese Republic (1936), they held an inauguration meeting of this Federation at the Young Men's Federation in the International Settlement of Shanghai and at the same time issued a manifesto dealing with the inauguration meeting of the Federation and the Preliminary Political Principles dealing with National Salvation and Resistance against Japan. On July 15 of the same year (1936), Sung Chun-dz, Tsang Na-chi, Dao Ying-ts, and Tseu Tao-fun published a pamphlet under the caption "Several Fundamental Conditions and Our Minimum Demands for Resistance Against Alien Invasion by Unification", advocating cessation of internal strife, release of political offenders, compromise with the Red Army and establishment of a united political Government for resistance against the enemy.

Having read in the newspapers the speeches delivered by Sung Chun-dz and others, Mou Cheh-tung (毛澤東), leader of the communist bandits who were then retreating in the North-west, sent a reply addressed to Sung Chun-dz and others in favour of their suggestions. Upon receipt of this favourable support, Sung Chun-dz and others, considering that they had attained their object, worked more energetically for the enlargement of their influence, and detailed Lo Ching, another accused, to undertake the formation of the National Salvation Federation of the Various Circles of Kiangsu Province. Henceforth, their activities became more and more energetic. At the same time, they started the publication of a paper known as "National Extinction Aversion Intelligence Report", strongly criticising the administrative policies of the National Government in the hope of reducing the people's confidence in the Government.

Taking advantage of the strike of workers that was then in progress in the various Japanese cotton mills in Shanghai, Sung Chun-dz and others formed a body known as the "Strikes Support Committee" and started the collection of contributions for financial support of the strikers, with the intention of urging the strikers to undertake activities coincident with those of the National Salvation Federation. For this reason, they (Sung Chun-dz, Wong Zao-dz, Soo Chi-li, Li Kung-poh, Tsang Na-chi, Tseu Tao-fun and Sz Liang) were arrested by the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety, now known as the Shanghai City Government Police Bureau, with the assistance of the Police authorities of the International Settlement and the French Concession in Shanghai.

1937年4月7日。下午译本。

不久之后，他们扩大了联合会的范围，成立了全国各界救国联合会。中华民国二十五年（1936年）5月31日，他们在上海公共租界的青年会举行了该联合会的成立大会，同时发布了关于联合会成立大会的宣言，以及关于救国和抗日初步政治原则的文件。同年（1936年）7月15日，沈钧儒、章乃器、陶行知和邹韬奋发表了一本小册子，标题为“团结御侮的几个基本条件与最低要求”，主张停止内战，释放政治犯，与红军妥协，并建立统一的抗敌政府。

当时正在西北撤退的共匪首领毛泽东（Mou Cheh-tung）在报纸上看到沈钧儒等人的演讲后，复信给沈钧儒等人，表示支持他们的建议。收到这种有利的支持后，沈钧儒等人认为已达到目的，便更加努力地扩大其影响力，并指派另一被告罗青负责组建江苏省各界救国联合会。从此，他们的活动越来越积极。同时，他们开始发行一份名为《救亡情报》的刊物，严厉批评国民政府的行政政策，企图降低民众对政府的信心。

利用当时上海各日本棉纱厂正在进行的工人罢工，沈钧儒等人成立了一个名为“罢工后援会”的团体，并开始募集捐款以资助罢工者，意图促使罢工者开展与救国联合会相一致的活动。为此，他们（沈钧儒、王造时、沙千里、李公朴、章乃器、邹韬奋和史良）在上海公共租界和法租界警务当局的协助下，被上海市公安局（现称上海市政府警察局）逮捕。

April 7, 1937. Afternoon Translation.

With the exception of Sz Liang, who disappeared
after release on bail, the arrested persons were handed
over, together with certain evidence, to this Court for
investigations as they were suspected of having conspired
with communist elements, organized illegitimate bodies
and instigated strikes of workers and students, with the
intention of menacing public peace and order as well as
overthrowing the Government. Later, Sz Liang surrendered
herself to this Court during the progress of the investiga-
tions that were being conducted by this Court. Later,
Lo Ching was arrested in Kiangying and was handed to this
Court by the Military Court of the Military Affairs
Commission.

During the time when the investigations into
this case were still in progress, Koo Liu-hsiang, Zung
Chung-kao, Chang Chung-mei, Chen Tao-hung and Chen Tso,
as representatives from the National Salvation Federation
of the Various Circles of Shanghai, submitted a petition
to this Court requesting the release of Sung Chun-dz and
others. In view of the fact that these persons were all
members of the National Salvation Association of the
Professional Circles of Shanghai, moreover, as Zung Chung-
kao was the Secretary of this Association, they must have
had connections with the communists; they were therefore
likewise held in detention by this Court pending investi-
gations. As a result of these investigations, it was
ascertained that the principal object of the various accused
in establishing such bodies and propagating doctrines that
were contrary to the Three Principles of the People was to
endanger the internal security of the Republic of China.
The evidence for the prosecution is as
follows:-

(1) In the manifesto issued by the National
Salvation Federation of Various Circles Throughout the
Country, it states: "The attacks made on Soviet Russia by
various Powers are unjustified, while bandit suppression
in China is also wrongful," and "A small number of people
with ulterior motives still regard the Soviet Union and the
Communist Party as the principal enemies of the Chinese
people."

Similar statements have also frequently
been published in the Salvation Bulletin. It must be clear
to all that the Communist Party has done serious damage
to the country. The object of the Communist Party is
inconsistent with that of the Three Principles of the People.
The accused formed an organization proposing that no
punitive action be taken against the Communist Party and
openly criticising the bandit suppression policy of the
Government; it is very obvious that they were intentionally
obstructing the national policy of the Central Government
towards uprooting the Red menace.

(2) Besides advocating that political
offenders be immediately released, the above mentioned
manifesto also states that "The various parties and cliques
should formally send their respective representatives and
the People's Front for National Salvation is willing to
arrange a general principle for joint resistance against
the enemy and to establish a unified political power to
resist the enemy". The Anti-Japanese National Salvation
Preliminary Political Principles also demand that "A unified
national salvation political power be immediately established."
From this evidence, it is clear that the
accused took similar steps to these

1937年4月7日。下午译本。

除施良在保释后失踪外，其余被捕人员连同部分证据已移交本院审讯，因其涉嫌与共产主义分子勾结，组织非法团体，煽动工人与学生罢工，意图危害公共治安与秩序，并推翻政府。嗣后，施良在本院进行审讯期间向本院自首。此后，罗青在江阴被捕，由军事委员会军事法庭移交本院。

在本案审讯仍在进行期间，顾留祥、宗仲高、张仲梅、陈道宏及陈佐作为上海各界救国联合会的代表，向本院提交请愿书，请求释放宋春泽等人。鉴于这些人均为上海职业界救国会会员，且宗仲高系该会秘书，他们必然与共产党人有联系；因此，本院亦将他们羁押候审。经审讯查明，各被告建立此类团体并宣传违背三民主义之学说，其主要目的旨在危害中华民国内部安全。
检方证据如下：

(1) 在全国各界救国联合会发布的宣言中称：“列强对苏俄之攻击毫无理由，而中国之剿匪亦属错误”，以及“少数别有用心之人仍视苏联与共产党为中国人民之主要敌人”。

《救亡情报》中也经常刊登类似言论。众所周知，共产党对国家造成了严重损害。共产党之宗旨与三民主义相悖。被告组建组织，主张不对共产党采取惩罚行动，并公开批评政府之剿匪政策；显而易见，他们有意阻碍中央政府根除赤祸之国策。

(2) 除主张立即释放政治犯外，上述宣言还称：“各党派应正式派遣各自代表，人民救国阵线愿意安排共同抗敌之总原则，并建立统一政权以抗敌”。《抗日救国初步政治纲领》亦要求“立即建立统一的救国政权”。由此证据可知，被告采取了与这些

April 7, 1937.
Afternoon Translation.

From this evidence, it is clear that the
accused took similar steps to those of Tsang Nan-chi who,
in his "Communist Party Letter to the Kuomintang" addressed
to Lo Ching, states that "We uphold the establishment of
a Republic of a Unified China", and "We uphold the National
Defence Government of the Unified Country".
As the accused are under the control of
the National Government and Sung Chung-dz and Lo Ching also
called themselves "Kuomintang members", and as they know
very well that the Kuomintang is the only organization
responsible for the establishment of the Chinese Republic,
their absurd allegations as mentioned above have recklessly
attacked the present Government, disregarding its control-
ling right, and they have intended to form another
Government besides the Present Government.
(3) In the various publications issued by
Sung Chun-dz, Tsang Nan-chi, Dao Ying-ts and Tseu Tao-fun
suggesting the several fundamental conditions and minimum
demands for a unification against aggressors, the following
sentences are found:
"To make a truce with the Red Army for a
joint resistance against Japan," "The so-called various
parties and cliques mostly lean towards the Communist Party,"
"Recently the Communist Party proposed a joint resistance
against Japan, but the Kuomintang made no comment at all;
this will make the public believe that the Communist Party
is ready to give up its established policy and has taken
a wider view of the general situation."
In the Livelihood Weekly Magazine, an
article published by Dao Ying-ts states that "The Red Army
is one of the three main groups in China". This shows
that he intends to render assistance to the Communist Party
and to weaken the public confidence in the Government and
the Kuomintang.
Furthermore, when asked by this Court that
as the Communist Party is without nationality and believes
in cosmopolitanism, how can it save the country, Sung Chun-
dz replied: "We have not studied this question". (vide
records of interrogation of December 23, 1936). When
further asked: "As when the Central army was offering
resistance in 1932 and during the various battles along
the Great Wall, the Red Army took advantage of the situation
by making a counter attack at the rear, how can the Red
Army co-operate with the Government and what assurance is
there that no similar action will be taken by the Communist
Party afterwards?", the accused could not give a reasonable
answer, but simply replied: "After the co-operation, if
the Communist Party dares to turn against the Government,
it will be easy for the Government and the people to check
it by force."
According to Li Kung-poh's statement, "From
what I read in newspapers and magazines, the Communist Party
is anti-Japanese, but whether it is determined to resist
Japan is another question." (vide the records of interrogation
dated as above) From this observation, it is still unknown
whether the Communist Party is determined to resist the
aggressors. The accused placed the Kuomintang and the
Government among various other parties and cliques, and at
the same time, they maintained that the so-called "various
parties and cliques are mainly, of course, meant the Chinese
Communist Party." This proves that they despised the present Government

1937年4月7日。
下午译本。

由此证据可知，被告采取了与曾南池类似的步骤，曾南池在给罗青的《共产党致国民党书》中称：“我们拥护建立统一中国之共和国”，以及“我们拥护统一国家之国防政府”。
由于被告受国民政府管辖，且宋春泽与罗青亦自称“国民党党员”，而他们深知国民党是负责建立中华民国的唯一组织，其上述荒谬言论肆意攻击现政府，无视其统治权，并意图在现政府之外另立政府。
(3) 在宋春泽、曾南池、陶英士（音译）及邹韬奋发布的关于统一抗侵略之若干基本条件及最低要求的各类出版物中，可见以下语句：
“与红军停战以共同抗日”，“所谓各党派大多倾向共产党”，“近日共产党提出共同抗日，而国民党未置一词；这将使公众认为共产党已准备放弃既定政策，并对大局采取更宽广之视角”。
在《生活周刊》中，陶英士（音译）发表的一篇文章称“红军是中国三大主力之一”。这表明他意图协助共产党，并削弱公众对政府及国民党的信心。
此外，当本院问及既然共产党无国籍且信奉世界主义，如何能救国时，宋春泽回答：“我们未研究过此问题”。（见1936年12月23日审讯记录）。当进一步问及：“1932年中央军抵抗之际及长城各战役期间，红军趁势在后背发动反击，红军如何能与政府合作？有何保证共产党日后不会采取类似行动？”被告无法给出合理答复，仅回答：“合作之后，若共产党敢背叛政府，政府与人民很容易以武力加以制止。”
据李公朴陈述，“从我在报刊杂志上所读到的内容来看，共产党是抗日的，但其是否决心抗日则是另一回事。”（见上述日期之审讯记录）由此观察，尚不知共产党是否决心抵抗侵略者。被告将国民党与政府与其他各党派并列，同时声称所谓“各党派”主要当然意指中国共产党。这证明他们蔑视现政府

and their propaganda was no doubt advantageous to the
Communist Party.
(4) The so-called People's Front for
National Salvation (also called the People's Front, the
United Front, the People's United Front, National Salvation
Front, etc.) is explained by Sung Chun-dz, Wong Zao-dz,
Li Kung-poh, Soo Chi-li, Tsang Nai-chi, Tseu Tao-fun, Sz
Liang, Koo Liu-hsiang, Zung Chung-kao, etc. as being
different from the People's Front promoted by the Communist
Party. Tseu Tao-fun produced the Life Daily (生活日報)
edited by himself to prove this statement. However,
according to Lo Ching, the accomplice, "As the terms are
not yet unified, the People's Front, the People's Front
for National Salvation, the National Salvation Front, the
Unified Front, the Racial Front, the United Front, etc. are
all one and the same." (vide records of statements taken
down on January 19, 1937) The Life Daily produced by Tseu
Tao-fun states that with a view to producing a clear
understanding, the term "People's Front" should be abandoned
and the "People's United Front" substituted. This does not
prove that the People's Front for National Salvation and
the People's Front are two different bodies; on the contrary,
it furnishes the evidence that the title of People's Front
had long been used by the accused. In the home of Tsang
Nai-chi, "The Intelligence" (情報), No. 1 of the Chinese
Students' National Salvation Federation was seized, in which
it states that a manifesto be issued and funds be collected
to assist the Spanish People's Front Government. This
shows that the People's Front for National Salvation and
the People's Front are, in reality, terms of a similar nature.
This can further be verified by the Fu Hua Reading Society
(大化讀書會) formed by Tseu Shou-yee (周守義), Zung Dz-
wen (程韻文) and Kan Shang (甘爽), whose object is anti-
capitalism; in reality it is a communistic organization.
This society once joined the National Salvation Association
of Professional Circles, and was enlisted as 1433rd section
with Tseu Shou-yee as Chief. The Second Branch of the
Kiangsu High Court has already sentenced Tseu and the others
to terms of imprisonment on a charge of forming a society
with intent to injure the Republic of China. The accused
all confess that the National Salvation Association of
Professional Circles joined the National Salvation Federation
of Various Public Bodies of Shanghai and the latter Federation
further joined the National Salvation Federation of Various
Circles Throughout the Country. It is quite clear that
at its establishment, the National Salvation Federation
allowed communist elements to join. The People's Front
is one of the titles of the Communist Party and this is not
denied by the accused. The civil war in Spain was caused
by the People's Front directed by the Communist Party.
The accused used these slogans to influence the people and
their desire is to assist the Spanish Popular Front Government.
On the one hand, the accused point to the bandit suppression
campaign of the National Government as civil war, and on the
other hand, desire to assist the civil war of a People's
Front in a foreign country. Who can believe that they have
no international background or that they have no political
ambition?

1937年4月7日。下午译本。

且其宣传无疑有利于共产党。
(4) 所谓人民救国阵线（又称人民阵线、统一战线、人民联合阵线、救国阵线等），据宋春泽、王造时、李公朴、沙千里、曾乃炽、邹韬奋、施良、顾留祥、宗仲高等人解释，称其与共产党提倡的人民阵线不同。邹韬奋出示其主编的《生活日报》以证明此说法。然而，据同案犯罗青称，“由于术语尚未统一，人民阵线、人民救国阵线、救国阵线、统一阵线、种族阵线、联合阵线等均为一回事。”（见1937年1月19日笔录记录）邹韬奋出示的《生活日报》称，为了产生清晰的理解，应放弃“人民阵线”一词，代之以“人民联合阵线”。这并不能证明人民救国阵线与人民阵线是两个不同的团体；相反，这提供了证据表明被告长期使用人民阵线这一名称。在曾乃炽家中，查获中国学生救国联合会《情报》第一期，其中称应发布宣言并募集资金以援助西班牙人民阵线政府。这表明人民救国阵线与人民阵线实为性质相似的术语。这一点可由周守义、程韵文及甘爽组成的“大化读书会”进一步证实，该会宗旨为反资本主义；实则为共产主义组织。该社曾加入职业界救国会，并被编为第1433分部，由周守义任主任。江苏高等法院第二分院已以组织意图危害中华民国之社团罪判处周等人有期徒刑。被告均承认职业界救国会加入了上海各公共团体救国联合会，而后者联合会又加入了全国各界救国联合会。很明显，全国各界救国联合会在成立之初便允许共产主义分子加入。人民阵线是共产党的称号之一，被告对此并不否认。西班牙内战是由共产党领导的人民阵线引起的。被告利用这些口号影响民众，其愿望是援助西班牙人民阵线政府。一方面，被告指称国民政府之剿匪运动为内战，另一方面，又希望援助外国人民阵线之内战。谁能相信他们没有国际背景或没有政治野心？

(5) In the letter (printed matter) sent by Communist Mou Cheh-tung to Sung Chun-dz and others, it states "The Nanking Government on May 5 promulgated the Constitution and the regulations governing the organization of the National Convention. We are of the opinion that this is anti-democratic. We cannot recognize that this National Convention has the authority to represent the opinions of the people throughout the country. We feel that the existence of the National Convention is harmful. We hope you and all national salvation bodies throughout the country will detail representatives to participate in the Chinese Soviet Government." In this letter, Mou Cheh-tung has no intention to dissolve the Soviet Government, but hopes that all national salvation bodies will detail representatives to participate in the bogus government. Tsang Nai-chi eventually gave this reactionary literature to Lo Ching and instructed him to undertake the formation of the National Salvation Federation of Various Circles of Kiangsu Province (vide the statements made by Lo Ching). However, they still pretend that they have no intention to injure the Republic of China. Who will believe this?
(6) The accused firmly deny having directed students to suspend their studies, but they do not refute the formation of the Strike Support Committee. They further said that the National Salvation Association of Workers also joined the National Salvation Federation of Various Public Bodies of Shanghai. Under the name of the National Salvation Federation, they distributed copies of a handbill of appeal on behalf of 3,500,000 Shanghai residents, in which it states "These 200,000 workers may all be turned into heroes on the battlefield". Thus, they have done their best to instigate the workers, whose knowledge is slight. Nevertheless, the accused still argue that their intention is to save the nation.
(7) In the home of Tseu Tao-fun, the newspaper "Struggle" (鬥爭) published by the Communist Party was seized. It states "The Tsang Nai-chi clique is an anti-Stalin clique and the national salvation front formed by him and others should be opposed for it has no political ambition". In spite of this, the view of Tsang and others is still contrary to the Three Principles of the People, and this cannot be regarded as evidence beneficial to the accused.
(8) Although the accused say that they have no connection whatever with the 3rd Internationale, yet it will be remembered that the People's Front is the slogan passed by the 3rd Internationale at its 7th Conference of Representatives. They use the slogan passed by the 3rd Internationale and in many periodicals, they repeatedly declare "It is not easy to achieve success in suppressing the red bandits. We do not believe that the Kuomintang will undertake the work of national salvation". In their

(5) 在共产党人毛泽东寄给沈钧儒等人的信件（印刷品）中称：“南京政府于5月5日公布宪法及国民大会组织法。吾人认为此举反民主。吾人不能承认该国民大会有权代表全国民意。吾人认为国民大会之存在有害。希望阁下及全国各界救国团体派遣代表参加中华苏维埃政府。”在此信中，毛泽东并无意解散苏维埃政府，而是希望各界救国团体派遣代表参加该伪政府。章乃器最终将这份反动文献交给罗青，并指示他负责组建江苏省各界救国联合会（参见罗青之陈述）。然而，他们仍假装无意危害中华民国。谁会相信这一点？
(6) 被告坚决否认曾指导学生停课，但他们并不否认成立罢工后援会。他们进一步称，工人救国会也加入了上海各公共团体救国联合会。以救国联合会的名义，他们分发了代表350万上海市民的呼吁传单副本，其中称“这20万工人都可成为战场上的英雄”。因此，他们极力煽动知识浅薄的工人。尽管如此，被告仍辩称其意图在于救国。
(7) 在邹韬奋家中，查获共产党出版的刊物《斗争》。其中称“章乃器一伙是反斯大林派，由他等人组成的救国阵线因无政治野心而应受反对”。尽管如此，章乃器等人的观点仍违背三民主义，这不能被视为对被告有利的证据。
(8) 虽然被告声称他们与第三国际毫无关联，但需知人民阵线是第三国际在第七次代表大会上通过的口号。他们使用第三国际通过的口号，并在多种期刊中反复宣称“剿赤不易成功。吾人不信国民党能承担救国工作”。在他们的

against insults is contained this sentence: "We agree with

(9) Among the eight suggestions made by Chang
Hsueh-liang at the time of the Sian Incident on December 12,
1936, one advocated "the admission of various parties and
cliques into national affairs, the immediate release of
leaders of the patriotic movement arrested in Shanghai and
the convention of a national salvation conference." The
accused strongly denied having anything to do with this, and
stated that at the time of the inauguration of the National
Salvation Federation of Various Circles Throughout the
Country on May 31, 1936, they had not heard anything about
there being a national salvation association in Sian.
However, in the first issue of the National Extinction Aversion
Intelligence Report dated May 6, 1936, there was a report about the
"glorious patriotic movement of Sian students" stating that
"there were national salvation organizations in all the
schools in Sian." The 25th issue of this publication contained
a detailed account of the inauguration of the National
Salvation Federation of Various Circles in the North-west
as well as the following statement: "We have printed and
distributed more than 2,000 copies of the manifesto and the
compendium of the National Salvation Federation of Various
Circles Throughout the Country." This shows that the
accused in saying that there is no national salvation
association in Sian are shuffling deliberately.
The National Extinction Aversion Intelli-
gence Report published in its 27th issue on November 22,
1936, the following telegram addressed to Chang Hsueh-liang
in Sian by the National Salvation Federation of Various
Circles Throughout the Country :-

".....We hope you will, in accordance
with your advocacy of immediate resistance to Japan,
submit as soon as possible a firm demand to the Central
authorities that the diplomatic negotiations in Nanking
be immediately stopped and that a national war against
Japan be started. We also hope that you will send
telegrams to various military leaders asking them to
unanimously urge the Central authorities and themselves
despatch troops to Suiyuan to assist the forces there.
The matter is urgent and the nation is in danger.
Please carry out the above immediately."

Only ten days after the despatch of this
telegram, the Sian Incident broke out. Chang Hsueh-liang,
in his circular telegram, clearly demanded the release of
the accused. Furthermore, the measures advocated by the
two parties exactly corresponded with each other. From this
one can see their connections.
It is true that the telegram referred to
above only instigated Chang Hsueh-liang to obtain the
co-operation of other military leaders to urge the Government.

所提出的巩固及抵抗侮辱的条件中，包含这样一句话：“我们同意中国共产党和中国红军的政策。”这特别表明他们的政策符合第三国际通过的决议。他们意图危害中华民国，难逃惩罚。
(9) 在1936年12月12日西安事变期间，张学良提出的八项主张中，有一项提倡“开放各党各派参与国事，立即释放在上海被捕的爱国运动领袖，并召开救国会议”。被告强烈否认与此有任何关系，并称在1936年5月31日全国各界救国联合会成立之时，他们未听闻西安有救国会。然而，在1936年5月6日出版的《救亡情报》第一期中，有关于“西安学生光荣爱国运动”的报道，称“西安各学校均有救国组织”。该刊第25期详细记载了西北各界救国联合会的成立情况，并附有如下声明：“我们已印发并分发全国各界救国联合会宣言及简章两千余册。”这表明被告声称西安无救国协会是在故意推诿。
1936年11月22日出版的《救亡情报》第27期刊登了全国各界救国联合会发给西安张学良的以下电报：-

“……望阁下本着立即抗日的主张，尽快向中央当局提出坚定要求，立即停止南京的外交谈判，并开始对日民族战争。亦望阁下致电各位军事领袖，请他们一致敦促中央当局，并自行派兵赴绥远援助当地部队。事态紧急，国家危在旦夕。请立即执行上述事项。”

在此电报发出仅十天后，西安事变爆发。张学良在其通电中明确要求释放被告。此外，双方所倡导的措施完全吻合。由此可见他们之间的联系。
诚然，上述电报仅是鼓动张学良争取其他军事领袖合作以敦促政府

All this is sufficient to show that they had the desire to

(10) 罗青承认负责组建江苏省各界救国联合会，并称在与章乃器商议时，沈钧儒和邹韬奋也在场。在其身上搜获以下物品：-

Conclusion

By forming an organization with the intent of
injuring the Republic of China and propagating a doctrine
irreconcilable with the Three Principles of the People,
the fourteen accused in this case have, according to Articles 1
and 28 of the Criminal Code, jointly committed the offence
mentioned in Article 6 of the Law Governing the Punishment
of Persons who Commit Offences to Injure the Republic of
China. Apart from the issue of circular orders of arrest
for Dao Ying-ts, Chang Chung-mei, Zung Tao-hung and Chen Tso
whose whereabouts are unknown, prosecution is hereby
instituted against the remaining accused in accordance with
Articles 230 and 243 of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
The following files and evidence are handed
over to you:-
(1) 12 files,
(2) evidence as stated in list,
as well as the following accused to be tried according to
law:-
(a) in custody: Sung Chun-dz, Wong Zao-dz, Li Kung-pch,
Soo Chi-li, Tsang Nai-chi, Tseu Tao-fun, Sz Liang
and Lo Ching;

kao.

结论

本案十四名被告通过组成意图危害中华民国之组织及宣传与三民主义不相容之学说，根据《刑法》第一条及第二十八条，共同犯了《危害民国紧急治罪法》第六条所述之罪行。除对下落不明的陶行知、张仲梅、宗道宏（音译）及陈佐签发通缉令外，现依据《刑事诉讼法》第二百三十条及第二百四十三条对其余被告提起公诉。
现将以下卷宗及证据移交给贵院：-
(1) 卷宗12宗，
(2) 清单所列证据，
以及以下被告依法受审：-
(a) 在押：沈钧儒、王造时、李公朴、沙千里、章乃器、邹韬奋、史良及罗青；
(b) 具保释放：顾留馨（音译）及宗仲高（音译）。

December 5, 1936.
（印：Morning Translation）
China: Files and other local newspapers :-
MR. SUNG CHUN SHIH AND OTHERS REMOVED TO SOOCHOW HIGH COURT
A telegram from Soochow reports that Messrs Sun, Chun Shih(沈鈞儒), Wong Chao Shih(王造時), Chow Tao Teng(鄒韜奮), Chang Nan Chi(章乃器), Li Kung Fu (李公樸) and Soo Chi Lien(沙千里) were transferred on the afternoon of December 4 to the Kiangsu High Court at Soochow by the Shanghai Bureau of Public Safety. At 6 p.m. they were brought separately before Procurator Cong Chan Nyien (翁贊年) of the High Court for examination, after which they were held in the newly constructed Detention House.

Communist Party Concerned Over Arrests
The Sing Sung News Agency(新聲社) reports that, according to information received, the Communist Party is much concerned over the arrest of Mr. Sung Chun Shih and others, because it is an undeniable fact that these men have had co-operative dealings with the working members of the Party.
The "China News Agency"(中國新聞社) in New York, U.S.A., has close relations with a certain printing company in Shanghai. This printing company is managed by a foreigner named "Ma-Ke-Lai-Li"(馬格南利) who is connected with the Communist Party and undertakes the printing of reactionary literature. Following the arrest of Mr. Sung Chun Shih and others, one Mr. Dao(陶) of the "China News Agency" of New York sent a telegram to Mr. "Ma-Ke-Lai-Li" requesting information regarding the cause of their arrest and inquiring after their health, and advising him to request people to speak in their favour. The reply given by Mr. "Ma-Ke-Lai-Li" contains only four words: "Friends are in distress".

Miss Sze Liang Still A Fugitive
Miss Sze Liang(史良), the female lawyer, has so far failed to put in an appearance after she was released on the guarantee of her lawyers, Messrs Chang Tse Niang(張志讓) and Tong Hao(唐豪). The Procuratorate of the Kiangsu Third Branch High Court has issued a circular warrant for her arrest and has bound over the two lawyers on cash securities of $500 each and ordered them to locate Miss Sze Liang within ten days.
It is learned that the two lawyers and the family of Miss Sze Liang have done their best to locate her but without success. Miss Sze Liang's mother has become ill since receiving a letter from her daughter in which she stated that she would not return.
Yesterday the two lawyers published advertisements in the local newspapers advising Miss Sze Liang to appear in Court. A similar advertisement was also published by Miss Sze Liang's brothers and sisters.

中国：档案及其他本地报纸：-
沈钧儒等人被移送苏州高等法院
来自苏州的电报称，沈钧儒、王造时、邹韬奋、章乃器、李公朴和沙千里诸先生于12月4日下午由上海市公安局移送至苏州江苏高等法院。下午6时，他们被分别带至高等法院检察官翁赞年面前受审，随后被羁押于新建的看守所。

共产党关注逮捕事件
新声社报道，据收到的消息，共产党对沈钧儒等人被捕一事极为关切，因为这些人曾与该党工作人员有过合作往来，这是一个不可否认的事实。
位于美国纽约的“中国新闻社”与上海某印刷公司关系密切。该印刷公司由一名名为“马格南利”(音译)的外国人管理，此人与共产党有联系，并承印反动刊物。沈钧儒等人被捕后，纽约“中国新闻社”的一位陶先生致电“马格南利”，询问他们被捕的原因及健康状况，并建议他请人为他们声援。“马格南利”的回复仅有四个字：“朋友遭难”。

史良女士仍在逃
女律师史良女士在其辩护律师张志让和唐豪具保释放后，至今仍未露面。江苏高等法院第三分院检察处已签发通缉令逮捕她，并责令两名律师各缴纳500元现金保证金，限他们在十日内找到史良女士。
据悉，两名律师及史良女士的家属已尽力寻找，但未有结果。史良女士的母亲自收到女儿表示不会回来的信件后，便病倒了。
昨日，两名律师在本地报纸刊登广告，劝告史良女士出庭。史良女士的兄弟姐妹也刊登了类似的广告。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. ......
Special Branch S.2. XXXX,
REPORT
Date November 29, 1935
Subject Letter of inquiry from the Belgian Consulate General regarding the
present whereabouts of Mr Leon Terrie.
Made by D.S. Jones Forwarded by. [签名]

With reference to the inquiry dated November 25, 1935
from the Acting Consul General for Belgium concerning the
present whereabouts of Mr Leon Terrie, I have to state that
this individual has now left Shanghai for Europe.
According to information procured from Melchers & Co.,
No. 210 Kiukiang Road, Terrie was signed on in this port as a
member of the crew of the Norddeutscher Lloyd steamship HAVEL,
prior to her departure to Japan on October 23, 1935. After
visiting certain ports in Japan this vessel returned to
Shanghai and on November 14th steamed out of Shanghai on the
homeward voyage to Hamburg. Terrie was still on board when the
vessel departed for the second time and is believed to be
working his passage to Europe in the capacity of ship's fireman.

D.C. Special Branch D.S. [签名: D.S. Jones]
[签名]

档案编号 ......
特务科 S.2. XXXX,
报告
日期 1935年11月29日
事由 比利时总领事馆关于莱昂·特里先生目前下落的查询函。
撰写人 D.S. Jones 转呈人 [签名]

关于1935年11月25日比利时代理总领事就莱昂·特里先生目前下落提出的查询，兹陈述如下：此人现已离开上海前往欧洲。
根据从九江路210号美最时洋行获取的信息，特里于1935年10月23日北德意志劳埃德轮船公司“哈维尔”号蒸汽船启程前往日本之前，在本港签约成为该船船员。该船在访问日本某些港口后返回上海，并于11月14日驶离上海，踏上返回汉堡的归途。该船第二次启航时特里仍在船上，据信他以船舶司炉的身份搭船前往欧洲。

特务科副督察 D.S. [签名: D.S. Jones]
[签名]

Shanghai, November 25th., 1935.

CONSULAT GÉNÉRAL
DE
BELGIQUE

N° 2201.
---
Cl : 409.

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. B. REGISTRY
B. D. 7111
27-11-35）

Dear Sir,

I have the honour to request that you be
good enough to institute the necessary proceedings
in order to locate the present whereabouts of a cer-
tain Mr. Léon TERRIE, who claims to be a Belgian.

Mr. Terrie last occupied House N°7, Avenue Dubail
256, but left the house on the 30th September last. All
trace of his address has been lost since, and the efforts
of the French Municipal Police to locate it on the French
Concession have proved fruitless.

I would therefore be much obliged if the same
enquiry could be made with regard to the International
Settlement. I am unfortunately unable to give you any
information on this person. It seems however, that Mr.
Terrie was frequently seen at the "Bar Marseillais" on
Broadway, and that he pretended having found a job with
the Whangpoo Conservancy Board.

Thanking you for any steps you may take in this
matter and for such information as you may be able to
gather, I remain, Dear Sir,

Yours faithfully,
For the Acting Consul-General,
b/o The Vice-Consul:
（签名）

The Commissioner,
Shanghai Municipal Police,
Foochow Road,
Shanghai.

上海，1935年11月25日。

比利时总领事馆

第 2201 号。

（印：上海公共租界工部局警务处
特务科登记处
B. D. 7111
1935年11月27日）

尊敬的先生，

谨请阁下采取必要措施，以查明自称比利时人的莱昂·特里先生的目前下落。

特里先生最后居住于杜巴伊路256号7号住宅，但已于去年9月30日搬离。此后其地址线索全部中断，法租界巡捕房为查找其下落所作的努力均无结果。

因此，如能就公共租界范围内进行同样的查询，我将不胜感激。遗憾的是，我无法提供关于此人的任何信息。然而，似乎有人经常在百老汇路的“马赛酒吧”见到特里先生，且他声称已在黄浦浚浦局找到了一份工作。

感谢阁下为此事采取的任何步骤以及所能收集到的任何信息，我谨此致意，

您忠实的，
代表代理总领事，
由副领事代办：
（签名）

致警务处长，
上海公共租界工部局警务处，
福州路，
上海。

S. D. REGISTER
B. D. 7111
3 /12 35）

December 2, 35.

Acting Consul General for Belgium,
Shanghai.

Sir,

I have the honour to refer to your letter No.2201
dated November 25, 1935, and to inform you that Mr. Leon
Terrie left Shanghai on board the Norddeutscher Lloyd
steamer "HAVEL" which sailed for Hamburg on November 14,
1935. According to Messrs. Melchers & Co., 210 Kiukiang
Road, Mr. Terrie was engaged as a member of the crew of
the s.s. "HAVEL" prior to her departure for Japan on
October 23, 1935. After calling at various ports in
Japan, this vessel returned to Shanghai and finally left
for Hamburg with Mr. Terrie on board on the date mentioned.

I have the honour to be,
Sir,
Your obedient servant,

(Sd) K. M. Bourne.
Acting Commissioner of Police.

KMC

1935年12月2日。

致比利时驻上海代理总领事，

先生，

谨此提及阁下1935年11月25日第2201号来函，并告知阁下，莱昂·特里先生已乘坐北德意志劳埃德轮船公司“哈维尔”号轮离开上海，该轮于1935年11月14日驶往汉堡。据九江路210号美最时洋行称，特里先生于1935年10月23日“哈维尔”号轮启程前往日本之前，受雇为该船船员。该船在停靠日本各港口后返回上海，并最终于上述日期载着特里先生启程前往汉堡。

谨此致意，
先生，
您顺从的仆人，

(签署) K. M. Bourne.
代理警务处长。
